articleTitle: Selection of suppliers of vehicle components based on green supply chain
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Green supply chain is an important means to promote the harmony between vehicle manufacturer enterprises and the environment. Choosing appropriate vehicle component suppliers based on the green supply chain provides a solid foundation for vehicle manufacturers to develop green products and green systems. According to the characteristics of green supply chain, this paper builds the assessment index system for suppliers of vehicle components and establishes the assessment model by using the Threshold Method and the Gray Correlation Analysis. Through quantitative and qualitative methods, we analyze specifically for the process of vehicle manufacturers choosing respective suppliers of vehicle components, and prove the efficiency and validity of the established assessment model and index system.

Author Keywords: Supplier of Vehicle Components and Parts

articleTitle: Semantic integrated condition monitoring and maintenance of complex system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Condition monitoring and maintenance system of capital-intensive plant such as energy, chemical and manufacturing is information-intensive. It needs to integrate process parameters (such as speed, flow rate, etc) from process control systems and component condition monitoring parameters (such as vibration, oil particle size, etc) to improve fault detection, fault isolation and fault identification process. It also needs data (such as asset maintenance history information, spare parts, and costs information) from MES or ERP systems to optimize the maintenance activity decision. In this paper, we introduce ontology and rule to code the condition monitoring and maintenance domain knowledge, and then different applications can use tools (rule engine, reasoner) to manipulate the domain knowledge. In this way, it is easy to accomplish the condition monitoring and maintenance activities, reuse and share the domain knowledge.

articleTitle: A multiple objective optimization model for environmental benign process planning
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Few years back, not much importance was given to the effect of the product on the environment in the process planning stage. Till recently the environmental issues related with the manufacturing process were taken up seriously by both the general public and the government agencies which led to the need for environmental conscious manufacturing. This paper deals with the systematic determination of methods involved in the manufacturing of parts with one of the objective of minimizing environmental impacts. The focus of this study is to develop a multi objective non linear programming model for environmental supportive process planning while minimizing factors such as machining cost, machining time and environmental impact. An interactive front end tool is developed for optimum parameter selection and the results are discussed.

articleTitle: Hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm for assembly line balancing problem-2
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper discussed the types of Assembly Line Balancing Problem and relevant algorithms, presented the mathematical description of Assembly Line Balancing Problem-2. Using PSO's global search capability and high efficient of searching with SA's local search capability, proposing a hybrid PSO algorithm for Assembly Line Balancing Problem-2 and giving out a solving procedure based on the analysis of standard PSO algorithm for Assembly Line Balancing Problem-2. The result of example shows that the proposed the hybrid PSO algorithm is more effective than standard PSO algorithm on Assembly Line Balancing Problem-2.

articleTitle: Research on construction supply chain management in e-business environment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With continuous economic development and scientific and technical progress, global market competition is becoming increasingly stiff. Elementary knowledge of the supply chain management and e-business of construction enterprise were introduced in this paper. Some problems of existing supply chain management of construction enterprise in e-business environment were analyzed. Measures and key factors for strengthening supply chain management of construction enterprise in e-business environment were discussed. It's proposed that cooperation and communication be reinforced and good relationship between suppliers and contractor be well maintained and third-party logistics and JIT delivery system be made better. Supply chain management and e-business are effective tools for construction enterprise to save cost, shorten construction period and improve quality. E-business provides low-cost and convenient information support to supply chain management. Supply chain management of construction enterprise in e-business environment is important for improving competitiveness and economic and social benefits of construction enterprise.

articleTitle: Research of predictive maintenance for deteriorating system based on semi-markov process
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper proposes a predictive maintenance model for the deteriorating system with semi-Markov process, and presents a method to determine the best inspection and maintenance policy together. Furthermore, the phase-type (PH) algorithm is put forward to measure the transition probability matrix analytical tractability. The results of numerical simulation show that the model and algorithm are effective in improving maximal availability while optimizing the inspection rate. And it is also found that when the deterioration is the same at each failure stage, the optimal policy obtained by semi-Markov decision process with the phase-type approach (PSMDP) is a dynamic threshold scheme whose threshold value relates to the inspection rate.

articleTitle: Application of game theory on bidding price decision
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to provide a basis for bid decision, the paper constructed bidding price game model based on game analyzing characteristics in bidding and analyzed string bid phenomenon in bidding by this model, then found the root in this phenomenon. In addition, how to improve the probability of winning a bid by estimating the project cost accurately was discussed, thus, it was beneficial to contractor for bidding price exactly. Finally, how to strength the competitiveness of bidder was proposed. So bidding price game model is a bidding price decision model that can instruct contractor bidding and provide a reference to prohibit string bid behavior.

articleTitle: Quantification of valve stiction for control loop performance assessment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Control valves are extensively used in the process industry and valve stiction limits the performance of control loops. This study aims at the quantification of valve stiction that is valuable for improving the control performance by a subsequent step of valve stiction compensation or valve maintenance. A newly proposed two-layer binary tree data-driven model is adopted to capture the valve stiction; the Wiener model is used to describe the process dynamic nonlinearity. That is, a novel Stiction-Wiener model is formulated and a new identification algorithm is proposed to cope with the stiction parameter estimation in the closed-loop environment. It is verified through a numerical case study that the proposed quantification algorithm can provide the consistent estimates of valve stiction parameters.

articleTitle: Research on security requirements engineering process
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Nowadays, mostly security solutions are mainly focused on how to defend against various threats, including insider threats and outsider threats, instead of trying to solve security issues from their sources. In this paper, a security requirements engineering process is presented for security requirements elicitation and analysis. And the proposed process will deal with the security requirements at the earlier stages of system design in a systematic way. In addition, it can be generalized to any large-scale design project.

articleTitle: The Dempster-Shafer synthesis rule for service supplier selection
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Vendor selection becomes increasingly important for most manufacturing firms as it helps to reduce cost to the bottom line. The selection involves the determination of quantitative and qualitative factors so as to select the best possible suppliers. There are many different characteristics between product and service, the service supplier selection is uncertainty and a multi-level assessment of indicators. In this paper, according to the unique characteristics of the service supply chain and service, It summed up the service provider's evaluation criteria, and then expatiate the basic principles of the Dempster-Shafer synthesis rule. Finally, There is a example to show that the Dempster-Shafer synthesis rule is efficient, it can guarantee that the multi criteria evaluation could find the accurate and effective service providers on the service supply chain, and it also help the service business decision-maker.

articleTitle: Economic production identifying optimal economical and logistical measures
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The environment in which production enterprises operate is one of ever-growing complexity and dynamism - especially in the face of the current recession. The resulting increased pressure to reduce prices and costs forces enterprises to intensively examine the economic efficiency of investment decisions in their productions. Within the context of a research project at the Institute of Production Systems and Logistics at the Leibniz Universitaumlt Hannover, a demonstrator has been developed which, based on the example of rigidly linked lines in the forging industry, allows measures in the production to be evaluated regarding their impact on logistic and monetary objectives. By applying the stored decision logic the delivery reliability for example and the residual gains can be assessed. A driver tree along with Logistic Operating Curves and transfer functions that allow a monetary evaluation of changes in the logistic performance, form the basis for this decision logic.

articleTitle: Reliability calculation model of gears considering strength degradation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The correct evaluation of reliability for the system or components is very important for high quality and security. The traditional models take stress and strength as the static random variable without considering the effect of strength degradation. The effect of strength degradation on the reliability of a gear was studied in this paper. With the conditional reliability introduced, a reliability calculation model of gear with multiple failure modes is developed by using the stress-strength interference model, without the assumption that there was independent failure mode of gear. The reliability model of a gear under the strength degradation is developed based on the model. And the dependence of gear reliability on the strength degradation is studied. The result shows that the gear reliability decreases with the strength degradation due to fatigue, corrosion, aging and other factors.

articleTitle: Research of failure prediction Bayesian network model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A failure prediction Bayesian Networks model (FPBN) is brought forward by expanding the traditional Bayesian network (BN) methodology and tailored to deal with failure prediction problems. In the FPBN model, the classification of network nodes: failure detection nodes, failure cause nodes and failure mode nodes, and the algorithm to initialize orientations of network edges are illustrated. Moreover, with the conditional probability distributions, the implementation of the FPBN model in failure mode prediction, failure cause diagnosis and failure detection efficiency analysis are also described in details. At last, the simulation case study of a helicopter convertor is carried out and the comparison results show that, the FPBN model could perform effectively under uncertainty.

articleTitle: Vertical partioning in insert-only scenarios for enterprise applications
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Todays applications have a specific demand for operational reporting. It becomes more important to gain information using analytic style queries on the current transactional data. In addition enterprises must keep track of historical data for legal reasons, so they are forced to track any changes in the system. One possibility to record all changes is to use an insert-only data management approach. When using a main-memory database efficient usage of main memory is a very important factor. In this paper we show how a combination of insert-only data management together with vertical partitioning to achieve a seamless integration of time based data management and efficient memory usage. To validate our approach we present results of a customer analysis.

articleTitle: Choosing an appropriate construction project delivery method using FAHP in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The construction project delivery method chosen in the contract planning stage has a significant influence on the subsequent project performance. This paper aims to supply the employer with an effective and simple system of choosing the delivery method for certain projects in China. The fuzzy analytical hierarchy process (FAHP) is adopted to choose an appropriate construction project delivery methods in consideration of several relevant factors and sensitivity analysis is used to indicate the influence on choice when taking different key factors into account and to verify the practicality of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: Binary search tree visualization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Binary search tree is a very common data structure in computer programming. Working with large BSTs can become complicated and inefficient unless a programmer can visualize them. This article contributes with two BST visualization algorithms that draw a tree in time linearly proportional to the number of nodes in a tree.

articleTitle: A capacity planning model for TFT-LCD production networks
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper presents a capacity planning model for TFT-LCD production network. The capacity planning decision of TFT-LCD manufacturing is to simultaneously seek an optimal capacity allocation plan and capacity expansion policy. Capacity allocation decides on profitable product mixes and allocated production quantities of each product group at each production site. Capacity expansion concerned with determining the timing, types and sizes of capacity investments, especially in the procurement of new bottleneck machines and acquisition of new auxiliary tools. This study proposes a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) to formulate the capacity planning problem which considers many practical characteristics of TFT-LCD manufacturing such as multi-generation & multi-site production network, two capacity types, economic cutting ratio, and high capacity expansion costs. Finally, a case study modified from a Taiwan TFT-LCD manufacturer is illustrated.

articleTitle: Open innovation strategy in the process of technological capability development: Conceptual framework aspect
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: How to improve technological capability and generate core competence is one of most critical issues faced by companies in a serious competitive business world, especially those in developing countries. The theory of open innovation provides a new model to make the strategies of technological capability generation without a well-established capability base, while it requires a company to improve its capabilities on alliance strategies and alliance management. Based on theoretical and practical research, this paper argues that open innovation strategy contributes to the development of technological capability. External technology sourcing, particularly the alliances, plays a critical role in improving technological capability of companies. The process of technological capability development is a process to construct and manage open alliances. Due to its changing existed capabilities and available internal and external resources, a company has to make distinguish strategies to manage its external technology sourcing in its development stages. This research provides a new research framework on development of technological capability in emerging countries based on open innovation.

articleTitle: Study on fuzzy matter-element model based on grey relevancy analysis in comprehensive evaluation of logistics center location
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Logistics center location is a key step of logistics system optimization, so it is important to select a proper method to assess it. First, the index system for location evaluation of logistics center is constructed by analyzing influencing factors of logistics center location. Then, the fuzzy matter-element model based on grey relevancy analysis is built in view of the fuzziness and incompatibility of evaluation index in evaluation of logistics center location, and the model is used to choose the best scheme. Finally, the example indicates that the model is simple and convenient. It can effectively reduce subjective effect in the course of evaluation, and it can overall and objectively appraise the schemes of the logistics center location.

articleTitle: Research on logistic distribution system of retail chain
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Smooth logistics system contributes a lot to the success of chain operators, which is exerting ever increasing influence on China's economic development. This paper first analyzed the predominance of chain operators and then proceeded to the discussion of network implementation into logistics. Based on the reference of logistics advanced theory and the study of logistics chain management system, mathematical tools were applied to establish the vehicle scheduling data model and optimize the system design. Feasible proposals aimed at the acceleration of China's logistics and distribution system were given in the last part, expected to achieve logistics modernization, facilitate production and improve the socialist market economy in China.

articleTitle: Research on storage space allocation model of containers in container yard based on mixture storage
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the development of containerization, the requirement for operations optimization in container terminals has become prevalent and necessary. How to improve the efficiency of container yard and yard handling system is really an important subject for container terminals to tackle with. In this paper, a systematic method of container yard is proposed in order to solve both storage space allocation problem and yard crane scheduling problem. Based on mixture storage status of container yard, a mix-integer programming model, which considers various constraints related to operations of yard cranes and storage space allocation rules of yard blocks, is developed. Finally, numerical experiments are conduced to valid this model.

articleTitle: Multi-agent based modeling and simulation of complex system in hospital
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study puts forward a method to model and simulate the complex system of hospital on the basis of multi-agent technology. The formation of the agents of hospitals with intelligent and coordinative characteristics was designed, the message object was defined, and the model operating mechanism based on the mechanism of autonomous activities and coordination mechanism was also designed. In addition, the Ontology library and Norm library etc. were introduced using semiotic method and theory, to enlarge the method of system modeling. Swarm was used to develop the multi-agent based simulation system, which is favorable for carrying out test and optimization of the model. It is also favorable for making guidelines for hospital's improving its organization and management, optimizing the working procedure, improving the quality of medical care as well as reducing medical charge costs.

articleTitle: Application of rainflow cycle counting in the reliability prediction of automotive front corner module system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management

authors.preferredName: Assoc. Prof. Dr. Dzuraidah A. Wahab

abstract: The need for improvement in engineering reliability characterization for automotive components is nowadays becoming a major industry request. The post-design approach in determining reliability is inappropriate for an integrated product development process that aims to incorporate engineering life cycle requirements from the early stage. This paper intends to give a description of a method used in predicting the service loads in the reliability characterization of the automotive front corner module system. An accurate representation of the service environment as well as load histories is obtained from the proving ground by data acquisition. The acquired service load data is applied on durability test rig and number of cycles of the resultant random stress-time data is determined using rainflow cycle counting. Superposition of rainflow matrices is applied in order to replicate the actual service loads profile and cumulative damage analysis based on Palmgren-Miner rule is employed to determine life of components and system.

articleTitle: A practical split vehicle routing problem with simultaneous pickup and delivery
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: We study a split vehicle routing problem (VRP) with simultaneous pickup and delivery. Our problem is motivated by the logistics operations practice of a third-party logistics provider (3PL) who serves the inbound logistics for an automobile manufacturing company. We develop several greedy algorithms and a competitive decision algorithm to solve the problem, and conduct computational experiments to investigate some managerial insights of the system. Our work provides useful guidance for the operations of the 3PL.

articleTitle: Toward complexity: The impact on the traditional supply chain management by decentralized control — A view from a Supply and Demand Network (SDN)
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the overall control of a classic sense, the producers in the traditional supply chain can have control over the sales agents or retailers and reach the stable equilibrium by wholesale-price plus subsidy contracts. However, when things processed are complex and decision-making decentralizes in various system nodes, the traditional description is definitely inadequate. Thus, this article discusses the impact of the decentralized decision-making and decision-making period on the supply chain and proves that, as a result of the impact, the supply chain system cannot always be optimal.

articleTitle: Research on the customer service system for diesel engine industry
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the development of economy and society, the competition between companies is more and more drastic. Enterprise has to change their commercial mode from ¿product-oriented¿ to ¿customer-oriented¿ due to the cruel actuality. To diesel engine industry, service is very important. But, the diesel engines are not sold to the final customer, so there are many question and trouble in their service for customers. In this paper, the status quo and requirement of diesel engine industry are analyzed, a system for the customer service which make using of the Internet, computer and communication technology adequately and realizing the integration with the existing system is conceived, and the paper explain the structure detailed from the overall framework and the function designing sides.

articleTitle: Appraisal of lean production's implementation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Integrating the advantage of traditional batch production and piece production, lean production is being widely adopted by enterprises under customer-oriented market environment. This trend requires the appearance of scientific appraisal to lean production implementation, because reasonable appraisal has great significance to smooth application of lean production. On one hand, through scientific appraisal the enterprise that has been applying lean production can recognize its lean degree and identify improvement direction, on the other hand, the enterprises that still hold wait-and-see attitude can know the value of lean production exactly. In this paper, the index system of appraising lean production is set up, including financial indexes and also non-financial indexes. The lean factors are correlated, leading to enterprise's unique competence, so in the process of appraisal we use ANP to fix the weights of indexes. After introducing the unascertained theory, we set up the model to appraise lean production's implementation. At last a case is shown using the model put forward in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on performance evaluation of higher education based on the model of BSC-DRF-DEA
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the balanced scorecard (BSC) method, the performance measure indicators (PMLs) system for higher education is constructed, comprising four perspectives: financial, customer, internal process, and learning & growth. Incorporating DRF (data reduction factor) and DEA (data envelopment analysis) methods, a DRF-DEA model is proposed for university performance evaluation. The DRF approach is used to extract the rotated public factors from PML· and then DEA is applied to calculate the relative efficiency between DMUs (decision making units). The proposed DRF-DEA model can overcome the disadvantage that the differentiation of DEA's results will decrease with the increase in the number of variables. In the case study, 15 Science and Technology universities of MOE (Ministry of Education) have been chosen to illustrate the proposed model, which can evaluate the performance of higher education more scientific and reasonable.

articleTitle: Low-cost mutual RFID authentication model using predefined password lists
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The use of RFID tags for storing unique identifiers increases the complexity of existing global supply chains. Companies participating in this RFID-aided supply chains are confronted with new challenges by using RFID technology. Most RFID tags contain no sophisticated data protection mechanisms, because they are primarily designed to be cheap and to carry a very limited amount of data. This lack of data protection introduces various attack scenarios for current and upcoming RFID scenarios. The use of authentication in communication networks prevents third parties to gather access to confidential data. We introduce a mutual authentication model prevent the exposure of RFID communication data between tag and reader based on the implementation of predefined on-tag password lists.

articleTitle: The application of the risk-based inspection technique in the failure possibility analysis of the buried gas pipeline
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The failure possibility of pipeline is an important aspect affecting the size of the pipeline risk, so the failure possibility analysis of buried pipeline is necessary. Firstly, the status of buried pipeline failure analysis is analyzed. Then the risk-based inspection and its qualitative, semi-quantitative and quantitative analysis method are introduced. The semi-quantitative RBI method, which is applied to analyze the failure possibility of the buried gas pipeline, is introduced in detail with an example of urban buried gas pipeline.

articleTitle: Ambidextrous management of a large, complex engineering project with significant innovations-case study of the sutong bridge project
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The ambidextrous management of exploratory learning and exploitative learning during the limited time-span of large, complex projects with significant innovations is often necessary to spur creativity while ensuring reliability and efficiency, but is challenging due to the differences in organizational support needed for the two learning approaches. Through a case study, this paper examines how ambidextrous management can be achieved in such a complex and innovative project. The findings show that partitioning the two learning approaches in different project phases and separating funding mechanisms for the two types appear to be the two main performance drivers. Strong leadership on innovation and the flexibility in adjusting project targets also contributed to the success of the project.

articleTitle: Study on work improvement in a packaging machine manufacturing company
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies the improvement of production efficiency and balance rate of the manual assembly line in a packaging machine manufacturing company. Modular arrangement of predetermined time standards (MODAPTS) method is used to obtain time values for elements and for entire operations of the manual assembly line. Also the ECRS four principles (eliminate, combine, rearrange and simple) are used to minimize the idle time at every station or the percentage of line balance loss. In order to verify the results that were obtained from the generated line-balancing pre- and post-, Witness simulation software is used to estimate the output. Simulation results showed that productivity increases about 41.72% higher than the current situation.

articleTitle: Study on modern logistics cost management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With regard to the dominant cost and recessive cost in modern logistics cost as well as the target of logistics management, the logistics cost control system was established by using modern logistics information management system. Modern logistics cost could be managed with activity-based costing method, which is beneficial to control logistics cost, improve the enterprise's competitiveness and promote research on modern logistics cost management.

articleTitle: The process quality control of single-piece and small-batch products in advanced manufacturing environment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: SPC and APC are two important process control methods. Comparing to APC, SPC has more advantages in cost and in excellent rate. Especially, SPC can prevent quality accident. However, in advanced manufacturing environment the production is of single-piece and small-batch mode, which makes against the use of SPC. In order to utilize the advantages of SPC and find the statistics law of the quality characteristics in the single-piece and small-batch production circumstances, this paper adopts two ways to make use of SPC, which are using tolerance percentage method and amending control charts. The practice shows that the two ways are effective.

articleTitle: Optimization of assembly line based on work study
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The target of the study is the assembly line of lamp in one company. We analyze the producing process in detail. We found that there existed some problems such as bottleneck process and unbalanced line. To solve these issues we used the MOD method in work study as well as ECRS principle. The new plan merged and simplified the entire operating process, reduced workers and increased the rate of production line balancing.

articleTitle: Dynamics model study on the supply chain early warning system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to study the internal structure and dynamics behavior of supply chain early warning system, this paper analyzed the system framework of supply chain early warning system, And then presented the complex system internal index relationship. Moreover, the paper developed the dynamics model of supply chain early warning system, which focuses on the systematic analysis of all the interrelated subsystems, as well as the process of its operation.

articleTitle: Research on real estate supply chain risk identification and precaution using Scenario analysis method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the status quo of the real estate supply chain risk management, analyzed the risk identification stage using Scenario analysis method, then combined with the establishment of early warning mechanism, and built a complete set system of the real estate supply chain risk identification and Precaution in the paper, so that provide reliable reference for the real estate enterprises to response various risks better.

articleTitle: Academic stress and subjective well-being: The moderating effects of perceived social support
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using a sample of 226 graduate students from a university located in Northern China, this study empirically examined the effect of graduate students' academic stress on their subjective well-being, and tested the moderating effect of perceived social support on the relationship between academic stress and subjective well-being. The hierarchical regression analysis with SPSS 16.0 was employed to test the hypotheses. The results demonstrated that graduate students' academic stress was negatively correlated with their subjective well-being, and their perceptions of social support moderated the relationship between their academic stress and subjective well-being. Finally, limitations and practical applications were offered.

articleTitle: Designing reverse logistics network for End-of-Life Vehicles under capacity constraints
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Due to the environmental protection and the remaining economical value in End-of-Life Vehicles, this paper presents a capacitated facility location reverse logistics network problem and formulates a mixed-integer nonlinear facility location model to determine the optimal number and locations for collecting centers so as to minimize the total cost. Since this problem is NP-hard, we propose a Lagrangean Relaxation and Tabu Search hybrid algorithm. The performance of the proposed solution method has been demonstrated with computational experimentation.

articleTitle: The eco-industrial system study of circular small town
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Small town construction is an important strategy to promote the rural economic and social development. Its development has promoted the prosperity of rural economy and accelerated the urbanization course. But desperate resources exploitation and extensive economic mode have brought about large amount of problems about resource, energy and environment which prevented the small town from further developing. The very ways to solve the problems is constructing circular economic small town. Thus, the much important performance is constructing eco-industrial system, developing eco-agriculture, eco-industry and service and constructing eco-agricultural zone, eco-industrial zone and eco-tourism according to the four modes: agricultural-supporting mode, industry midwifery mode, tour-driving mode and urban radiations mode.

articleTitle: Research on the spare parts inventory
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The equipment management, maintenance and repair included, has been proven as an important task in operation. Spare parts inventory can exert great influence on the operation. Spare parts storage is directly linked to system performance since insufficient stocks can lead to extended equipment downtime. However, excessive or insufficient stocks lead to large inventory carrying cost and risks of not having then when they are needed. Therefore, in the management of spare parts inventories, one has to seek a balance and make a compromise between the cost of stocking the parts and the cost and risks of not having them when they are needed. In the thesis, characteristics of spare parts are listed by comparing with WIP and final products. Classifications of spare parts are introduced for different inventory methodologies. At the end of the thesis, a model for single depot is introduced for optimization.

articleTitle: Failure mode risk analyzing based on grey theory for power plant steam turbine proper
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As one of the top three main equipment groups in power plant, steam turbine system has an essential effect on the reliability and economy of energy production. And the steam turbine proper is the priority among priorities. Failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) is the technique to help effectively perform hazard prevention and power systems maintenance. In traditional analysis methods, includes fuzzy inference, the risk priority number (RPN) ranking mechanism was utilized which has several drawbacks. An improved ranking method based on grey theory is put forward with taking steam turbine for example in this paper. Analysis results are compared in the final.

articleTitle: Application of project portfolio management in the real estate corporations
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As is known to us all, after the occurrence of the global financial crisis, real estate corporations suffer more serious challenges. There will be more uncertainties and risks in the future. Traditional project management just focuses on doing the projects right, which is not enough. How to do the right projects becomes more important. In this paper, we simply review the concept and history of project portfolio management. After that we introduce some industries which apply project portfolio management. And then we argue some problems in the real estate corporations. At last we propose three primary phases to apply PPM in real estate corporations.

articleTitle: Research on the fractal company modeling based on competence
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The conceptual model of enterprise competence is built firstly, and the four basic enterprise competences are proposed which are activity competence, process competence, operator competence and team competence. Then the conceptual model of competence fractal unit (CFU) is built according to the competence characteristics of the fractal company, the four basic CFUs are proposed which are activity CFU, process CFU, operator CFU and team CFU, the mathematical models of the four basic CFUs are built on the basis of Unified Enterprise Competence Modeling Language (UECML), and the competence modeling procedures of the fractal company are given. The proposed competence modeling approach of the fractal company can represent the competences of the fractal company with the same and single formalism at different levels of abstraction, which facilitates the identification and management of the competence of the fractal company for creating competitive advantages for the company.

articleTitle: Integrated life-cycle costs analysis and life-cycle assessment model for decision making of construction project
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the acceleration of urbanization process and the booms in domestic infrastructure investment, the amount of civil engineering projects and infrastructures increase with years. In this context, how to lower the energy and environmental impacts of proposed project while achieving an optimization of owner's investment capitals has become a research focus with both theoretical and practical significance. Since the traditional decision-making process of construction projects solely focuses on the return of investment, this research aims to formulize a more scientific one by combining the concrete economic costs with quantitative social costs. Specific methods adopted are life-cycle costs analysis and hybrid life-cycle assessment. Result shows that the large-scale hydropower project, no matter in the aspect of life-cycle costs or in energy efficiency and environmental impact, are superior to the small-scale one.

articleTitle: RFID middleware as a service — Enabling small and medium-sized enterprises to participate in the EPC network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: RFID technology has been adopted in the market. It is used in large enterprises for different approaches with great success. The rise of RFID technology is still at its beginning and there is a lot of unused potential, especially concerning the so called long tail. To achieve the full value of supply chain networks the SMEs have to introduce RFID technology at their side, too. The idea behind Software as a Service has already proved in different scenarios that it is able to reach the long tail. In this contribution we will present such a SaaS solution for an on-demand RFID middleware, especially for SMEs.

articleTitle: Study on the organization and work breakdown structure of the international academic conference event management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The characteristics of international academic conference is analyzed specifically, the principle and process to design the organization structure and work breakdown structure (WBS) of international academic conference are proposed on the basis of the theory of event management and work breakdown structure in project management. Then the reference organization structure and general WBS of international academic conference are built. Finally, the actual value of the research is showed by being applied into the 38th International Conference on Computers and Industrial Engineering (CIE) and generating the specific responsibility matrix. A suitable way for the majority of international academic organizations can be attempted to explore to make the organization of international academic conference more subtle, specific, greater controllability.

articleTitle: Design and research on data analysis platform of the renewable energy monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article is based on the research of the software which is used in present to analysis building energy consumption. Through long-term monitoring the renewable energy consumption in construction which located in different climatic zones, different resources zoning, and different building types, we build new software which is suitable for China. By using XML data exchange mode, the software can solve the heterogeneous data problems. Adopted with a decision system which has three bases, the software can solve many problems, such as the fusion of multiply monitoring points, energy types and model methods. Through providing renewable energy consumption formula, the software can calculate and compare renewable energy use efficiency between various kinds of architectural climatic zoning, and then help government to make decision.

articleTitle: A study on reliability of a special two-dimensional system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A linear consecutive- (2, 2) -out-of-(m, n) : F system is a special two-dimensional system, which consists of m × n components, and fails if and only if all components in a 2 × 2 sub-matrix are failed. This system can be treated as a reliability model for video monitoring systems, phased-array radar systems, and wireless communication networks etc. An effective method has been developed for evaluating the exact system reliability, but that method can only give a recursive algorithm that can not be used for system optimization. In this paper, a finite Markov chain imbedding approach is used to obtain the reliability analytic formulas of that system. Numerical examples show that the method can be used for not only the system with independent identical distribution components, but also with independent non-identical distribution components.

articleTitle: Study of impact of real estate development and management risk on economic benefit
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Real estate industry is the weak realm of risk analyzing and application. This paper combines the characteristics of real estate development and management, specifics to the deficiency of traditional financial evaluation methods which ignore the risk factors and reflects the risk appraisal results in the financial index through Monte Carlo simulation. The paper studies the impact of real estate development and management risk on economic benefit, makes the financial index reflect relevant risk condition and provides basis for scientific decisions.

articleTitle: Cost model based optimization of RCM group maintenance interval
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For the optimization of complex system RCM tasks, the group maintenance policy is introduced, and mathematical models are established to minimize the whole maintenance cost per unit time. The cost of traditional periodic replacement and functional check considering potential failure are analyzed, respectively; integrating several types of preventive maintenance, the complex system group maintenance cost model is obtained. By the joint execution of maintenance tasks, the times and loss of system shut-down are reduced and the maintenance cost can be saved. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed models is illustrated through a numerical example.

articleTitle: Market orientation and corporate performance: The mediated effect of marketing capability
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Market orientation is regarded as one of the executive tools of marketing concept, and having been one of the most important research topics in academia, including its antecedents and consequences and the relationship between market orientation and corporate performance. The existing theories are not unanimous about the impact of market orientation on corporate performance. The underlying causation lies on the relationship between market orientation and corporate performance is not direct, but some mediums are in existent. This paper focuses on the mediated effect of marketing capability on the relationship between market orientation and corporate performance, constructing a mediated model and testing it empirically based on Chinese companies. According to the conclusions, we indicate that companies must actively transform their market orientations into marketing capabilities effectively, so as to gain excellent performances and persistent competitive advantages.

articleTitle: Vehicle routing problem with time windows and simultaneous pickups and deliveries
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper focuses on the time windows factor in vehicle routing problem with simultaneous pickups and deliveries. In vehicle routing problem with time windows and simultaneous pickups and deliveries (VRPTWSPD), vehicles must wait and can not start service immediately if they arrive earlier ahead of the time when pickup goods are ready. Meanwhile, tardiness may cause penalty cost. We propose a mathematical model for VRPTWSPD and develop a genetic algorithm to solve it. The results for the numerical experiments validate the effectiveness of the algorithm proposed in this paper, and demonstrate the significance of introducing time windows. Moreover, we discuss the algorithm performance under varying penalty values of tardiness through sensitivity analysis.

articleTitle: Measuring the quality of interfaces using source code entropy
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Global enterprises face an increasingly high complexity of software systems. Although size and complexity are two different aspects of a software system, traditionally, various size metrics have been established to indicate their complexity. In fact, many developed software metrics correlate with the number of lines of code. Moreover, a combination of multiple metrics collected on bottom layers into one comprehensible and meaningful indicator for an entire system is not a trivial task. This paper proposes a novel interpretation of an entropy-based metric to assess the design of a software system in terms of interface quality and understandability. The proposed metric is independent of the system size and delivers one single value eliminating the unnecessary aggregation step. Further, an industrial case study has been conducted to illustrate the usefulness of this metric.

articleTitle: Research on modularization fuzzy petri net of disassembly system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at the two key problems during the process of the disassembly analysis, which are the combination explosion in generating the disassembly model and the lack of the uncertainty factors in determining the optimal disassembly sequence, this paper proposes a level modular method and puts forward the Petri net model correspondently, which reduce the complication of the disassembly model effectively. Meanwhile, the influences of uncertainty factors on evaluation algorithm of disassembly indexes, under different work conditions, are discussed and formulated. These parameters are saved in a fuzzy unit with the carrier of workers information, which form a special "place". Thus, a common Petri net is extended as a fuzzy Petri net disassembly model. Combining the corresponding evaluation algorithm, an optimal disassembly sequence according with the actual working situation can be achieved. Finally, a case is proposed to illustrate the above method.

articleTitle: The lean manufacture research in environment of the supply chain of modern industry engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the modern manufacturing industry stepping into the era of post-industrialization, Chinese modern manufacturing enterprises have to promote technical innovation, adjust industrial structures, perfect supply chain management, strengthen quality education, enhance management level, fulfill energy saving and waste lowering, uphold stable, sustained and coordinated and scientific development. Facing to the global finance crisis even though the economic crisis, this is to be a difficult problem how to make out lying before us. Utilizing lean manufacture basing on supply chain integration, the Chinese modern manufacturing industry is sure to tide over and win the first strike among international competitions. This is an important aspect of the study in modern industry engineering.

Author Keywords: modern industry engineering and the manufacturing industry

articleTitle: Research on the knowledge transfer in construction projects
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The construction industry is generally viewed as a project-based industry, in which knowledge is scattered in different construction projects and participants. Since the complex nature of construction projects brings serious challenge, knowledge will seldom be shared or reused if it could not be transferred effectively and acquired correctly. Knowledge loss in a construction project's lifecycle and among different projects is discussed in this paper. Obstacles of knowledge transfer in construction projects are identified and the importance of knowledge transfer in the implementation of construction projects is emphasized. Additionally, the mechanism of knowledge transfer is analyzed. Some suggestions for improving efficiency of knowledge transfer in construction projects are presented also.

articleTitle: Post-disaster risk management: From the perspective of policy acceptance of earthquake survivors in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A huge earthquake jolted Wenchuan, China, shocking the whole world. It is worth noting that the disaster brought several factors of social instability, and how to conduct social risk management effectively becomes the top priority. Whether post-disaster public policies are perceived to be reasonable and accepted by the victims plays an important role in post-disaster risk management. Therefore, exploring the impact mechanism of post-disaster public policy acceptance in earthquake-stricken region will be conducive to strengthen targeted risk management and ensure social stability. A field study was applied to the local survivors of the earthquake-stricken region, which was designed to examine the effect of procedural justice and the collective outcome favorability on post-disaster policy acceptance through hierarchical regression analysis method. The results (7V=290) indicated that perceived collective outcome favorability had larger effect on the post-disaster policy acceptance than perceived procedural justice. Furthermore, perceived procedural justice interacted with collective outcome favorability. That is procedural justice promoted policy acceptance only when people's perception of outcome was favorable to the whole survivor group; when it was unfavorable, procedural justice lost its positive effect on policy acceptance.

articleTitle: A performance assessment on manufacturing nodes in robust design of supply chain networks (SCNs)
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper provides an evaluation method on the performance of manufacturing nodes in supply chain networks (SCNs). After extensive literature review on the robust design of SCNs, a definition of "robustness" is tentatively made. This paper proposes an analytical framework for the manufacturing nodes and explicitly discloses the production authorization (PA) mechanism inside the manufacturing nodes in SCNs. Based on a hypothetical M/M/l queue model of PA mechanism in the manufacturing nodes, a performance assessment on the manufacturing nodes in SCNs is conducted by simulation of the production process through queuing theories. Finally, some possible research directions are suggested for the future work.

articleTitle: Study on the association between regional logistics and regional economy
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Quantitative analysis of regional logistics and regional economic relations can find out the impact of logistics on the economy. A set of new regional economic index systems was established, and the index weight in the economic index systems was determined. In the analytic hierarchy process, the association between regional logistics and regional economy was given by using the gray correlation method. Finally, the method is used to discuss the association between the logistics and the regional economy in Qinhuangdao.

articleTitle: Study on quality and safety supervision control system for food supply chain
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Food supply chain involves in the production, consumption, processing, circulation and other links of primary agricultural. Any improper control of links will affect the final quality of products; even jeopardize the health of consumers. So the treatment of food supply chain safety relied on the concerted efforts of all participants. The establishment of risk-sharing, benefit-sharing of safety control supervision system of food supply chain is the primary work of the whole society. This supervision control information system which designed for food supply chain is studied in this article.

articleTitle: Applying TAFEI method to orthopaedic robot system's requirements analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Medical robot can enhance surgery through improved precision, stability, and dexterity, which has brought great benefits for patients. However, it yields a series of disadvantages to the surgeons, such as the bad eye-hand coordination, the ill-designed workstations etc. All these disadvantages can cause human error during operations, and human error is considered to be the major contributing factor of medical accidents. To improve the safety of the orthopaedic robot system, the task analysis for human error identification (TAFEI) method is used to predict the human error during the requirements analysis stage. By analyzing the potential undesired operations, which will influence the usability of the system, the protection measures are proposed to reduce the errors of the applied system. It is concluded that this method is feasible during the requirements analysis stage of the design.

articleTitle: An impact fatigue testing machine to investigate the fatigue lifetime of automatic mechanism key components
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This problem of fatigue lifetime of automatic mechanism key components has been widely valued by people, so to develop a kind of fatigue testing machine is important. A scheme regarding impact fatigue testing machine was presented through using impulse theorem and Hertz impact theory. The main parameters of fatigue testing machine were considered. And the dynamic analysis to the airframe result of was obtained by finite element analysis software. In this paper, to design an impact fatigue testing machine, the impact fatigue testing machine will reduce the cost of components and improve the reliability of components design.

articleTitle: Normalization of interval symbolic data
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As a new tool in data mining, symbolic data analysis (SDA) can not only decrease the computational complexity of huge data sets, but also master the property of the sample integrally. In many statistical analysis methods the sample data need to be normalized in advance. This paper focuses on the normalization of interval symbolic data. Firstly, on the assumption that all the individuals are uniformly distributed within the interval, the method of normalization of interval symbolic data is presented. Then, the method of normalization of interval symbolic data of arbitrary distribution is studied. For this purpose, the mean and variance of interval symbolic data is brought forward in advance. Finally, an example of evaluation on different financial stocks in Chinese stock market is given.

articleTitle: Research on knowledge work efficiency and influencing factors under dynamic network environment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In present paper, the issue of knowledge work efficiency under dynamic network environment is put forward. The mechanism of knowledge work is analyzed. The knowledge work efficiency is defined as cognitive efficiency and group collaboration efficiency in narrow and broad sense, respectively. Six kinds of factors, namely individual factor, work group factor, task factor, work resource factor, management factor and physical environment factor, and 54 specific influencing factors are obtained based on theoretical analysis and investigations through questionnaires in some provinces of China. Finally, 13 major influencing factors are obtained according to factor analysis based on variance maximization of multivariate statistical analysis method.

articleTitle: Ontology based semantic interconnection of distributed numerical simulations for virtual production
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The focus of this work is to promote the semantic interconnection of distributed numerical simulations for virtual production systems. The product planning phase usually requires a huge range of various numerical simulations that are used by different departments of a company. To increase productivity on the one hand and reduce complexity of simulation chains on the other hand, it is essential to be able to interconnect the differing syntax and semantics of the distributed numerical simulations. The interconnection is realized by an ontology based tool for data integration that is used within a simulation platform.

articleTitle: A conflict resolution algorithm considering design objective optimization in collaborative design
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Conflict is inevitable to take place in collaborative design, and conflict resolution plays an important part in complex product collaborative design systems. Firstly, a mathematic description model in collaborative design considering resource conflict, process conflict and design conflict is given, and the mathematic model expresses the origin of conflict and shows that conflict resolution is a multiobjective planning problem. Next, a conflict resolution algorithm considering design objective optimization is presented, and fuzzy value and fuzzy grade are applied in the algorithm. Depending on both considering design variables having fundamental influences on its design objectives and the cost of conflict resolution, the algorithm can improve the quality and efficiency of conflict resolution. Finally, an example of single cylindrical gear reducer is used to show the validity of the algorithm.

articleTitle: noFilis CrossTalk 2.0 as device management solution — Experiences while integrating RFID hardware into SAP Auto-ID infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Intelligent objects, results of the modern RFID technology, tend to be used extensively in business contexts to improve processes like goods receipt, goods issue, logistical tracking of returnable transport items, and kanban. Those RFID-enabled processes need large support from existing Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems. Therefore this paper evaluates software systems which helps integrating RFID technology into existing ERP systems. To this end, we use an exemplary kanban scenario to show how the device management software noFilis CrossTalk fits into common middleware like the SAP Auto-ID infrastructure. Finally we evaluate noFilis CrossTalk and give a short outlook.

articleTitle: Data envelopment analysis model and its application on technical efficiency evaluation of coal enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A math model based on Data Envelopment Analysis was proposed to make comprehensive technical efficiency evaluation for coal enterprise with multi-input and multi-output systems generally, and this makes it complex and difficult to make precise technical efficiency evaluation, for example, it is hard to set evaluating weights index and difficult to get sound evaluation when the evaluation function is unknown. However, these difficulties can be avoided with DEA model. The C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>GS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> model and EC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>GS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> model derived from C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>GS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> model were proposed and their efficiency judgment criterions were given in this paper. Then based on existing data, the model was applied to make technical efficiency evaluation for Chinese coal enterprises to estimate their technical performance.

articleTitle: The city planning for service centers of express company
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper summarizes the status of the express industry and provides basic knowledge related to the city planning for service centers of express companies. Then the paper goes deep into the detailed steps of the city planning for service centers. Based on the forecast of volume, productivity and capacity growth by service zones, the author proposes an effective way to select the location for future service centers to meet the increasing market requirements.

articleTitle: Critical success factors (CSFs) for process management projects
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study establishes critical success factors (CSFs) that affect the readiness and successful implementation of process management (PM). Preliminary by reviewing the literature and studying various reports about implementation PM in organizations, critical success factors that affecting successful implementation of PM were identified. The 13 factors and 64 sub factors were refined, and these factors and sub factors were tested by PM experts' opinions. Then, the refined CSFs formed the basis of self-assessment framework that can be used by firms to analyze their readiness to implement PM. Finally we offer statistical methods in order to manage, improve and increase the affects of them in organizations by using ISO 10017:2003.

articleTitle: The empirical study on the relationship between corporate intellectual capital and corporate performance
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the rapid development of intellectual capital studies, it is an indisputable fact that intellectual capital has become an important source of corporate competitiveness. On the basis of the 326 specific questionnaire survey statistics, the impact of the three integral parts of intellectual capital on corporate performance is studied by utilizing Structural Equation Modeling. It is finally verified that relational capital is the most significant factor that impacts on corporate performance, structural capital the second significant one, and human capital the least significant one. Human capital exist its indirect impact on corporate performance through the relational capital and structural capital, rather than direct significant impact on corporate performance. All these three parts have positive impacts on corporate performance.

articleTitle: Risk evaluation process modeling in software project investment based on Bayesian networks
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A risk evaluation model in software project investment based on Bayesian networks (BNs) is presented in this paper. The BNs parameter learning is applied to the modeling process based on sample data set, so that the BNs is more accordant with the project feature in the software project investment phase. In addition, the validity of the parameter learning is validated with algorithm precision and convergence. Practice proves that the risk evaluation model can provide the accurate risk information for decision-makers in the process of software project investment.

articleTitle: Methods for optimizing weights of wavelet neural network based on adaptive annealing genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The BP neural network algorithm can not guarantee an error plane as the overall minimum in the training process. It may have a number of local minimum rather than the optimal solution to the issue. To solve this issue, a new genetic algorithm of self-adaptive annealing is designed on the basis of standard genetic algorithm, combined with algorithms for global optimization of simulated annealing to optimize the connection weights. Furthermore, since the standard genetic algorithm is found to have such issues as early immature convergence and late search retardation; difficult coordination of crossover and mutation operator; weak capacity of local search; single way to update the group hard to take care of both the diversity and convergence requirements; slower convergence rate, etc. Based on the characteristics of the algorithm structure, genetic algorithm with parallelism applies the adaptive annealing strategy in calculating the selection probability to enhance the convergence of the genetic algorithm, while adaptive processing is made on the selection of the probability of crossover and mutation to further improve the stability and convergence of the genetic algorithm. The mixed use of genetic algorithms and other algorithms can achieve the advantageous objective while avoiding the disadvantages. Application of this method for training in the Shanghai stock index has witnessed a better network performance.

articleTitle: Study on integrated information system of world expo 2010 Shanghai construction and operation management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Focusing on the important points during the implementation of World Expo 2010 Shanghai, the general framework of integrated information system for construction and operation management is established. Key technologies of system implementation are also presented. These techonologies include service-oriented comprehensive information integrated architecture, virtual reality technology based on GIS platform, integrated information technology for large-scale & complex construction programme, intelligent video monitoring technology, decision support technology, information portal technology etc.

articleTitle: Research on location-routing problem of relief system based on emergency logistics
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The research on the Location-Routing Problem of relief system based on emergency logistics is very important for improving the ability to deal with the emergencies and the disasters. This paper divides the location-routing problem (LRP) into two sub-problems: emergency facilities location problem and emergency resource routing problem, and then establishes a LRP model with the goal of minimizing total cost (including fixed cost, transportation cost and disaster losses cost), and uses a two-stage heuristic algorithm to settle this model. At the first stage, it uses an clustering method solve the emergency facilities locating problem with the constraints of emergency time, demand and weight of distance to solve the heuristic function; and at the second stage, it uses ant colony algorithm to solve the heuristic function with the goals time, the probability of safe passage and distance for the emergency resource routing problem. At last, the paper selects the typhoon disaster as a typical example to analyze the model, and after operated in MATLAB7.0 the results show that the LRP model is rational and feasible.

articleTitle: A assembly modeling method based on assembly feature Graph-Tree model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Assembly model plays a important role between conceptual design and detail design. A novel model, in which a structural Graph-Tree has been constituted by assembly feature as a basic unit, is presented. Furthermore, a notation system has been presented for representation of the model. Based on the proposal feature mapping arithmetic, the assembly model is been built easily. Mapping between functions and structures has been realized easily and the instance of closed loop in constrain resolve has been avoided successfully. Finally, the integration of conceptual design and detail design has been well realized.

articleTitle: Impact of strategic customer behavior breadth on profit in revenue management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies the impact of strategic customer behavior breadth on seller's profit. The paper considers a seller that sells a product over two periods during the selling season with the presence of strategic customers. By solving the rational expectation equilibrium between the seller and the customers, the paper studies the pricing and inventory decision of the seller. Results show that the seller should make their decisions according to the strategic customer behavior breadth. Many factors are involved in determining the turning point of strategic customer behavior breadth, but the seller may resort to high full-price at the beginning of the selling season in most cases.

articleTitle: Some thoughts about the whole life-cycle cost management of civil engineering projects
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The whole life-cycle cost management is a concept of modern project management. Combined with China's national conditions, this article has put forward a basic strategy of the whole life-cycle cost management of civil engineering projects, given some basic analysis and calculation methods of the whole life-cycle cost management, introduced an overview of the integrated management system for the development of the whole life-cycle cost management of civil engineering projects, expatiated information flow management and risk management elements in life cycle cost management and designed a framework of whole life cycle risk management.

articleTitle: The interrelationship among quality planning, knowledge process and new product development performance
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By means of 198 questionnaires and structural equation modeling (SEM) approach, this paper aims to investigate the mechanism and the paths of the interaction among quality planning, knowledge process and new product development performance. The findings indicate that quality planning has a significant direct positive effect on the knowledge process of new product development (NPD); knowledge process has a significant direct positive effect on the NPD performance; and quality planning has a significant indirect positive effect on the NPD performance through knowledge process. Knowledge acquisition, knowledge integration, knowledge application and knowledge sharing can represent knowledge process.

articleTitle: Research on the project supervision game model based on the information asymmetry theory
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to investigate the game among contractor, supervisor and owner, this article analyzes their information asymmetry in project supervision, and explores the evolutionary game model. Compared with traditional model studying two sides' mixed strategy Nash equilibrium we construct strategic response function and deduce a game space ultimately.
