By introducing a three-player game-theoretic model, we show that governments should reinforce the owner's supervision mechanism, owner need to complete the present engineering supervision system and adopt penalty- incentive mechanism both to contractor and supervisor. This is the way to realize the win-win strategy among three players in the long run.

articleTitle: Systematical design quality control model based on key quality characteristics
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To systematical control the quality of product design process, a quality control model of product design is presented on the basis of the key quality characteristics. According to the theory of three levels of the total product and Axiomatic Design principles, quality systematical control requirements of product design, such as meeting customer demands and adaptation to production capacity of enterprise, are analyzed. The concept of product key quality characteristics is put forward based on analyzing multidimensional framework of product quality characteristics, and then an evolution process model of product key quality characteristics is created, which includes identifying, decomposing and mapping activities. A design quality control process model based on the evolution model is presented, it provides objects and measures in the form of quality plan for product design quality control via console. Finally, an application example is analyzed to show the feasibility of this proposed model.

Author Keywords: Key quality characteristics identify and decompose

articleTitle: Research on competitiveness evaluation of seamless garment enterprises based on PROMETHEE method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Seamless knitting technology is an innovative textile and garment manufacturing technology. In the last decade, China has become one of the key production bases of seamless apparel along with Israel and Turkey. Zhejiang Yiwu seamless apparel industry cluster is developing into a powerful competitor to absorb the international industrial transfer from Israel, which is under pressure of higher labor and material cost. To evaluate the competitiveness of the key seamless apparel enterprises in Yiwu industrial cluster, this study seeks to establish a criteria system, which covers R&D capability, production capacity, management level, human resources, capital operation, and brand value. The relative importance of criteria is determined by Entropy. Outranking method PROMETHEE is applied to evaluate the competitiveness of five major seamless apparel producers (BJ, BN, RY, SM, QR) in Yiwu industrial cluster. Sensitivity of the weight is analyzed with GAIA planes. This study provides an in-depth analysis of the strength and features of the seamless apparel enterprises, and shows the potential measures to improve competitiveness.

articleTitle: Research on the credit of practicing qualification personnel in construction market based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Evaluation method based on the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is brought out trying to analyze the credit of practicing qualification personnel after the index system is established. And then, a case study is executed by taking one participator of practicing qualification as an example. The research results reveal that the method can efficiently evaluate the credit of the practicing qualification personnel. So it can give good advice to the construction enterprise to prevent the discreditable behavior made by the practicing qualification personnel.

articleTitle: Research on the formation mechanism of service recovery paradox
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Finding out the formation process of service recovery paradox is useful for enterprises to control failures and adopt recovery measures. This paper reveals the entire process of the formation of service recovery paradox based on customer satisfaction. The result shows: the frequency, severity and controllability can cut customer satisfaction down remarkably, among which the severity is the most influencing factor; both the level of physical compensation and non-physical compensation can increase customer satisfaction; relationship strength will moderate the change of satisfaction for these two processes, customers with low relationship strength are more sensitive to the frequency and severity and pay more attention to physical compensation.

articleTitle: Inventory control for remanufacturing system with stochastic product returns
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The remanufacturing is regarded as a resource-saving and environment-friendly industry. However, inventory control for remanufacturing is facing great challenge caused by uncertainty of product returns, demands and repairing process. In this paper, a single-product remanufacturing system is analyzed and the research of effect caused by stochastic product returns is especially focused on. A kind of pull policy considering the unserviceable inventory and serviceable inventory together is employed. A cost model, the expected value of average single-cycle cost (EASC), is constructed under certain environmental assumptions. The objection is to minimize the EASC by controlling two variables, the serviceable inventory's supplement batch and the remanufacturing product batch. The problem is solved by mathematical method.

articleTitle: Analysis of strategic decision-making of company's project investment based on portfolio theory
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at the problem of risk evaluation and decision-making of corporation's project investment programming scenario, the paper sets up project yield evaluation model based on projects' investment incomes. The conception of strategic environment is introduced, and its probability distributing is used to describe the environment's uncertainty inside and outside of corporation. Hence, taking integration yield even value m and variation sigma<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> which weighs risk degree as evaluation index of project investment programming scenario; optimum risk decision-making model is established using portfolio theory. At last, the paper illuminates the application approach and validity of the model through a concrete example.

articleTitle: Forecasting model for degradation path and parameter estimation based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Traditional life evaluation theory established on the basis of mass failure data, the phenomena of little or naught failure put forward challenges for existed life evaluation theory. The performance degradation data provide useful information for products' reliability and gives feasible way for products' life evaluation. The limitations of existing degradation models are analyzed, a new forecasting model and parameter estimation method based on neural network is brought forward. By using back propagation neural network(BPNN), the nonlinear degradation path of product performance can be got, and the parameters can be estimated by self-adaptive neural network. An example is given out to validate the effectiveness of the method and compared with existing model.

articleTitle: Automotive process-based new product development: A process monitoring
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The new product development (NPD) process is subjected to be monitored to assure the desired results in terms of both effectiveness and efficiency. This paper presents process-based NPD and process monitoring concept, within the context of the automotive quality management system standard, ISO/TS16949:2002. The process monitoring covers the areas of review, verification, and validation including Production Part Approval Process (PPAP). These areas focus on process effectiveness. In order to improve process efficiency, the monitoring should be extended to the area of process performance measurement. The further study regarding process performance measurement in conjunction with the proposed automotive process-based management is recommended.

articleTitle: The customer marketing strategy of commercial banks based on customer lifetime value
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: One of the difficulties of commercial banks is how to determine the profitability customer, and then consider them as the key of marketing. Base on the customer lifetime value, the paper analyze the current value, the potential value, the currency value and the non-currency value of the commercial banks customer. The customer lifetime value of commercial banks is been determined by applying AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. Based on the customer lifetime value the commercial banks customer is been segmented to four classes, and the corresponding marketing strategy is been put forward.

articleTitle: Simulation resource selection based on local optimization method in distributed simulation repository
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the development of simulation applications, the Distributed Simulation Resource Repository (DSRR) could manage all kinds of distributed simulation resources and provide transparent access, search, and browsing for users. In recent years, more and more research focus on the construction of DSRR, which includes metadata, dataset, algorithm, model, toolkit, and etc. However, when more and more resources are added into DSRR, users get many same or similar resource result sets in DSRR by semantic searching. Numerous time has been spent on selecting simulation resources from the result sets. According to the features of simulation resources, we setup 5 quality criteria which are the resource price, download speed, the reputation of source, the availability and whether the resource has been accessed. Then the Local Optimization method is applied to get the quality score of each resource. These resources in result set are assorted again by quality score to help user select suitable resource and access it. This method is accomplished by LDAP server and J2EE JNDI interface. The selection time can be reduced by this method.

articleTitle: Customer demand forecasting based on SVR using moving time window method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The principles of support vector regression (SVR) are described. The collection and treatment of customer demand, the moving time window method, the selection of training samples and the analysis of forecasting accuracy are stated. The customer demand forecasting approach based on SVR using moving time window method is proposed. With the demand data of a simulation example, the presented approach is used to forecast the demand values for 7 days ahead. The average forecasting error is less than 2%. The simulation results demonstrate the approach is feasible and valid in customer demand forecasting.

articleTitle: A hybrid genetic algorithm for multiresponse parameter optimization within desirability function framework
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The desirability function method is widely used for simultaneous optimization of several independent or uncorrelated responses. In practical applications, a second-order polynomial is usually employed to represent each response based on RSM. Then a functional form for the overall desirability will be reached. The so-obtained overall desirability function is usually nondifferentiable, highly nonlinear and multimodal for practical problems, especially when there are quite a number of responses and design variables. This paper proposes a hybrid approach, which merges a global search procedure, the genetic algorithm, with a local search procedure, the pattern search method, to tackle this kind of problems. A numerical example from literature is discussed for illustrative purpose. Results reveal that the proposed approach has good convergence characteristics.

articleTitle: A study on thumb and index finger operated interface for personal mobile devices: Mobile phone keypad and joystick
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This study intends to redesign the user interface of mobile devices to ease the heavy workload on the thumb as well as to better fit our hand with the devices when grasping. Based on the motion characteristics of thumb and index finger and the one-handed operated interface requirements, a new design idea was emerged. The design principles were taken into consideration for the new interface design in order to increasing comfort and reducing muscle workload of the thumb. The method of this study is divided into two stages: new device innovation and evaluation. After experimental analysis, this study suggests: 1. Designing the contoured grasping region based on user anthropometric data for the mobile devices will provide a more comfortable grasp. 2. It is recommended that the center of keypad be located at near the thumb tip for both minimizing the joint angle changes of operating digits and enhancing the accessibility of the thumb. 3. The effort of adding index finger keys for reducing thumb fatigue level is not seem to be obvious. The results can contribute to design of one-handed mobile device.

articleTitle: Model choosing method based-on variation coefficient and its application to project management of petrochemical engineering construction
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper provides a review of the related literatures on decision making indexes and methods for project management mode selection, and analyses the characteristics of petrochemical project construction, and further makes the comparison among the common management modes for petrochemical project at present and designs the corresponding mode selection indexes. A method of management mode selection for petrochemical project construction is presented, in which the index weight is determined based on variation coefficient method. Finally, an illustration is given through a case.

articleTitle: Construction and evaluation of post-evaluation index system on loan projects of international financial organizations
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at loan projects of international financial organizations, this paper put forward the content and framework of post-evaluation. Set the Yellow River flood control and disaster reduction system construction project as an example, this paper established the three-tier evaluation system using AHP method and fuzzy mathematics for fuzzy comprehensive post-evaluation. The rationality and effectiveness of the contents and methods of post-evaluation on loan projects of international financial organizations were proved by one example.

articleTitle: Urban planning and management system development discussion for small and medium-sized cities
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the requirements of urban planning and management business for small and medium-sized cities, different system models are discussed in the paper. The use of workflow technology can improve the operational efficiency and management level, and the system has good flexibility and compatibility as well. OLE automation technology is applied to integrate GIS software (AutoCAD Map) to the system. So the system is the integration of operation interface, function and data. The practical application of the system shows that the model can meet the actual needs of small and medium-sized cities.

articleTitle: Best linear unbiased estimation method for ammunition storage reliability data
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The mean and variance formulas of interval statistic for ammunition storage reliability data are given, the best linear unbiased estimation method for ammunition storage data of two-parameter Weibull distribution is also established, and the confidence limits of percentile and percentage of two-parameter Weibull distribution for ammunition storage data are obtained based on it.

articleTitle: Research on the efficiency evaluation of industry innovation system based on DEA analysis method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Industry innovation is critical for industry adjustment and escalation, and is the terminal embodiment of international competitive power. The concept of industry innovation system tries to provide a multi, comprehensive, dynamic, evolutive idea of industry innovation. This concept can better interpret industry structure, verge, organization and their relationship, learning process, innovation and producing process and the process of system coordination evolution. The thesis establishes the evaluation index and evaluation model of industry innovation system based on the theories of technological economics, econometrics and industrial economics, etc., which provides not only reference for the development of China industry innovation system research but also foundation for the stipulation of concerning policies.

Author Keywords: DEA Industry innovation system Efficiency evaluation Evaluation means

articleTitle: Improvement study of quality control in process of producing flux-cored wire
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The flux-cored wire is a new kind of welding material with many advantages. The quality and uniformity of flux-cored wire are affected by its production mode greatly. In this paper, the cause of uneven quality flux-cored wire produced under steel rolling process is investigated firstly. Then, a mathematical model of relative motion between the rolling machine and the strip is carried out based on the principle of reverse engineering. After that, some reasonable design conditions for control systems and production equipment are obtained by solving the model. Finally, an example for the actual production is introduced for verification.

articleTitle: Research on product information model for collaborative design
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A three-layer structural product information model is put forward. The information interaction of each layer is researched. In data layer, model-driven mapping method is adopted. The bidirectional data mapping mechanism is set up between XML and database using JavaBean object as the middleware. In logic layer, the paper uses product structure tree to take organization and management on components and parts. And in user layer, the model is given the ability of real-time and synchronous information interaction using AJAX. The collaborative design prototype system is developed based on AJAX4JSF. The product information model of GC1-2 sewing machine is built using the approach put forward by the paper. The tests show that model's real-time and synchronous information interaction capacities are improved.

articleTitle: The systematic research on constructing "three-dimensional" logistics network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The logistics is the foundation and artery of our national economy, and constructing "three-dimensional" logistics is an important way to keep our country's logistics system steadily-growing over the long term. Also, it's a positive response to logistics adjustment and promotion plan issued by State Council on March 10, 2009. This article illustrates the connotation of "three-dimensional" logistics system, discusses and analyzes the overall framework of "three-dimensional" logistics network in the macroscopic level, the intermediate perspective level, and the microscopic level, and then carries on the empirical analysis by collected and arranged the data from 1991-2008. This article proves the scientific and feasibility of the "three-dimensional" logistics in the theory and practice.

articleTitle: A study about Kansei quality of consumer goods
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Kansei Quality contains product philosophy with traditional culture involved. To create Kansei Quality, understand its attribute concept and reveal the inner relationship between culture and Kansei Quality, the paper finds out invisible subjective Kansei demand, build up heuristic Kansei Quality conversion model and arrive at objective elements of Kansei Quality with the methodology of empirical and explanatory methods. The nature of Kansei Quality is to satisfy demand value with the existence of dualism of freedom and rationality. It is imperative to combine China Kansei characteristics and quality to build light industry consumer goods with Chinese characteristics, meet and adapt to the needs of intertraditional trade change, maximize Chinese enterprise profit and create globally recognized quality grade.

articleTitle: Extenics method for implementation strategy of instant customerization
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The present article proposes an Extenics analysis Method for Instant Customerization(EMIC) to the existing problem that it's difficult to realize Instant Customerization(IC). Extenics model of IC is established firstly, diverging tree of feasibility problem for IC is proposed to study implementation strategies set, and then the conflicts between implementation strategies are solved. At last, EMIC studies the feasible implementation strategies set and IC is well realized. This article also studies extenics demand forcasting in detail. At the end of the article, an example is proposed to verify the correctness of EMIC.

articleTitle: Multi-objective shop scheduling scheme well-chosen decision making based on A-E method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Multi-objective shop scheduling optimization approach often presents the scheduling decision makers a set of Pareto solutions, which is hard to select the most satisfactory one from them. Therefore, a new method was put forward to select the best solution from the Pareto solutions. Firstly, a new weight-confirming method which contained subjective factors and objective factors was obtained by combining analytic hierarchy process and entropy theory (A-E). Then, the distance between ideal scheme and spare schemes was illuminated by Euclid norm as a standard to select the best scheme. Finally, the result testifies that using A-E method can make a right decision quickly which can help the decision-maker get the most satisfied solution from the set of Pareto solutions.

articleTitle: Empirical study on the effectiveness of engineering management tools: EVA and FGV
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: EVA and FGV are new tools for performance measurement and engineering management. The paper tests the value relevance of EVA, FGV and traditional performance measurements such as ROE, EPS, and CFOPS. Ohlson model, relative information content test and incremental information content test are used to do the work. The result of relative information test shows that FGV's relative information content is largest. It is more highly associated with corporate value than EVA, EPS, ROE, and CFOPS. Although EVA is also associated with corporate value, it is not as remarkable as EVA advocator's proposed. The result of incremental information test reveals that EVA and FGV all have significant incremental information content. It also suggests that EVA and FGV have significant incremental explanatory ability to corporate value. And FGV has more incremental explanation than EVA.

articleTitle: Using the group decision making matrix to evaluate RFID supplies
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Researchers of decision making have often shown that it is a complex process that a decision maker is quick and accurate at preferences structure or ordering when he was confronted multiple objectives, multiple criteria, and multiple alternatives. Before the enterprise shifts the operation to RFID, needs to carry on the simulation or the construction feasible deliberation and the appraisal first. In the simulation process, the enterprise may understand that what benefit in essence from RFID. Moreover the enterprise may also further estimate possible impact from the RFID. This study not only applies Multi-Criteria Decision Making with Incomplete Linguistic model (InlinPreRa) and uses horizontal, vertical and oblique pairwise comparison algorithms to construct but also expansion group decision making model. When the decision maker is carrying out the pairwise comparison, the following problems can be avoided: time pressure, lack of complete information, the decision maker is lack of this professional knowledge, or the information provided is unreal and thus it is difficult to obtain information. In this study uses group decision making Matrix to elevate the best RFID supply chain will carry effective and immediate for company. To conclude, this study may be importance in explaining the function of the InlinPreRa Model on decision making, as well as in providing decision makers with a better understanding of the process of the InlinPreRa Model.

articleTitle: Study on product development based on customization for manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies theory and the process of product development and design. According to the PDM system, it puts forward the product development platform frame based on customization. This production model not only could be satisfied with the individual needs of customer, but also keep product with the low cost and the short delivery time at same time. At the end, an application to the design of a metallurgy machine enterprise is shown.

articleTitle: Research on videophones' form based on kansei engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Taking the videophone for example, this study developed a process and method of product form perception based on customer preferences. This study proposed the process of product form perception evaluation scale which includes 17 appraisal words and 10 representative pictures by questionnaires, multidimensional scaling, and cluster analysis method. Then it established the relationship model between consumer preference and image words using multiple regression analysis and the relationship model between consumer preference and appearance design variables using conjoint analysis. These two models will support videophone product form designers during the design process and can also indicate other products designers with methods of meeting consumers' emotional demands.

articleTitle: Research on performance evaluation method of manufacturing system — Based on cash flow
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The performance analysis of manufacturing system originates from enterprise financial analysis, its purpose is to objectively analyze and evaluate the factors that can reflect the whole circumstance of the system by gathering all kinds of data in manufacturing system. This thesis mainly studies on the cash flow, which can reflect the managing and operating ability of modern manufacturing system, makes mapping between business indexes and manufacturing process indexes, builds evaluation model based on management accounting, which has the advantages of convenience, promptness and exactness. In the end, this thesis demonstrates the effectiveness of the model through example analysis.

articleTitle: Product configuration via negotiation for mass customization: An interactive goal programming approach
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the context of product customization, customers and manufacturers are often unable to accurately articulate need and solution information. This paper takes product configuration as a process of collaborative design and introduces negotiation as a new method to support interactive decision making. A general framework for negotiation-based configuration is developed based on negotiation analysis and the domain concept of axiomatic design. Product configuration is formulated as two interdependent goal programming problems between customers and manufacturers. An interactive problem solving procedure is also developed to implement the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Research on application of the differentiated service management — A case of a telecom corporation in a province
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Status and effect of the service have been increasingly exposed under the drastic situation of marketing competition. Nowadays, the telecom corporations may win in the smoking competition by putting the differentiated service (DiffServ) into practice because the deviations of telecommunication products become narrower and narrower, the promotion less and less innovation, the demand of customers more and more various and the requests for the telecom service higher and higher. In this paper, the effect of the differentiated service in practice has been described by analysis of the experience successful in a provincial telecom corporation, laying out the experience for reference for the similar corporations.

articleTitle: Study on application of value engineering on construction design
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: At present, our country construction technical level is low, management and construction career behind the vigorous development of variance exist. Meanwhile, adapt to the development of modernization needs the new progress of science and technology industry has not yet been fully formed. So strongly advocate application of value engineering in the construction industry. Construction enterprises need to improve product value and promote the value of traditional products innovation, foster and form the core of enterprise competitiveness, promote national economic and social sustainable development, both has long significance.

articleTitle: How to establish the textile clothing industry harm early warning system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To protect the home industry, it is stipulated by Foreign Trade Law of The People's Republic of China that harm early warning mechanism should be establish and international competitive power investigation should be carried out. As China is a big textile clothing exporter and also an importer, it is necessary that we establish the textile clothing industry harm early warning system to protect the industry. In the background that various countries have established the textile clothing industry harm early warning system in international trade, the author discusses the function of the textile clothing industry harm early warning system. The author also gives the steps and principle to establish the system, as well as the way to set up index system and estimate system.

articleTitle: Manufacturer's procurement decision considering correlation of default risk between suppliers
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyses the procurement decision of a manufacturer who deals with two correlated suppliers who may default on their obligations to deliver order quantities at the end of the production lead time. Distinguished from the most studies about the supply disruption management by establishing multiple sources of supplies, this paper especially studies the effect of the suppliers' correlation of default on the manufacturer's order policy and supply disruption risk and it also uses CVaR (conditional value at risk) as the measure of risk. We first obtain the formula for the order quantities, which indicates that the correlation of default is negatively related to the order quantities, while positively related to the manufacturer' CVaR. We then find the identical point where the manufacturer orders the same quantities from two different suppliers, and the decline of the correlation of default between the suppliers can still stimulate the manufacturer to order more.

articleTitle: Knowledge spillovers: Evidence from regional high-tech industries of China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper examines the effect of knowledge spillovers on regional industries' knowledge output. The function of knowledge is proposed and applied to a panel dataset of five industries in 30 provincial units from 1996 to 2005. The estimates show that interindustry knowledge in own region as well as intra and interindustry knowledge in other regions play significantly positive impact on regional industries' knowledge output. The sales of new products (NP) increased by 0.13%, other industries' R & D increased by 1% in this region; The number of patent application as dependent variable, inter-industry and intra-industry knowledge spillovers in other regions promote this industry' knowledge output, whose elasticity is 0.44 and 0.17 respectively. Interindustry knowledge spillover and own R&D effects complement each other in promoting productivity.

articleTitle: E-business workflow security architecture based on UCON
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the analysis of various access control models, an E-business workflow management system based on UCON is proposed. In order to achieve the security of access control, the UCONabc model, the RBAC access control model and the reference monitor are put into the workflow management system. For each access request, according to subject properties, roles, object properties, operation, obligation, as well as condition, the access control system makes judgments whether it has access permission or not. Before access, in access, or after access, the access control system renews the properties of the subject and the object for enhancing the robustness of the system greatly.

articleTitle: The research of united optimal operation aid decision system for cascade hydropower plants in local power network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The decision-making support system for optimal operation of cascaded hydropower plants in local electric power network, which includes system structure build up, and module design methods, is studied and designed in order to satisfy the demands of cascade hydropower plants optimal management in local electric power network. The system function include data management, hydrological forecast, long-time optimal operation planning, short-term optimal operation planning, and daily operation scheming. The system can provide decision support for optimal operation of small cascade hydropower plants in local power network. The system is applied in one local power network, and the results show that it is efficient.

articleTitle: Research on the strategy and implementation in stages of organizational learning based on TRIZ theory
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the limitation of organizational resources and the uncertainty of the results of organizational learning (OL), this article attempts to analyze the mechanism, strategy and implementation of OL by TRIZ theory. First of all, the core concepts of TRIZ theory are introduced and the reason for considering OL and TRIZ together is explained. Secondly, according to the models of the technology systematization of TRIZ theory, two strategies for OL are brought forward, which are gap strategy and options strategy. Thirdly, a grading model of OL implementation is proposed, which coincides with the model of increasing dynamics and controllability of TRIZ theory. Fourthly, the relationship between the core competitiveness and OL is well defined by the analysis method of substances - field. Finally, combined with outstanding OL practices, three effective modes of OL are discussed for different organizations according to TRIZ theory.

articleTitle: A study of real estate investment timing under asymmetric duopoly
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The optimal timing analysis of the land development is not only an important topic for real estate firms, but also the focus of the application of option-game theory. This paper constructs a continuous time option game model under asymmetrical duopoly by assuming that different competitive strengths exits between duopoly due to differentiated real estate products, and deduces the equilibrium strategies of asymmetrical duopoly. Thus, sequential strategy equilibrium or instantaneous strategy equilibrium is achieved. But which strategy the firm will employ depends on the different conditions of current demand shock level and the comparative competitive strengths between duopoly. This paper builds three distinctions compared to the models in previous researches. First, the asymmetry between two developers is shown in product quality, and then this paper constructs a differentiated duopoly price competition model. Besides, project value is calculates by a limited time periods cash flow model.

articleTitle: A fuzzy logic based decision support system to forecast the yield of Jatropha in cultivable wastelands
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The world economy runs on fossil fuels and the demand for it is increasing at an exponential level. This led to the quest for alternative sources of energy that can replace fossil fuel dependence. Bio-fuels are one such alternative for the international community. Production of bio-fuel from `Jatropha curcas' plant has received much attention in India. In this paper the bio-fuel generation from Jatropha Curcas by optimal usage of cultivable wastelands using fuzzy logic decision support system has been discussed. The uncertainty lies in the Jatropha seed production due to some uncontrolled parameters. ARIMA model have been used to capture the time series behavior of the data, to provide an adequate basis for optimizing the yield pattern of Jatropha using fuzzy logic and finding the cultivable wasteland for Jatropha in each and every district of Tamilnadu. Apart from collecting the Jatropha seeds and oil and storing them at a place can be a logistical hurdle in the supply chain network. This paper also aims at developing a decision support system to locate the optimum facilities within Tamil Nadu to store the Jatropha seeds and/or Jatropha oil produced and to distribute them to the next level of the supply chain.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis for a retail-cross-docking center
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Materials handling of a cross-docking center under retail distribution environment is complicated and labour intensive. Managers are usually under enormous pressure to optimize the staff shifts, inbound schedules and operating rules to minimize handling costs while ensuring just-in-time shipments. In this study, a discrete-event simulation model is developed to understand and validate the operation of a retail-cross-docking center. The simulation model is tested and validated at an actual retail-cross-docking center in order to confirm its effectiveness. Furthermore, the model is found to be both practical and powerful to provide critical support for logistics managers in management decision making at a cross-docking center.

articleTitle: Multi-stage order sequencing model and application of revised ACO algorithm in JIT manufacturing environment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Ant colony algorithm (ACA) is an intelligent optimization algorithm based on the behavior of ants seeking a shortest path between their colony and a source of food guided by their pheromone trails. Preliminary study indicates that it has superiority in solving complicated optimization problems. Order sequencing problem is a typical combinatorial optimization problem. This paper presents a model of order sequencing on multi-stage processing in JIT manufacturing environment and employs ACA to find the optimal solution for this model with detail algorithm steps. Testing the algorithm on experimental data, the paper validates its effectiveness on finding optimal solutions and its computational efficient as well.

articleTitle: Mixed-channel inventory policy between retailer and e-retailer stores in two-echelon supply chain
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we study a mixed-channel supply chain system which comprised by one manufacturer and one retailer. Customers can make purchases either from the retailer or directly from an e-tail store which is operated by the manufacturer. From the manufacturer's perspective, we study a Stackelberg inventory strategy to obtain the optimal inventory levels in retail and e-tail stores and the optimal wholesale price of manufacture. Managerial insights are provided to illustrate the applicability of the optimal strategies, the most important one is the manufacture can choose the optimal main channel based on the demand split proportion.

articleTitle: Research on service patent licensing risk under asymmetric information
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The existence of asymmetric information makes the process of the patent license become a game process among the participants. This article studies the moral risk which patentees will face when the licensed patent is service patent, puts the emphasis on the risking relations between the patentees and the inventors, designs an optimal incentive mechanism for the inventors using principal-agent theory, sets up a model, analyzes the impact imposed by risk attitude, inventor's effort cost and other factors on the model, draws some conclusions that the patentees cannot hold the more conservative attitudes towards the risk, and so on.

articleTitle: The construction study of quality cost evaluating system based on advanced manufacturing environment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Advanced manufacturing technology has not only the technology advanced facet but also the conceptuality advanced facet, according to this principle idea, the paper pointed out that quality cost must be re-identification under the concept of "reasonable quality". A relative perfect quality cost management evaluating system conformed to AME requirements must be constructed and quality cost evaluation index system has been designed in this paper.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis on the thermal performance of chilled ceiling panels using encapsulated phase change material
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A chilled ceiling panel using PCM is developed. Study has research on its thermal performance and analysis on heat transfer mechanism. Phase change process of PCM has three stages, solid Mushy and Liquid. Mathematic model is built for the cool room and simulation is made to evaluate the thermal performance. Contact thermal resistance and conduction shape factor are taken into consideration. Existence of air gap between PCM and aluminum plate largely decreases the heat conduction coefficient, which has great influence on the stability of the cool room temperature and phase change time. Heat load of conduction shape factor constitutes major part of total heat load. Simulation gives the high accuracy of trend of PCM ceiling thermal performance. When structure determined, refrigerant temperature Tin, environmental Ten, air velocity v have influence on performance of PCM ceiling, but the influence degrees are different, according to the single factor changing experiment and orthogonal design analysis for multi-factors influence which are taken.

articleTitle: Framework and strategies of management transformation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The worldwide financial crisis dramatically changed the global economy, and made the business environments for enterprises more severe. In this new environment, enterprise transformation, especially for the enterprise management transformation (EMT) is becoming more and more necessary not only for the companies with poor performance, but also for the good ones. Compared with the predecessors' researches, this article provides a systematic framework of EMT to formulate the superior enterprise. And the framework is comprised of lens model, key points and philosophy-strategy-operation (PSO) transformation model. The EMT framework acts as a unified model, and the PSO model provides constructive and optional strategies to conduct the various EMT for different enterprises.

articleTitle: A multi-variable measuring analysis on regional risks influencing project investment of enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: From the view-point of enterprise, project investment is the carrier achieving the strategic goal of enterprise. The bad performance of project investment necessarily causes the loss of enterprise economic profit and social profit, and the demoralization of staff, even to affect the total development strategy of enterprise. Then what factors will affect the result of project investment? How to measure these factors? The answer of these two problems will be the key to the exertion of project function, the enhancement of investment effect and the optimization of regional resource collocation. Based on a questionnaire survey by factor analysis, six main risk factors are extracted as effective measures on project investment effect. By multi-variable correlation analysis, the correlative relationship between the six risk factors and project investment effect is discussed and six variables are found critical in project investment effect. Finally, using one-way ANOVA, the level of critical factors influencing project investment effect are compared among Beijing, Shanghai, Xi'an, Guangzhou and Wuhan.

articleTitle: Independent pricing models of urban reused water
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Regarding to the blindness and arbitrariness in urban reused water pricing in China, this paper provided theoretical models and practical methods of independent pricing of reused water, based on the comprehensive considerations of market demand and production cost. Firstly, proceeding from the hypothesis that reused water can be used by consumers only when they can cut down expenses, an independent pricing model regardless of water quality difference was founded. On this basis, a pricing model allowing for water quality difference was founded by applying the utility function which contains quality preference parameters. Finally, the independent pricing methods were reviewed and some suggestions were put forward. The outcome of independent pricing is mainly determined by supplier's sufficient market research and operation plans. It can be applied to improve pricing efficiency.

articleTitle: Leveraging multi-core CPUs in the context of demand planning
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Over the last couple of years a paradigm shift in CPU development has been happening: away from increasing the clock rate towards increasing the numbers of cores per CPU. In order to leverage the resulting new architectures, nowadays business applications have to be rewritten or at least adapted. This paper describes the most characteristic operations in the context of demand planning which is a crucial part of supply chain management. Furthermore, it presents different strategies how those operations can be distributed onto several cores. The different strategies were prototypically implemented and measured on different systems (including Intel Core and Nehalem Microarchitecture) in order to determine their efficiency. The paper concludes with a comparison of the different strategies, identifies the most efficient one, and describes the potential performance gain in demand planning by leveraging multi-core CPUs.

articleTitle: Measurement of the financial risks and the early warning assess — Based on the sight of catastrophe model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper formulates a system, with strong alerting functions, of indices of assessing these risks. Defines the early warning borders of all kinds of indices and of all ranks of risks, and ranks the early warning of the financial risks. This paper constructs a catastrophe model of measurement and pre-warning of the financial risks according to the catastrophe theory. By using this theory and method, this paper quantifies and calculates the value of each subsidiary financial system and the degree of the financial risks.

Author Keywords: the indices system of early warning
the rank of the early warning system
the degree of the financial risks

articleTitle: Evaluation index system of resource integration capability for mid-small enterprises cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Resource integration is the principal source of competitiveness for the mid-small enterprises cluster and enterprises. In order to evaluate resource integration capability of mid-small enterprises cluster, the meaning of resource integration capability of mid-small enterprises cluster is presented from the two levels of strategic thinking and tactical choice in this paper, and the evaluation index system which affected the resource integration capability of mid-small enterprises cluster is studied from the breadth, depth, speed and openness. The results provide an important theoretical basis for further quantitative research.

articleTitle: Empirical research on modern mine of information and digital technology — Building integrated automatic network platform for Beizao mine
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: An integrated network platform for Beizao Mine of Longkou Mining Group which is formed by seas digital system and industrial ring Ethernet+fieldbus is analyzed. Based on this platform, "five major information systems" of Beizao Mine which are office automation system, production safety monitoring system, underground staff location system, seas industrial area television and gas detector attendance system are integrated in one network. Then these modern digital mining systems are analyzed including system structures, technical features, key system elements, layers, links etc. Innovations on this empirical research are concluded and clarified in the end. This is a new attempt and successful application of modern information and digital technology on complex management systems of coal mine.

articleTitle: Innovative metrics for machine performance measurement and their applications in semiconductor manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Reasonable metrics to measure machine performance are appropriate benchmarks for maintenance. The most popular machine performance metrics machine availability (MA) has been found that it is not suitable for all the situations. After scheduled downtime was excluded from the analysis, machine performance (MP) and machine failure (MF) were proposed. A case study demonstrates that the proposed two metrics can reflect the machine performance induced by machine self more accurately than MA. Correlation analysis validates the deduction that the difference between MF and 1-MA is less with the growth of the length of the selected period. MA was not denied in all areas because it can be used in catching the total available time of machine or catching the machine performance of a long time. The results of two applications (machine downtime control and performance measurement of preventative maintenance) show the proposed two metrics can work well to measure the machine performance.

articleTitle: Research on semiconductor wafer fabrication's hot lots problem
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper the hot lots problem on semiconductor wafer fabrication is studied. Corresponding mathematical model whose object is to minimize the total cost of produce and transport is made. The method based on Binary Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm is proposed to solve this problem. The detailed realization of the method is illustrated, and an example is presented, the simulation results compared to solved by lingo software proves that the BPSO method is effective and stable.

articleTitle: STEP integration of CAD/CAM & CAPP in numerical control machining
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In manufacturing, Numerical Control (NC) was a revolutionary innovation while the development and application of Computer Aided Design (CAD) and Computer Aided Manufacturing (CAM) has boosted manufacturing greatly. However, there have been "walls" between CAD/CAM and the workpiece processing on the shop floor. Fortunately, thanks to the international collaborative research projects, we now have the "standard for the exchange of product model data ", known as "STEP", which are industrial automation systems and integration product data representation and exchange. These systems are able to describe product data covering the entire lifecycle of a product, independent from any particular system. This description is of such nature as it is not only fit for neutral file exchange but also serves as a basis for executing and sharing product databases and archiving.

articleTitle: Modeling supplier selection and the use of individual advantage characteristics for high-quality supply chain design
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Without considering the individual advantage characteristic of different suppliers, the existing method of the supplier quality evaluation, and/or supplier selection, had mostly been used in the same scale with the idea of the "Uniform". This essay improved the existing method of the supplier quality evaluation, proposing a method based on individual advantage characteristic. According to the idea of goal programming and q-norm distance, weight coefficient was determined from the angle which is the most propitious to evaluated object. On the basis, an evaluation model based on individual advantage characteristic was constructed. The method proposed in this essay considered the individual advantage characteristic of different suppliers, which could lead the enterprises to identify the individual advantages of the different suppliers and choose the most suitable supplier for them for high-quality supply chain design.

articleTitle: Research on innovation performance of high-tech industries in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Evaluation on innovative performance of high-tech industry in China will help to find and solve problems in innovation system of high-tech industries, and improve the operating efficiency of the innovation system. Based on the four basic elements as the technology monopolization factor, human resources factor, market efficiency factor and social motivation factor, this paper defined the performance evaluation system of innovation performance that impacted on high-tech industry, and analyzed empirically innovation performance of more than 20 provinces and cities region in China with SPSS15.0 software. The results showed that some districts had a weak technological exclusivity, the low efficiency of markets, lack of social power and unreasonable structure of human resources. In order to promote the development of high-tech industries in every region, this paper proposed policy implications on high-tech industry innovation performance from the four basic elements.

articleTitle: Modeling and analyzing repairable safety-critical series-parallel system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The repairable safety-critical series-parallel system has working, fail-safe, and fail-dangerous states. This paper studies the repairable safety-critical series-parallel system by considering its component lifetime possessing general distribution. We first respectively derive the reliability and safety indices of the system including probabilities that the system in these states and mean times for the system under two different failure ways. And then the non-uniform aging model of the system is built, and two virtual age criterions are employed to study the expected repairs of the system during different aging stages of its whole operational cycle. Finally some illustrative examples are employed to show the procedures. These formulas are derived without considering component lifetime distribution assumptions, which have important meanings for improving the system reliability, safety, and maintenance.

articleTitle: Empirical research on the underpricing of initial public offerings in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In December 2004, the bookbuilding method was introduced in the Chinese IPO market and the PE ratio restriction was abolished. The purpose of the study is to examine whether the IPO shares after reform are priced efficiently so that the different levels of underpricing can be explained rationally by economic variables for information asymmetry theory. The result of the study revealed that only a small portion of the underpricing could be explained by the information asymmetry theory in either the pre or post liberalization periods. The possible reason is the pricing process of the unseasoned shares in China is still under the influence of the government authorities such as the equity division regulation and allocation restriction.

articleTitle: Construction and nonlinear dynamic analysis of nonlinear dynamic price model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A nonlinear dynamic price model considering the nonlinear factors between supply and demand was constructed in this paper. And the meanings of each parameters in the model were explained. By using nonlinear dynamic analysis, the system stability conditions were obtained from the analysis of the model. By numerical simulation of the model with MATLAB, the influence of different parameters on the system stability was obtained, in which the effect of different parameters on the system states was also considered.

articleTitle: Analysis of industry differences in information systems growth of enterprises in northeast old industrial base
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It collected and processed the history data of their information system construction through an investigation of 222 enterprises in northeast old industrial base, explored the industry differences in growth process of information systems of enterprises. By analysis, we found that there were differences in the time of starting to implement informatization and starting to build a LAN, development mode and application field of information system of different industries. At last we concluded the reasons caused the differences, proposed several useful countermeasures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Simulation and optimization of hull erection based on P-FTPN
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to enhance the hull erection efficiency and realize the supervisory control dynamically to construction course, this paper applies Fuzzy-timed place Petri net to simulate the process of hull erection. Triangular Fuzzy Number is utilized to denote the uncertain duration, and an advanced Minkowski subtraction is presented in the model. We eliminate the Hatch Coaming Sections, combine the Compartment Blocks, change the Orientation Double Bottom Block, simplify the complicated Bow Blocks and rearrange the erection scheme. Flow line erecting has been achieved and the efficiency of hull erection has heightened. The construction states can be identified immediately by establishing the Reachable Marking Graph of the erection model and calculating the existing time of markings. Then, the dynamic supervisory control to the hull erection process can be attained.

articleTitle: Saving-sharing contract of product-service system based on effort factor
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: On the premise of our effort dependent on resource saving in one-supplier one-custom system, the mathematical models of saving-sharing contract were established, and the impact of effort factor on system collaboration was analyzed. Through studies on pure saving-sharing contract, the reasons of difficulty in product-service system collaboration were explained. To deal with this problem, the saving-sharing contract based on channel rebate and penalty was proposed, the object of system collaboration was achieved. Also, a method of defining the optimal contract parameters was provided. Finally, a numerical example was given to illustrate the model and the solution process.

articleTitle: Research of evaluation index system of community commerce building
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Evaluation of community commerce building is fundamental to work out the strategy for the development of community commerce, guiding the business community to make healthy and coordinated development. This paper firstly introduces the significance and principles for establishing evaluation index system. According to the evaluation norms of the national model of community commerce, this paper further establishes evaluation index system of the commercial development level from different viewpoints in objective and subjective evaluation index. This study is not only beneficial to improve the building of community commerce, but also to effectively promote the quality of community services.

articleTitle: An efficient approach for shelf space planning and display area allocation in convenience stores
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper addresses the problems of shelf space planning and display area allocation in convenience stores. A genetic algorithm is developed to obtain optimum solutions for such problems. A store trial is performed to collect data for analysis and the effects of facing space and display location on product sales are studied. The proposed approach provides a practical and effective means of managing shelf spaces in retail stores.

articleTitle: Influence of information search cost on technology transfer based on multi-agent system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To establish cooperation between universities and enterprises is an important way to realize technology transfer. In reality there are many universities and enterprises, and the process of technology transfer is very complex. Thus it is difficult to resolve the multi-participant game problem through traditional economics method. Based on multi-agent system (MAS) thought and method, evolvement system, which consists of many self-determination and interaction agents, is set up to simulate the process of technology transfer from universities to enterprises. In the end of the paper, through a series of computational experimentations, conclusion is found that more choice chance and less information search cost are necessary conditions of technology transfer.

articleTitle: On the flexibile decision of safety input in Chinese coal enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Through setting up models, the coal enterprises' threshold of safety input is obtained with the real option approach. Further, the results shows: the coal enterprises' safety input are influenced by following aspects critically: the efficiency of safety technologies, the quantity of the input, the raise speed and the uncertainty of the safety technical efficiency, and the policy and monitor of government.

articleTitle: Study on relationships between innovation factors and profit
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper present development rule of high-tech industry on the view of relationship of innovation feature factors and profit with statistics data from National Bureau of Statistics by Dual-density Dependent model and Density Dependence Model. It was found that the R&D investment did not generate direct promotion for profit growth, new products development investment (NPDI) also showed a weak promotion for profit increasing, R&D investment and new products development investment promote to growth each other.

articleTitle: Design economics of product platforms for enterprise sustainability towards mass customization
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Being customer centric and producing only what customers really want are considered as a foremost means to increase both financial and economical sustainability for an enterprise. Developing multiple product variants based on product families sharing common platforms has been well recognized as an effective means to cater for product variety while maintaining mass production efficiencies. It provides an important input for increasing the sustainability of value creation along the entire enterprise value chain. Consistent with the options thinking, this paper outlines a research agenda of real option theoretic financial analysis models for product platforms by identifying product variety-related real options.

articleTitle: A multi-view modeling methodology for modular design based on relationship constraint network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As a systematic design method, modular design requires modeling techniques to prepare information structure for construction and evolution of product system, which generally include modeling for decomposition and that for specific design and family optimization. In this paper, a multi-view modeling methodology is proposed to prepare such an information structure based on relationship constraint network. Firstly, locations of modeling techniques are given according to the whole close-loop process of modular design, and framework of this method is given. Secondly, correlative information among elements is organized in the form of constraint network, and correlative information of product is organized into a tri-view model. Then, a tri-view model of product family is established based on modular layouts, which provides a two-way channel for decomposition and optimization of modular scheme. Finally, a case is presented to illustrate the application of the proposed approach, which proved the effectiveness of this approach.

articleTitle: The strategy of technology transfer: A dynamic analysis on standards, technology life cycle and international expansion
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As the key resource of a cluster or alliance rather than a single firm, technology resources can be configured with various ways to fit the need of competition or cooperation. Technology transfer is a main approach to implement firm's strategy, for it has the following functions: positive influences to the technology standards setting; positive influences to the technology standards expansion; positive influences to the technology life cycle; positive influences to the technology standards expansion in new markets; positive influences to the technology life cycle in multi-markets. Technology standard setting is also important, for it has positive relationship with the technology life cycle in multi-markets. The paper has two contributions: first, making the technology transfer analysis with international expansion from firm level; second, discussing the result with RBT from a view of cluster.

articleTitle: Quality costing: An efficient tool for quality improvement measurement
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Sound economy and assured profitability of an organization entirely depend upon effective control of non-quality costs generated in the organization. Through simple economic model with parato and cause effect analysis of different elements of quality costs, e.g. prevention, Appraisal costs conformance costs and internal and external failure costs - non conformance costs, total quality costs can be controlled resulting considerable savings. This paper discusses how quality has an impact on the costs of goods and services in an organization and "return on investment (ROI)" is linked with "return on quality (ROQ)".

articleTitle: The empirical studies on industry lifecycle, knowledge spillover and regional industry agglomeration
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The research of LiangQi (2004) showed that there are certain differences between the labor intensive industry and the technology intensive industry regarding their agglomeration level and alteration characteristics. This paper did a further research about this phenomenon. The empirical studies based on Chinese provincial statistics (1986-2006) indicates that along with the change and development of industry lifecycle, the type of regional knowledge spillover will turn from JACOB into MAR, because industries of different lifecycle have different dynamic knowledge spillover types. The industry agglomeration will change accordingly with the different development environment of these two outer requests.

articleTitle: Exploratory experimental research on incentive-control mechanism of R&D personnel in technological enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper examines the technology enterprise. After the literature review, key motivation choices are listed out, namely training and development, authorization of innovation, promotion, involvement in management, which are optional incentives relevant to personal capability, as well as improvement of R&D working environment. The R&D personnel incentive-control mechanism is proposed based on the principal-agent relationship. Six groups, including MBA students, R&D personnel were selected as experimental subjects and corresponding experimental studies were performed after careful designing. The paper presents explorative discussion on the effectiveness and efficiency of two incentive-control mechanisms - trust and incentive- and has proposed a series of useful conclusions. In regard to effects and benefits, the experiment suggests that the trust incentive control method can achieve the win-win result under the unremitting learning condition.

articleTitle: Construction and analysis of balance model on supply and demand in pharmaceutical market before and after the separation of pharmacies from hospitals
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In China, it is more and more difficult and expensive to see a doctor. One of the deep reasons goes to the situation that the hospitals and medicine are bound together and that medicine is supplemental to support the hospitals. This article sets forth a brief and direct balance model on supply and demand in pharmaceutical market and analyses the policy of separation of pharmacies from hospitals on Micro-Economics. The construction of the models and analysis has provided a new solution to solve the problem of fostering hospitals with medicine and to implement the separation of hospitals and medicine.
