publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: advanced decision analysis; e-business process; knowledge management; engineering economy; cost analysis; global collaboration; global information system integration; information management; product lifecycle management; manufacturing systems; operations research; production planning; production control; quality control; quality management; reliability engineering; maintenance engineering; risk management; service management; supply chain management; systems modeling; and technology management.

articleTitle: The MAS-based information model of Eco-industrial system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the main features of eco-industrial system, divided it into four core subjects. Introduced an agent's architecture suit for open environment, abstracted four agents for the core subjects. Build a MAS-based information model with four agents to simulate the operation of eco-industrial system. Reflect the intrinsic mechanism and the dynamic evolution of eco-industrial system through the model. On the basis of the model, analyzed the eco-industrial park, provided support for the promotion of eco-industrial.

articleTitle: The application of fuzzy-real option theory in BOT project investment decision-making
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Real option method can overcome the limitations of the traditional NPV method. This paper first analyzed the embedded real option feature in the BOT infrastructure projects and proved the applicability of real option theory. However, the existing evaluation method of the real options assumes that the present value of expected cash flows and investment costs is certainty numbers, which is unconvincing due to the high degree of uncertainty in actual projects. Thus, in response to this drawback of the hypothesis, this article assume that the present value of expected cash flow, investment costs and risk-free interest rate are the fuzzy numbers, and by making improvement to the B-S pricing model, established the fuzzy-real options evaluation model, and then gives a case study to verify the validity of the model. On this basis the real option method is introduced into project evaluation and investment decision-making in the BOT project feasibility study.

articleTitle: Study on the main factors that affect the core competence of coal group
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: There are certain main factors that affect the core competence of group companies and the main factors replacing one another at different times. This paper, which is based on the system dynamics theory, focuses on the main factors that affect the core competition of the coal group, and it puts forward several typical modes of the main factors, and provides relevant suggestions on how to cultivate core competition as well.

articleTitle: Study on house affordability of urban households in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As theory suggested, urban residents' income should maintain a stable ratio with house price. The recent years, however, the growth of house price is much higher than the growth of income in China, resulting in house affordability problem. This paper, based on China's quarterly time-series data from 1994 to 2006 and applying methods of co-integration test, Granger causality test and error correction model (ECM), makes an empirical analysis of the long-run equilibrium relationship between house price and income. It is shown from the results of the empirical analysis that there is the evidence of long-run equilibrium relationship, meaning that the deviation of these two series could be temporary.

articleTitle: Discussing the requirements and influences on access to information resource in virtual management of business enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Information resource, a kind of special resource which can be characterized as indivisible and reusable, is an important main factor of business operation. The information price has particular formation law: it is not only affected by the cost but also related to the effectiveness for utility and effectiveness for a given period of time. The difficulty level and bafflement size encountered in the process of access to information resource along with the cost size devoted influence what kind of organization and operating modes will be selected to a large extent; conversely, the organization and operating modes influence the difficulty level, bafflement size, and cost size. Virtual management is a sort of operating mode used to improve the competitive power, optimize the resource configuration, and advance the level for market to meet an emergency. The more developed information technology and the less cost of it, the more help to employ virtual management; on the other hand, the implement of virtual management will help to weaken or reduce various information access obstacles and lower the cost.

articleTitle: Effect of deformation on grain size distribution in process of rolling circle for heavy forgings
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The hot compression experiments of roller steel Cr5 were carried out on Gleeble-3500 thermo-simulation machine to research on the effect of deformation on grain size distribution. And finite element models of compression processes were built to acquire the strain distributions in the deformed samples. The microstructures observed by metalloscope show that fine grain sizes were obtained in central regions of the samples due to recrystallization. But coarse grain occurred in the critical strain zones determined by FE simulation. The results prove that FE method can be used to predict the location of coarse grain due to critical deformation of steel Cr5. So, the procedures of rolling circle for large shaft-parts with flat anvil were made and the corresponding FE models of rolling circle processes were established. The FE simulation results indicate that the technology of rolling circle with flat anvil can avoid generating coarse grain caused by critical deformation.

articleTitle: Abnormal state detection of production system based on the support vector data description
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Abnormal state detection is very helpful for managers to find production system's uncommon conditions timely, it can greatly reduce potential loss and increase the enterprise's economic profits. To improve the work quality, this thesis puts forward an abnormal state detection model; the model is based on the theory of support vector data description. Firstly the production system's evaluation indexes are defined, and the thesis points out that for different types of production system, the indexes may be quite different. Secondly, the relative abnormal state detection model is built, and then, the thesis briefs the basic theory of support vector data description. Thirdly, the production system's abnormal state detection model is built and verified by an experiment. The result of the experiment shows that the model proposed by the thesis is effective and helpful.

articleTitle: Study on mark-up rate decision model based on RBF neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aiming at the characteristics of mark-up decision, 18 main factors which influenced the mark-up rate were defined based on previous experiences and research results to build index system of the mark-up rate decision model. Then RBF neural network model was used for markup rate decision in bidding and pricing with MATLAB neural network toolbox.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of capacity for sustainable development of middle-aged resource-based cities in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper raised a new concept for determining the capacity for sustainable development of middle-aged resource-based cities and constructed a synthetic evaluation system to assess the sustainable development of middle-aged resource-based cities. Principle components analysis is adopted to analyze the capacity for sustainable development of Panjin City and to compare it with seven similar resource-based cities. The results show that the factors of economical and social development, resource abundance, foreign trade and living environment quality have a strong positive correlativity. The investments to education and construction of an infrastructure of Panjin City were shown to need gradual improvement. Moreover, the promotion of optimization and upgrading of industrial structure in resource-based cities should base on the characteristics of resources and regional economy, meanwhile, resource-based cities should develop clean energy and improve investment environment.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of price system based on stochastic model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Price system was analyzed by a nonlinear stochastic dynamic model with the supply and demand factors. This model converged to a process in probability. Then the stability of the system was analyzed by the result of drift coefficient and diffusion coefficient of the process. Numerical simulation results of the stationary probability density with different conditions were shown. It can be concluded that the stability of the system varied as the parameters varied. Finally, the influence of parameters on the stochastic bifurcation was analyzed.

articleTitle: Theory of assembly buffer for line balancing problem
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Line balancing problem is the bottleneck of flow production. How to adjust the line to decrease the pressure of bottleneck workstations and reduce the mistake rate is the frequent focus in production. In the paper, Theory of Assembly Buffer (TAB) is put forward to design rhythm of assembly lines, and worker's tension degree model is built. Dynamic and multi-time rhythm adjustment of line balancing is achieved. The instance application proves that the methods put forward can effectively eliminate the negative impacts of bottleneck operation on the stability of successive flow among workstations.

articleTitle: Status of Indian women entrepreneurship in context to liberalization, privatization and globalization
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This is entrepreneurs era, as government sectors are turning in to private sectors, it is the right time to enter into market as entrepreneurs. Currently, India has the best global talent, which is now required technical and knowledge skills to take on the entrepreneurial challenges [1]. Today, India is witnessing the emergence of a large number of entrepreneurs, but there is definitely potential for many more. The contribution of Indian women to the economy is no longer in doubt, but their contribution to the National Economy is under reported. In recent years, women have been taking interest in income generating activities, self employment and entrepreneurship. To encourage the entrepreneurships with climate in India we require more support from the government and society. Today huge number of young people is hungry to learn more about entrepreneurship-the key is to combine that passion with the knowledge that skills that will help them be more successful. Cost of living for an average middle class family is increasing their needs and demands of family members also enhanced depending on world scenario. Everybody wants to lead comfortable life. To balance the socio-economic status to cope with day today demands of the family more number of women is pushing in to the market as entrepreneurs. More and more innovative enterprises are open to fresh entrepreneurs. Our aim is to study impacts of education on women entrepreneur and how polytechnics (technical institutions) and job oriented courses curriculum can aid their strengths. This paper is the result of survey of women entrepreneurs from surrounding area of Bagalkot (Karnataka, India). we have prepared questionnaire and analysed the results got from the women entrepreneurs. This paper enlights on women entrepreneurship status, development, challenges, opportunities etc.

articleTitle: Study on information platform of technical standards based on B/S
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper focuses on resolving difficulties in finding technical standards by hand in a manufacturing enterprise in western of China. Through used information technology, carried out requirement analysis, and used modular design, information platform of technical standards is developed and put into practice in enterprises. Application of system is helpful for resolving problems of standard finding, realizes centralized management of standards such as international, national, industrial and enterprise standards, lays a solid foundation for collaborative design and manufacturing within enterprises, improves work efficiency and achieves sharing resources of technical standards.

articleTitle: A constraint satisfaction approach to coordinating multi-site manufacturing supply chains
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The dispersed manufacturing environment entails the coordination of product, process, and supply chain (PPSC) decisions. This paper formulates PPSC coordination as a constraint satisfaction problem (CSP) involving product fulfillment knowledge of multiple domains. Based on a domain-based reference model, the multi-site manufacturing supply chain is constructed, considering network structures, product characteristics, decision variables, along with various constraints. A decision propagation structure (DPS) is developed based on the concept of constraint heuristic search to facilitate the exploration of solution spaces. A case study of truck manufacture in a multi-national company is presented to illustrate the framework for PPSC coordination.

articleTitle: Research on reverse logistics-oriented multisources inventory control model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To improve enterprise inventory control strategy and optimize control parameters of inventory including external and interior reverse logistics, through applying periods' inventory checking strategy, a multi-sources inventory control model helpful to simulate the real logistics operations was proposed. Based on the arrival time of returned products following Poisson distribution, the returns production with lot-size processing method and the nonzero lead time of manufacturing/remanufacturing, a rational cost function of inventory control was established. Then the genetic algorithm was used to solve the inventory cost function so as to obtain the optimum solution of inventory checking periods, safe inventory point, production lot-sizes and processing lot-sizes of returns production. An example was presented to prove the feasibility and validity of the proposed method, and the proposed model can help the enterprises to implement multisources inventory control strategy.

articleTitle: Carbon reduction costs analysis in China power industry
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A study was conducted to compare the electricity generation costs of fossil fuel plants, hydro plants, nuclear plants and a number of current commercial technologies expected to become commercially available within the coming decade or so in China. The amount of greenhouse gas emissions resulting per Kwh of electricity generated was evaluated. The objectives were to estimated the costs increase in different scenarios based various carbon reduction goals, and to suggest some potential economical routines for Chinese carbon reduction.

articleTitle: A research of valuation based on EVA and fuzzy option
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Both EVA and the real option models have their own advantages. If we only use one of these two models, usually we can not consider exactly the value based on the cost of equity, or underestimate the potential value which the investment brings to the enterprise. This paper attempts to construct an evaluation method that unifies EVA and the fuzzy real options to the enterprise value evaluation, regarding the enterprise value as a sum of two parts: the value of profit ability based on the existing foundation and the value of potential profit opportunity. In the end, we verify the rationality of the method through a computation example.

articleTitle: Research on logistics development strategy for own brand automobile manufacturing enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, on the base of SWOT analysis, whole strategy plan of the enterprise and sustainable development strategy, development strategy model frame of the enterprise logistics of FCC was established, enterprise logistics development strategies which are adjusted to the characteristics of the enterprise itself were put forward combined management experience of advanced enterprises and the enterprise own experience of exploring and applying of lean logistics,.

articleTitle: Resource-based city's industry developing efficiency evaluation based on BE-DEA model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Resource-based cities have to optimize their industry structures to fulfill sustainable development. During this procedure, they should supervise the developing efficiency of those dominant industries, it helps to judge whether the structure adjustment is on the right way. The beyond-efficiency DEA (BE-DEA)model is perfect to such evaluation, it can trace the dynamic efficiency, avoid the passiveness and waste of afterward evaluation. This paper applies this BE-DEA model to an oil resource city, evaluates its dominant industries' developing efficiency both horizontal and vertical. The result offers quantitative proof to adjust the target or policy, and demonstrates BE-DEA model's superiority.

articleTitle: Managing globally distributed engineering teams: A case study on virtual industrial engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Globally distributed engineering teams face particular challenges regarding collaboration and communication. Spatial, temporal and cultural distances force a virtual cooperation that must adequately enable idea mediation and decision making within engineering teams. Thus, the engineering management plays a central role and therefore has to react to support and govern those teams. On this perspective, this contribution shares fundamental insights, results, challenges, and implications derived from a nine-month engineering project between students from Stanford University and Hasso Plattner Institute, their focus user group, and their client principal-a leading German engineering enterprise conglomerate.

articleTitle: Research on the aged coal mine identification and coal mine lifecycle system simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It gave the conception and meanings of the aged coal mine by summing up related names of the aged coal mine. In order to set up the criteria for a coal mine, it chose mine remaining service life as identification standard to identify whether a coal mine is aged or not on the basis of correlation analysis between many influence factors. By using the cluster analysis method it determines the remaining service life criteria for the aged coal mine, large and medium-size coal mine 10 a, small-size 5 a. Then it put forward a System Dynamic model for a coal mine lifecycle employing identification standard and influence factors of the aged coal mine, proved correctly and effectively by fitting test of historical data. The model can simulate a coal mine lifecycle and reappear the past action characteristics, judging turning point and predicting remaining service life of a mine.

articleTitle: The context and innovation performance in external knowledge network: An empirical study in software industry of China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper makes a study of how the knowledge network context contributes to the innovation performance of the firms in the network, and further establishes a regression analysis model, which takes objective, trust, communication, rules and risk control as independent variables and the firm's technological innovation performance as the dependent variable. Based on first-hand data of 74 software companies in China, the analysis shows that communication and risk control exert significant positive effects on the firm's technological innovation performance. The paper further explores, through regression analysis, the relations and effects among independent variables, finding that the maturity of rules have remarkable positive effects on the risk control of knowledge network, and that trust and rules have notable positive effects on communication effectiveness.

articleTitle: Study on modeling method of statistical distribution of wearing lifetime for mechanical parts
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Current modeling methods are almost set up on the basis of wearing loss distribution, and they are more suitable for that wearing loss data is systematic and complete, such as the original data is from friction and wearing test under strict controlled conditions. A new method has been presented which is based on mean wearing rate (MWR) distribution. The basic modeling processes are: (1) Set up the distribution function of MWR. (2)Get lots of lifetime samples through Monte Carlo digital simulation of lifetime. (3)Identify the lifetime distribution by Kolmogorov hypothesis testing. (4)Estimate lifetime characteristics. It can be applied to both complete and incomplete data efficiently.

articleTitle: Asymptotic optimality of freight booking control problem for the rail container carrier
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we consider the freight booking control problem for the rail container carrier. The problem is formulated as a stochastic optimization problem to set freight booking limits for maximizing the total revenue generated by all accepted bookings. We derive the fluid limit of the problem under the optimal booking control policy.

articleTitle: A cost analysis method on location planning for logistics distribution network system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A cost analysis method on location planning for logistics distribution network systems has been proposed in this paper. The whole network system has been divided into two components, one is the cost analysis of the terminals within the networks; the other is that of the distribution routes connecting the terminals. A general total cost model which includes all terminal cost and distribution transportation cost has been expressed by approximation modeling method. Finally, the simulation experiments and the comparisons have been proved the method effectiveness.

articleTitle: A study on reinvestment of technology business incubator based on grey control model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: During the development, technology business incubator faces the problem that reinvestment is insufficient so it needs to reinvest the suitable proportion of the earnings in the the hardware and software to achieve its sustainable development. Grey system theory is a effective method for studying problem of uncertainty with fewer data points and poor information. In this paper, we try to discuss the application of grey control theory in grey system quantification model. According to GM models, we deri¿vate a close feedback system, and simulate study by some variances. From an illustration the study finds the reinvestment by 70.02 pernent of the earnings in the business incubator to cause its sustainable development. The empirical analysis has indicated that the grey control theory can be used for the optimization of business incubator's reinvestment and some key parameters are obtained for the practice of the business incubator.

articleTitle: Study on hierarchical production planning for single machine systems
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A two-tiered hierarchical production planning model with sequence-independent family setup time, including aggregate production planning (APP) and family disaggregation planning (FDP), is proposed in this paper for a multi-product, single machine production system. In APP, the constraints about inventory, backorder and regular time are revised according to practical situation; and in FDP, the resulted APP in the first period is decomposed into detailed lot sizing plan for each product family in each sub-period and is guaranteed for completion. Two types of feedback information are adopted to adjust the aggregate plan at different stages of a period. The performance of the model is validated with data from an enterprise.

articleTitle: Effects of local standard development on local economic development
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Standardization plays a very important role in global industrialization. In order to explore the role of regional standards in economic development and to clarify the importance of the regional standards, it is necessary to study the relationship between the development of regional standards and the quality of local economic growth. Taking Heilongjiang Province of China as the case study, the following aspects regarding the objective of this issue was carried out based on a significant analysis of surveys and literature reviews. Firstly, a study of the quality evaluation index system of local standards development was conducted. Using questionnaires, first-hand data was collected from employees working in standards field. The quality index of local standards development, which was created based on yearly development data, was employed to appraise the various standards. Secondly, a study of the quality evaluation index system of the economic growth in Heilongjiang Province was carried out after the establishment of the evaluation index system for regional economic development using Principal Component Analysis (PCA). Finally, the relationship between the quality index of local standards development and the quality evaluation index system of the economic growth in Heilongjiang Province was obtained using the regression method. The r results showed that the quality index of the local standards in Heilongjiang Province was proportional to the quality of local economic growth both in quantity and quality aspects.

articleTitle: Supply chain alliance profits allocation based on balanced constant
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As a new model of enterprises business cooperation, fair and reasonable mechanism of profit allocation relates to the success or fair of the supply chain alliance. This paper applied symbiosis theory and conception into supply chain alliance which is a man-made symbiotic system, combined with Material and Energy Transformation Law, Quality Action Law, Energy Conservation Law and Henry Louis Lechatelier Balanced Reaction Principle, introduced the concept of balanced constant to analyze supply chain alliance profit allocation, integrated the impact of risks and resources on the alliance profit allocation, established supply chain alliance profit allocation mechanism from a new perspective, provided a reliable reference method for the efficient and effective operation of alliance to cope with vigorous market competition.

articleTitle: A research on development path of China's low-tech manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper suggests a model on the development path and innovation strategies of low-tech manufacturing based on factors' comparative advantage and business's market openness, discussing the four possible paths as well as each path's necessary conditions, innovation strategies, enable policies and supportable measures. Also, it analyses what path China's low-tech manufacturing would choose for future development and innovation, and puts forward some recommendations.

articleTitle: The knowledge management frame construction research in collaborative supply chain
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we investigate the concept of the enterprise collaborative knowledge management on the basis of both the realistic and the technological perspectives. We define the knowledge management contents, analyze the strategic aims and its 4 elements, and discuss the common policies for enterprises to implement collaborative knowledge management. And finally, we put forward the implementation process and the guarantee mechanism of the enterprise collaborative knowledge management.

articleTitle: Research of market concentration of international container shipping based on CRm: An illustrative example from China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In a variety of modes of transport, the container transport not only occupies an increasingly important position in the international transport system, but also plays an important role in regional economic, trade and logistics development with its own superiority. Although it is nearly 20 years later than the world beginning when China started its container transportation, with an average annual increase of 35% in this industry, China has been as the first ranking of the world for five years already. The fleet capacity of COSCO and China shipping container are ranking into the world's top 10, and the throughputs of six China mainland container ports like Shanghai and Shenzhen are listed into the world's top 20. Meanwhile, the containerization of China container port has achieved international advanced level. China's container transportation not only has been a strong support for the development of the national economy and foreign trade, but also has played an important role on the growth of the global economy.

articleTitle: Model of evaluation for quick response ability of clothing enterprise based on supply chain
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the development of market competitions, the cycle of products is shortening, customers have higher expectation for products and service, especially clothing which is fashionable and seasonal. Evaluation for Quick Response Ability (QRA) of clothing enterprise is significant. First, the basic theories of QR are summarized, the present problem and status is analyzed. Then the paper sets up the evaluation system for QRA of clothing enterprise based on supply chain, from three parts: time, cost, satisfaction, And determines the weight of Indicator system in use of Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) method. At last, the paper evaluates QRA by Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation (FCE). With the example of enterprise M's implement of Quick Response, the result shows the effectivity and feasibility of evaluation system for QRA of clothing enterprise based on supply chain.

articleTitle: The e-commerce entrepreneurs' professional knowledge in the service industry
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The study aims to explore the electronic commerce entrepreneurs' professional knowledge in the service industry of the Taiwan area. To achieve this goal, the study uses interviews, panel discussions and Mental Mapping to confirm entrepreneurs' professional knowledge. In addition, the study utilizes transformation of knowledge and ability to select representative knowledge items and to confirm the professional knowledge structure of entrepreneurs through mental mapping. Entrepreneurs in electronic commerce times should have these ten categories, totaling 90 items, such as essential professional knowledge item; that is, entrepreneur and entrepreneur's opportunity, marketing, economics, finance, accounting, management, global market, legal and business planning, in order to cultivate entrepreneurs' abilities of e-commerce effectively. Core professional knowledge of electronic commerce entrepreneurs should total 45 items including marketing ability, management ability, information ability, entrepreneurs and entrepreneurial opportunities and so on.

articleTitle: A study of knowledge management in the enterprise R&D process
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Knowledge exists extensively in enterprise R&D process. It has a significant theoretical value to study the issue of knowledge management in R&D process. The characters of knowledge management in R&D process are analyzed, and then, R&D process, its knowledge activities and knowledge types are discussed; finally, a conceptual model of knowledge management system in R&D process is constructed from three dimensions for some corresponding evaluations in the paper.

articleTitle: Study on the quality control and management system of engine assembling process
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper expatiates the selection of key points of quality control on the final assembling line of automobile engine, and the corresponding quality checking techniques and measures; establishes the quality control and management system (QCMS) in accordance with the principle of statistical process control (SPC), and finally investigates the functional realization of QCMS.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the relationship between corporate culture and BPR in Chinese enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to explore effective ways to improve the performance and ensure the success of BPR, the paper puts forward a conceptual model and 4 hypotheses describing the relationship between corporate culture and BPR. Factor analysis, correlation analysis, multiple linear regression, canonical correlation analysis and one-way ANOVA are as well as the SPSS13.0 statistical software is used to test the hypotheses. The relationship between BPR and corporate culture is concretely revealed; it preliminarily explored how contextual factors (for example, the size of the enterprise and who owns the enterprise) influence role which corporate culture plays in BPR. The result showed that four factors of corporate culture play a positive role in the success of BPR, various factors influence BPR differently, and there was a significant difference in the depth of implementing BPR among enterprises of different sizes.

articleTitle: Application of cyclic spectral analysis to gear crack assessment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With regards to the cyclostationarity of gear vibration, a novel indicator based on cyclic spectral analysis is proposed to assess localized gear damage. The cyclic spectral density of amplitude modulation and frequency modulation signals is deduced, and its properties in joint cyclic frequency-frequency domain are summarized. The ratio between the sum of cyclic spectral density magnitude along frequency axis at the cyclic frequencies of modulating frequency and 0 Hz indicates the amplitude modulation magnitude. In the analysis of gear crack simulation vibration signals, the ratio shows a monotonically increasing trend with the development of the gear crack level. It has potential to assess gearbox damage.

articleTitle: Study on monitor sorting and recovery based on fuzzy clustering
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the rapid development of electronics and information industries, waste monitors increases stridently, so it's urgent to solve the problem of sorting and recycling these waste monitors. This paper researches the fuzzy clustering method which is suitable to recycling monitors, expounds the procedures in details, and applies the method to solve reality instance. Through the case analyses, this fuzzy method proves to be effective in monitor sorting and recovery problem.

articleTitle: Study on supply chain partnership selection based on grey matter element method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to win in the competition, many enterprises adopt supply chain model to participate in market competition. Good coordination and cooperation between supply chain partners is the guarantee of enterprise to win in the competition. Benefit brought about by supply chain cooperation is taken seriously gradually. But how to choose a good supply chain strategy partner is an important issue facing enterprises. This paper analyzes the assessment factors to select supply chain partners and uses gray matter-element method to study the choice problem of enterprise supply chain partners. A calculation is made to describe the gray matter-element analysis method application in partner selection.

articleTitle: Controlled natural language for information integration
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The acquisition of knowledge is an important factor for enterprises to stay in competition. In this context, especially the integration of structured and unstructured data is a vital task and has been subject to research for many years. Opposed to other integration strategies, we propose an architecture that relies on first-order logic as a semantical foundation. Using a controlled natural language, which is a first-order logic equivalent subset of natural language, further enables the user to be involved in the process of information integration and thus creates the essential transparency.

articleTitle: Reasoning mechanism of HD diagnose system based on intelligent fusion algorithm
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To make patients with HD (Heart Disease) achieve standardized treatment at the same level in different medical institutions, the gap of medical quality and efficiency caused by the asymmetry of medical information and knowledge should be closed. The reasoning model based on four-layer-behavior-and-two-class-reasoning-mechanism was architected. The reasoning algorithm mixing RS (Rough Set) and PNN (Probabilistic Neural Network) was adopted to architect the heart disease intelligent diagnose system assisting the HD diagnose decision. Results of experiment shows that with the HD diagnose system mixing the RS and PNN the time to train samples was shortened and the ability to classify and generalized samples was heightened.

articleTitle: Study on the design of port logistics information platform
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to interconnect different logistics information platforms, based on the theories of vertical integration and horizontal integration principles of supply chain management, port logistics information platform model is designed. The regional, integrated and comprehensive platform include the foundation layer and the application layer which composed of professional logistics system, expanding logistics system, E-port and E-Government system, Financial service system, Coordination / value-added services provider system and the co-operation interface among different ports.

articleTitle: Professional credit guarantee principle-agent relationship model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By using the allocation of guarantee rate saving as incentive mechanism and considering the external supervision mechanism in credit guarantee contract, the principal-agent relationships between professional credit guarantee institution and small and medium sized enterprise (SME) is investigated in this paper. It has been proved that external supervision mechanism could not change the optimal effort level of SME under the symmetric information, while, the professional guarantee institution by using effective external supervision mechanism under the asymmetric information could make SME choose higher effort level and increase the incentive strength of guarantee institution. With the external supervision being reinforced by professional credit guarantee institution, the incentive strength is much stronger and expected revenue is much higher, while, the agent cost is less. Suitable and effective external supervision can decrease the total guarantee cost of professional credit guarantee institution.

articleTitle: The research on network systems of quality control in construction stage
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The quality control in construction stage is the focus of quality control of the project, and is the most important stage. In this paper, the construction process of project is divided in accordance with the content and nature of construction projects. According to common quality defects and the importance of the project, the quality control points in the various parts of the construction content are founded. And on the basis of construction norms and preventive measures to establish appropriate quality control network system, with a view to the formation of the corresponding software, aiming to provide system planning and control for the quality control process.

articleTitle: Analysis of the building energy efficiency market based on asymmetric game
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This comprehensive empirical analysis of the building energy efficiency market employs an approach of asymmetric game, from which some suggestions to the Government are put forward. In the last decade China has been increased interest in the provision of energy services that has also been driven by electricity and gas restructuring. In the year 1997, three pilot energy service companies (ESCOs) established in China. Based on the bounded rationality of players, an asymmetric game between the building owners and the energy service companies (ESCOs) is discussed in the domain of energy efficiency in buildings. The game model is built with the characteristics of imitator dynamic model, which comes to the conclusion that the final results basically depend on the initial conditions. Based on the review and analysis, we suggest the government to consider the characteristics in policy making.

articleTitle: Analysis on influence effect of knowledge worker-information system interactive efficiency
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To explore influence effect of key factors on knowledge worker-information system interactive efficiency within knowledge-intensive organization, propose a research model that key factors affect interactive efficiency through task-human-information system match. To apply structure equation modeling approach to solve the research model, the results show: influence of behavior-oriented psychology, work resource environment and performance of information system on interactive satisfaction perceive are greater, their total influence effect values are 0.579, 0.338 and 0.176 in turn; influence of work resource environment on result validity perceive is greater, its total influence effect value is 0.376, but influence effect of performance of information system, behavior-oriented psychology, cognition operation ability on result validity perceive are almost quite, their total influence effect value are all below 0.15. Influence of work resource environment, behavior-oriented psychology, cognition operation ability and information share on interactive time perceive are greater, their total influence effect value is 0.304, 0.237, 0.194 and 0.117 in turn.

articleTitle: Go beyond the minimum compliance: An environmental administration approach on corporate eco-efficiency assessment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The increasing environmental concerns from a broader range of corporate stakeholders and the severe environmental deterioration require more practical and effective assessment tools developed for the environmental administrators to facilitate the corporations move beyond the mere compliance to the environmental legislations. This paper proposed the application of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) to the assessment of corporate eco-efficiency. The method of DEA was introduced and the discussion on its application on eco-efficiency assessment was provided. A case study was implemented and the results indicated that the method of DEA applied with a set of appropriate eco-efficiency indicators may provide uniform base for the comparison of eco-efficiency across the corporations.

articleTitle: Study on the collecting mode of mineral resource tax and compensation fee
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to suggest a direction of collecting mode of mineral resources tax and compensation through literature review. Methods of documentation and induction were employed. The results show that, resources tax does not reflect the original intention, should not generally charge, fixed amount of resources tax leads to damage to national property rights. As to compensation, it levies based on the mineral resources price, leading to it does not reflect the compensation on resources used. Compensation rate is low. It is concluded that, the author proposed merger of resources tax and resources compensation for the resources compensation, and implementation of the collection mode of combining to base on amount and base on price. Overall, the compensation rate should be increased. Mineral reserves possession charging system and depletion allowance system of mineral resources should be established.

articleTitle: Two-step method based on DEA efficiency decomposition model and HCA model for industrial enterprises efficiency analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the fundamental principle of the DEA efficiency decomposition model and the HCA (hierarchical cluster analysis) model, considered these two models complement each other very well to overcome the obvious limitation when being used separately, and proposed a two-step method based on both the models for using in industrial enterprise efficiency analysis. Then, empirical studies are conducted with relevant data of Chinese listed nonferrous metal companies, using two-step method to divide the companies into several industrial enterprises groups with significantly different efficiency. We conclude that the two-step method based on integrated use of DEA efficiency decomposition model and the HCA model is an effective method for industrial enterprise efficiency study.

articleTitle: The implementation of NAT66 and the olutions of multi-homing in NAT66 environment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The mechanism brought by NAT deserves our attention in IPv6. NAT66, IPv6-to-IPv6 network address translation, provides a new mapping mechanism to design a NAT in IPv6 and aims to avoid as many of the issues associated with NAT as possible. This paper introduces the design and implementation of NAT66 and also discusses the multi-homing solutions in NAT66 environment. As the solutions of HIP and RFC 3484 don't work with NAT66 devices and there is no existing ILNP demo, in this paper we specialize in the implementation of ILNP on solving multi-homing problems in NAT66 environment.

articleTitle: Influence of stiffening ribs on warping stress of the thin-walled steel box beam
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To reduce the warping stress of the thin-walled steel box beam subjected to restrained torsion, transverse stiffening ribs are set. The warping stress is calculated by the finite element software ANSYS considering the influence of the stiffening ribs of the thin-walled box beam with different forms and different spacing intervals. There are four different stiffening rib's forms to be analyzed and compared. It can be concluded that the stiffening ribs with hollow rectangle section can significantly reduce warping stress in the thin-walled box beam and save the materials at the same time. The other conclusion is the warping stress in the thin-walled box beam will decrease remarkably only when the spacing interval of the stiffening ribs is less than one fifth of the beam length. These conclusions provide references for how to design and layout the stiffening ribs when designing thin-walled box beam in restrained torsion in the practical construction.

articleTitle: An evaluation system for service quality of brand specialty shops
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A service quality evaluation system for brand specialty shops was investigated in this paper by basing on the Exploratory Factor Analysis (EFA) and Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP). The index system was proposed to evaluate the service quality of brand specialty shops. Since the uncertainty of the service quality, the fuzzy evaluation was used to optimize the result of the primitive index system. Finally, field surveys at LENOVO brand specialty shops were carried out for validating the index system.

articleTitle: Human resource planning under stochastic capacity demand — The case of data entry service providers
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: There is always uncertainty associated with human resource planning that are caused by the uncertainties in outsourcing projects, resulting in lack of or surplus human resources in the production process. This paper draws upon the principles and methods used in manufacturing capacity planning, to build a human resource planning model in stochastic demands. The model takes cost as an objective function in stochastic conditions. The stochastic marketing constraint was built through random capacity requirement variables. Based on a two-phase model of stochastic linear constraint, the certainty equation of stochastic human resource planning model is obtained. An algorithm that integrates immune clonal selection algorithm (ICSA) with linear programming (LP) is proposed. Treating human resource variables as preconditions, the LP is used to find solutions to the problem of entry capacity distribution strategy. The solution to entry capacity distribution strategy is then used as affinity function for ICSA. Through immune gene and clonal selection operation, the human resource integral variables are searched until the optimum solution achieved.

articleTitle: Intellectual property protection modes in cluster: Based on governance theory
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It forms many intellectual property protection (IPP) modes in the development of cluster, because laws cannot protect IP effectively. Based on governance theory, this article use authority and the relationship type of network as two dimensions to divided governance modes, analyze the corresponding IPP modes in cluster, protection mechanisms, and compare different process of these modes.

articleTitle: Research on bus dispatch of city passenger traffic hubs based on simulation technology
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Passenger transport terminals (PTT) is the cross point of the various transport modes and the place for the travelers to gather, disperse and transfer, so it is the key part of the city's passenger transport system. Witness2007 as a simulation software is constructed to model bus station in Tianjin Railway Station in this paper. Based on above analysis, the paper gave optimized scheme from the view of traffic management, in order to improve transfer efficiency (TE) and reduce operating cost, and give a final plan of bus control. The final optimized result is evaluated at the aspects of utilization of facilities and level of service. The optimization results obtained will help decision make right decision.

articleTitle: The research on corporate independent brand innovation function and its effect appraisal
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Independent brand innovation is the key element for the existence and development of the modern corporations. The thesis raises four independent brand innovation functions of the corporations on the basis of deep research of the corporate independent brand innovation. The four functions are: the leading function of enhancing the independent brand's competitive predomination; the core function of deepening the development of independent brand; the safeguard function of completing the safe of independent brand; the promotion function of increasing the value of independent brand. It has set the effect appraisal model of corporate independent brand innovation function on the basis of fuzzy neural network method, and carried out empirical analysis by picking up classical cases.

articleTitle: Effective management of core competency for creating product innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper considers the relationship between product innovation and core competency that creates effective product innovation. Customers needs become diversified, meanwhile companies have to derive potential market needs and develop new products in order to survive. Therefore, core competency becomes more important to take advantage over their competitors and brings continuous product innovation. Companies should consider how core competency creates continuous product innovation. To create product innovation, the factors of own company's core competency should be carefully considered. It is important to correctly identify and select own core technology and apply it thoroughly, then combine technology seeds and customer needs for new product development. Three factors of core competency are presented for effective product innovation. The first factor is an acquisition of core technology, the second factor is an application of core technology, and the third factor is combining technology seeds and customer needs. For creating continuous product innovation, above three factors should be significantly strengthened, and they enable companies to enter diverse market.

articleTitle: Study on the optimization for the automatic stereo-warehouse of BEIJING BEIKAI ELECTRIC CO, Ltd
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As the expanding of the modern enterprise industrial scale, warehouse has become the most important and indispensable tache of the logistics system. The application of automatic warehouse with less floor space and better space utilization ratio has been popularizing gradually. In this paper, we mainly discuss the optimization for the docking technology and the sorting system & handling system of the automatic stereo-warehouse (abbreviated to A.S.W), Beijing Beikai Electric Co, Ltd (abbreviated to B.B.E) in order to help them to improve its productivity.

articleTitle: The study on correlation of industry logistics based on Copula
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to keep balance of the logistic infrastructure construction between different industry, we should know the correlations between them. Copula has the good property to study the correlations between variables. This paper will use the Copula function as a tool to study the correlation of different industry logistic of BinHai new area.

articleTitle: The motivation analysis and the control method research of quality management in the course of building construction
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Implementing quality management in the course of building construction can effectively prevent the safety accidents to occur during the latter process of the use of building products. Meanwhile the total cost of construction supply chain can be decreased. Also it's beneficial to enhance the brand popularity and reputation of construction enterprises. Mainly to the questions of quality in the current stage of building construction and combining with the features of quality management in the course of building construction, this paper analyzes the management motivation for the course of construction, and makes supply chain management and management by objectives idea and method apply to the quality management of construction, finally puts forward the specific quality control measures. All these are done to improve the overall quality of building products in the course of building construction.

articleTitle: Research on the impact of quality variations on the warranty cost of remanufactured-product under FRLW policy
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The consumers concerns about the performances of the remanufactured products and need great quality assurance. The warranty policies protect the customer by insuring against the failure due to the quality variations (initial design of the product, non-conforming component(s) and the reassembly error). The paper briefly discusses the impacts of the quality variations on the remanufactured product in the process of remanufacturing and models the reliability and the warranty cost under the free rectification lifetime warranty (FRLTW) policy. The numerical example is given to illuminate how the different kinds of quality variations affect the warranty cost and to conclude that the warranty cost to the manufacturer has a great relation to the quality variations and the impact of the reassembly error in the remanufacturing process is much more than that of the non-conforming component(s).

articleTitle: Micro Foundation Analysis of Interest Rate Policy in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In recent years, central bank utilizes interest rate policy more strongly and more frequently. It is general concern in market whether the policy tool can perform actual transmission function across all economic procedures as expected. This issue in transmission channel is also the focus people always argue about. This article analyzes the Micro foundation of interest rate policy, which is savings and investment reflection to the interest rates based on quarterly data from 1996 to 2008, and then concerns the validity of the interest rates policy in different economic cycles.

articleTitle: Pricing game between different brand's standard and innovative products of the same company
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In a highly competitive market, technical innovation and product differentiation are becoming effective ways to avoid cut-throat competition. In this paper, the pricing game model is first established between different brand's standard and innovative products of the same company, then it is discussed that the influence of the degree of product differentiation on equilibrium price. Based on some numerical calculations, the relationships between the rate of innovation on price and demand are revealed at different cost level. At last, in the view point of optimizing the total profit, the optimal rate of innovation at each cost level is identified.

articleTitle: Principal-agent theory based incentive mechanism for the electricity universal service
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: From the characteristics of the electricity universal service, this paper studies the problems within the incentive mechanism of the electricity universal service in the market environment. Based on the principal-agent theory, the paper takes into account the cost compensation and economic incentives factors for the power supply enterprises when implementing the electricity universal service, develops a new principal-agent relationship model between the electricity regulatory institutions and power supply enterprises under the asymmetric information situation, designs an optimal incentive contact, analyzes the problems of parameters' assignment in incentive contracts, as well as the influence of incentive contracts towards effort level, mutual earnings, etc. Examples prove that the proposed incentive mechanism could improve the self-earnings while the effort level of electricity universal service provided by power supply enterprises is upgraded, and together with it is the increase of electricity regulatory institutions' utility and social welfare, which in turn stimulates the power supply enterprises to improve the electricity universal service and achieves multilateral wins and the "Pareto Optimality" condition for the electricity universal service.

articleTitle: Model of design for energy saving of products based on the integration of TRIZ/AD/QFD
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: DFES (DFES, Design for Energy Saving) which incorporates energy-saving into the process of products design is an important part of Green Design. Aimed at the characteristics of possessing complementary advantages amongst AD (AD, Axiomatic Design), QFD (QFD, Quality Function Deployment) and TRIZ, an integration model of AD, QFD and TRIZ is set up. And this paper gives a detailed study on the structure of this integrated model and its implementation. Finally, a case study is introduced to illustrating this model. The achievements above solve the fundamental problem of DFES, which provide significant references for sustainable design.

articleTitle: Enterprises knowledge growth model basis on knowledge chain analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to probe the essence of enterprise development and exploration of the sustainable core-competence factor of the enterprise, the paper put forward the structures corresponding to knowledge increasing mathematic model by system dynamic analysis based on the knowledge chain model. From the point view of enterprise life cycle theory, the three key factors of knowledge management affect enterprise development were point out. Furthermore, according to three key factors as coordinate, along the enterprise life cycle interval, the enterprise knowledge growth model was built, which help the enterprise to gain sustainable core-competence, transmits from the overripe period to spallation period for sustainable development quickly.

articleTitle: Effective strategic planning for successful e-commerce project completion and deployment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: We investigate a number of important management factors that can be attributed to the successful of completion and deployment of e-commerce projects. These factors are generally considered in the process of project management within the context of a business-to-consumer environment. In particular, we focus on the important strategic planning stage of project management that can have a serious impact on the eventual success of the projects. The approach taken can be considered an adaptation of conventional engineering project management in the context of e-commerce deployment. This ensures that tried-and-tested techniques are applied and developed.

articleTitle: Research on MBR computer emulation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: MBR for wastewater treatment is presented in the paper. It aims at expatiating the research progress on MBR membrane fouling based on the system of bio-membrane process and coupling. A model for the research on MBR is established by studying the research on MBR mathematical model. The model comprises four modules: a multiphase flux module for calculating the flux speed field of gas, fluid and solid; a transfer module for calculating wastewater concentration field; a bio-reactor kinetic module for calculating the reaction of bio- decomposition and also a membrane permeability module for expressing membrane transfer and pollution. This model can help to attain a new cognition about MBR progress on mechanism. This paper also innovatively advances the theory of exploring wastewater treatment and how to solve it.

articleTitle: A method of urban saving energy evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to the city energy consumption character in China, this article forms a city energy conservation evaluation index system. It contains 27 indexes in 3 levels and 4 parts about industry, building, city transportation and residential consumption. According to some standard, the article divides city energy conservation level into 4 classes and forms energy conservation evaluation model. In the end, it takes one city as an example to carry on empirical research. The analysis result basically reflects the actual condition of the city energy consumption and indicates the feasibility of the estimate method.

articleTitle: Research on the management factors in calamity prevention and control of integrated transportation hub
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The construction of integrated transportation hub(ITH) is an inevitable trend with the development of integrated transportation system. ITH is a best way to realize efficient exchange of various transportation ways and to realize public traffic priority development in city. Meanwhile, it also points out a new research area — how to prevent and control the calamities of integrated transportation hub. Firstly, this paper classifies the factors of calamity prevention and control into four kinds: environment, technology, human and management. Secondly, this paper develops the frameworks of management factors analysis and operation in calamity prevention and control of integrated transportation hub. At last, this paper points out the research fields of the integrated transportation hub calamity prevention and control in the future.

articleTitle: Research on optimization method for facilities layout of complex manufacturing system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Aim at complex manufacturing system with many facilities and complication of mutual relevance, traditional methods can't achieve to optimize facilities layout. Combining with the thought of hierarchical analysis and QAP, Quadratic Facility Layout Method (QFLM) was proposed which lays out independent-type units and dependent-type units successively through dividing facility units into independent-type units and dependent-type units. The thought of QFLM was expounded. The models of QFLM were constructed and ant colony algorithm and Centroid method were used to solve the models. Through demonstration, QFLM can be used to lay out a workshop. It simplifies the process of facilities layout and achieves to optimize the facilities layout for complex manufacturing system.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation for the reliability of gearbox shell production line
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The following reliability indexes are calculated based on the observed one year and a half maintenance records for two gearbox shell production lines after 10 years of running: F(t), R(t), MTBF, MTTR, K, A and C. By contrasting the dynamic indexes of these 2 lines, we find out that the reliability of flexible line is lower than that of the rigid line. Furthermore, we build a fuzzy comprehensive model based on the static indexes above by using fuzzy math and AHP method. This model validates the conclusion of the difference in the reliability of the two production lines. Finally, we analyze the underlying reason of such reliability difference of these 2 lines.

articleTitle: System optimization model construction of raw coal cost management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The use of advanced management ideas, scientific methods of cost management and cost management system optimization are the most urgent matter of coal enterprises. In this paper, enhancing cost competitiveness as the goal, the cost of coal enterprises was studied. In addition, the modern theory of cost management system based, the influence factors of raw coal cost was analyzed, the construction principle of the evaluation indexes and index system of raw coal cost management were established, and system optimization model of raw coal cost management was constructed.

articleTitle: Study of the impact of start-up social network on the relationship between entrepreneurial competence and venture capital financing
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper demonstrates the relationship among start-up social network, entrepreneurial competence and venture capital financing, and adapts the multi-industry large sample data to verify. The results show that in the financing process of start-ups, the stronger the entrepreneurial competence of entrepreneurs is, the more venture capital enterprises can get, and the relationship is further affected by start-up social network. Specifically, network specific information, mutual trust and altruistic motivation enhance the positive correlation relationship between entrepreneurial competence and venture capital financing. It reflects that start-up social network plays an important role in the course of venture capital financing.

articleTitle: Factors affecting knowledge sharing in governmental fiscal departments: An empirical study
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: We propose a theoretical framework about the factors that affect knowledge sharing in governmental fiscal departments. The framework is about the relationship between information technology, trust, knowledge sharing intention and knowledge sharing behaviors. Seven hypotheses are proposed based on the framework. These hypotheses are confirmed through a field survey of 169 employees from 5 governmental fiscal departments in 5 cities in Shaanxi Province. The results show that information technology, especially the usage of IT application and easy use of information system by end-users definitely affect individual's intention to knowledge sharing. Additionally, we confirm that trust, knowledge sharing intention also has positive effect on knowledge sharing.

articleTitle: Quality cost control model based on fuzzy neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to develop a new quality cost control model, the paper first sets the third level subject of quality cost base on the PAF model, which is that quality cost is composed of prevention cost, appraisal cost, failure cost and does Pareto analysis according to the history data, finding the main influential subjects, second, it uses correlation analysis and partial correlation analysis to find the actual influential subjects, then it analyses the controllable factors and uncontrollable factors to these actual influential subjects. Finally, based on all the analysis results, and by taking use of fuzzy control and neural network, the paper sets fuzzy subsets and rules and establishes a quality cost control model based on them to facilitate automatic quality cost control.

articleTitle: Bayesian sequential control charts for monitoring multivariate processes
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The control charts are an effective tool to enhance quality in industrial sectors. To make full use of the sample' information in different stages and consider the parameter uncertainty risk in statistical process control, this paper introduces a reference prior distribution for the parameters in quality models, and constructs control with the warning limits and control limits in terms of the quality variables' predictive distributions as well as the relationship between the multivariate student t distribution and F distribution, monitoring the variables change in processes. When the current stage is under statistical control, the parametric posterior distribution is considered to be their priori distribution in the next stage, by which an sequential Bayesian multivariate control approach is established.

articleTitle: A study on the profit model of the port e-commerce platform
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Proceed from the commerce view, a perfect combination of port and e-commerce is the new breakthrough point that would make port income creating. This paper makes e-commerce thoughts and technologies applied for the traditional port transaction, excavates the value on the base of the port e-commerce platform, studies the profit model of the port e-commerce platform on the aspects of competition structure, the key to the success of industry-driven factors, value creation configuration, the core of business, marketing way, the basic and channel of value and so on. Moreover, it builds an evaluating model by using multistage fuzzy evaluation method.

articleTitle: The research about the price-limited housing existence conditions in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To stabilize the house price and guarantee the housing need of the medium income group, our government has put forward the price-limited housing policy. However, in various areas it arouses the controversy on the execution of the policy. Based on a systematic analysis about the welfare among the government, the developer and the house purchaser in the construction process of the price-limited housing, this research sets up a multi-purpose plan model about its existence conditions, and takes Beijing as an exemplification to verify the author's theory, with an expectation of giving some basis strategic suggestions for those local governments while adopting the price-limited housing policy.

articleTitle: Research of object target fine-granularity model objected to application system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper discusses the data, the manipulation and services, which forms the foundation of information system. And then an fine-granularity access control model to object resource is built, which can be extended to many information system. The fine-granularity access control to internal resources of information system can be realized very easily. The access authority and application becomes more and more clarity.

articleTitle: A semiotic approach of multi-agent simulation for policy evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Nowadays the changing environment becomes the main challenge for most of organizations, since they have to evaluate proper policies to adapt to the environment. In this paper, we propose a multi-agent simulation method to evaluate policies based on complex adaptive system theory. Furthermore, we propose a semiotic EDA (Epistemic, Deontic, Axiological) agent model to simulate agent's behavior in the system by incorporating the social norms reflecting the policy. A case study is also provided to validate our approach. Our research present better adaptability and validity than the qualitative analysis and experiment approach and the semiotic agent model provides high creditability to simulate agents' behavior.
