articleTitle: Research on relationship between private benefits of control and top executive compensation in double agent theory — An empirical study of equity transfer in China's listed companies
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studied the relationship between PBC and top executive compensation by simultaneous equation. Findings show according to 2SLS estimation that a coefficient between PBC and top executive compensation is 9.461 in PBC equation, and that a coefficient between expropriation and top executive compensation is 0.012 in top executive compensation equation. The results indicate that the impact of the top executive compensation to the PBC is greater than that of the expropriation interests of controlling shareholders to the top executive compensation.

articleTitle: A decision method of characteristic with adding new elements
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: From adding to the single element, it is universally discussed that a group of elements are added to the other group under the same judging criterion in G1 Method. The sequencing condition to the new sorting between every element in the new sorting and every one before adding more are given in this paper.

articleTitle: Rigid-flexible coupling dynamics analysis method for gun based on gauss constraint
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The rigid-flexible coupling multi-body dynamics model of the gun system was developed based on the Gauss minimum constraint principle. The expressions of the dynamic equations in closed form were deduced, and the means to simplify all kinds of external forces were provided. According to this dynamic equations and combining the correlative experimental parameters, the firing process of gun was numerically simulated and analyzed. The results of simulation indicate that: Although the modeling process considering barrel's flexibility is more complicated than the pure rigid modeling, the rigid-flexible coupling dynamics model that obtained by flexible multi-body dynamics theory is more close to the actual firing case compared with rigid model. Barrel's flexibility has an effect on the displacement and velocity of muzzle vibration, further more, affects muzzle initial disturbance of projectile, and finally, affects firing accuracy. So it's indispensable to consider barrel's flexibility when carries through the dynamic simulation of the whole gun system. The model, method, and results of simulation have reference value to correlative engineering research, and provide also a technical way for improving on the design of gun.

articleTitle: Research on comprehensive resource optimal configuration for manufacturing grid
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: By defining this resource quality objectives, the combination evaluation model based on principal component analysis determining objective weight and analytic network process determining subjective weight was presented to solve the problems of combinatorial optimization arising from the dimensions' differences between manufacturing grid and resource allocation and distributed manufacturing resource selective preference. In the final model analysis of grinding resources comprehensive evaluation, grinding resources comprehensive evaluation index system is simplified by principal component analysis, and ordering vector of candidate resource is formed by analytic network process, then objects will be comprehensive evaluated through the comprehensive evaluation model we've got, from which the result avoids the limitation of single evaluation method and shows the practicability and effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Inventory planning based on knowledgeable base and self-learning fuzzy petri nets
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to improve design, purchase, produce and inventory management efficiency of follow-up products, we present an establishment method of knowledgeable base and a self-learning fuzzy Petri nets (SFPN) model in knowledgeable manufacturing system. The SFPN model store existing products model in knowledge base, while a follow-up product is developed or a new decision is made, the model of existing product can be read, modified and trained, used as that of follow-up product, it can effectively improve the efficiency of enterprise management. A case study of the method to forecasting parts inventory verifies its validity.

articleTitle: Research on proactive knowledge service for product design
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The knowledge delivery is an important process that enables enterprises to create competitive business advantages. In view of the existing insufficiency of knowledge management system, this paper proposed a frame of proactive knowledge service system for product design, sketch the frame of proactive knowledge service system and show some details. Illustrate method of knowledge representation for product design, based on the knowledge need of product design processes, put forward an idea and method of the proactive knowledge matching.

articleTitle: Research on supplier-buyer enterprise contract cooperation model based on product-service system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Product-service system (PSS) focuses on the service based on product instead of selling product. It refers to selling service or function rather than pure products. Based on PSS, this paper establishes savings-share contract model and Profits-share contract model. Through quantitative analysis, it shows that when share index meet certain condition supplier enterprise and buyer enterprise will get more returns than under the traditional model and resources will be consumed much less.

articleTitle: Research on vertical integration under overcapacity
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Overcapacity is the main characteristic of many industries in transition economies. This paper focuses on the motives and impacts of vertical merger under this characteristic. Based on the extension of Hart-Tirole model, we show upstream overcapacity creates motivation for vertical merger, and the motivation is decreasing with the M&A cost. Eager bandwagon becomes possible while certain conditions are satisfied. Vertical merger may foreclose the surplus capacity out of market, and the likelihood is increasing with the downstream investment cost. At last, we check the adaptability of these suggestions to Chinese aluminum industry, and points out the influence of government intervention on the adaptability.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between design parameters and volume of diesel engine based on orthogonal experiment design
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, a parametric experiment model of V-8 diesel engine is developed. The angle of V-shape, cylinder-to-cylinder spacing, and connecting rod length are selected as research factors and their influences on the engine's volume are studied by the orthogonal experiment. In each experiment a new engine model is built by changing these factors' values and the volume of the new model is calculated. Through analysis of variance, the significant relations between diesel engine volume and factors are given, which provide the criteria for the selection of the design parameters.

articleTitle: Fee versus royalty licensing in an endogenous R&D model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The past researches study on the technology licensing considering a fixed-fee and a royalty by utilizing an exogenous research and development (R&D) model with the patentee has a cost-reducing innovation. In this paper, we discuss the patentee's R&D investment licensing under a fixed-fee licensing versus a royalty licensing with an outsider patentee. Two conclusions are: (1) the R&D investment with the fixed-fee licensing is always no less than with the royalty licensing, (2) the fixed-fee licensing is still the best strategy for the patentee himself and for the whole society.

articleTitle: Fuzzy measurement method and its verification of long-term development of small sized e-commerce companies
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Long-term development is a very important factor for small sized E-commerce companies (SSEC) when they are faced with more intense competition. How to measure the long-term development of these companies is very useful in practice. It is hard for us to know the fact of SSEC long-term development because there are not eligible methods with quantitative analysis for SSEC in the present researches. We try to adopt the method of AHP (Analytic Hierarchy Process) in fuzzy mathematics to establish fuzzy comprehensive measurement indicators system and synthetically measure the long-term development of SSEC from three aspects of Economic capability, operation ability and innovation ability. At last we verify and improve the effectiveness of the method by means of an example analysis.

articleTitle: Knowledge-sharing model and its practical significance basing on niche-theory
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Knowledge-sharing is the most important sector of knowledge management. Traditional research on knowledge-sharing mechanism doesn't resolve the fundamental problem affecting knowledge-sharing. Drawing on niche-theory of the ecology, this paper proposes a knowledge-sharing model basing on niche-theory. The core idea of the model is: as the starting point of knowledge preference, the model sets up knowledge-sharing mechanism, achieves the most optimal allocation of resources through knowledge ecosystem's self-organization, achieves value maximization of knowledge resources, and eventually realizes a win-win situation for both enterprises and employees.

articleTitle: The performance evaluation of real estate regulation based on DEA model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Since 2003, the Chinese government has strengthened controls on the real estate market. However, the academic circle has controversy on the policy effectiveness of real estate regulation. This paper adopts the data envelopment analysis (DEA) model to carry out system analysis to the effects of the real estate regulation policy during 2003–2008, and uses the statistical data to verify the conclusions. The results show that the real estate regulation of 2008 and 2006 was effective while other years were weak effective, the worst year of regulation performance was in 2007. The real estate regulation in this period is neither with no effectiveness as some public opinion in the early time, nor that with great success as claimed by some officials. These conclusions are helpful for using the instruments of real estate regulation policy in the future.

articleTitle: Affective-cognition modeling of product ecosystems using timed colored Petri nets
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Design for products and systems that are affectively pleasurable and cognitive intuitive conveys a competitive edge in terms of customer satisfaction. Further, it is not uncommon that products tend to be correlated with one another, in conjunction with services, use environments, along with many other use context-related factors. This leads to a scenario of product ecosystem design. This paper proposes concepts about product ecosystems, such as the affective and cognitive dimensions and modeling techniques that need to be specified, designed and implemented in order to realize the potential of the product ecosystem vision. Based on timed colored Petri nets, the proposed concepts are then translated into an operative model for the design and evaluation of the product ecosystem using an illustrating example. Preliminary results shed light on the paradigm of product ecosystem design.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of control algorithm for smart isolated structure based on Simulink S-Function
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A new simulation module is created based on the Simulink S-Function to meet the main characteristic of the active sequential optimal control (SOC) algorithm, in which the gain matrix is time variation, and embed into the Simulink Standard Block Library. Based on this new block library, a numerical simulation is carried out on the seismic responses of a five-storey base-isolated frame structure. Six key indices recommended by the ASCE are calculated to evaluate the control effects among the classical optimal control (COC), linear quadratic Gaussian (LQG) control and SOC in the case of the sensors normal working and sensors contaminated by white noise with different magnitudes, respectively. The results show that the new S-Function module is convenient and efficient in implementing a control algorithm simulation, and comparison with other two, the SOC algorithm has the best noise-resisting ability and the stable advantage in overall control effect.

articleTitle: Research on pricing of deposit insurance system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Deposit Insurance System is an important and fundamental system in finance under the condition of market economy. The article, taking foreign experience into consideration and by the means of system engineering, complex system modeling and BSDE and on the purpose of protecting the depositors, integrates the financing income and payment into one system recording to management and operation of DIS and establishes one based BSDE system model researching on the relationship between the fee standard, investment, payment and objective achievements. Then, it provides with different theoretical solutions considering the risky assets and risk-free assets respectively to analyze the pricing or charge.

articleTitle: Model for ranking green supply chain strategies based on MDEA
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To overcome the drawback of few researches for selecting green supply chain (GSC) strategic under fuzzy environment, a GSC strategy ranking model is proposed in terms of analyzing the framework for evaluating GSC. In order to integrate the fuzzy attribute values, the HWA operator is applied to transform the fuzzy decision matrices regarding attribute values into a complex decision matrix. After that, the values in the cost and the benefit attributes are respectively regarded as inputs and outputs, and the MDEA which allows for a ranking of the efficient units while evaluating the relative efficiency of decision making units is employed to develop a model for ranking GSC strategies and selecting the optimal strategy under the attribute weight information is partly known. Applied to a simulation case, the presented method is proved to be well applicable.

articleTitle: Key technology analysis of implementing lean production
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Lean production is a scientific management model that has been proven by practice, but the lack of implementation manual or guideline has seriously affected its smooth implementation as well as its propagation in China. Because the enterprises don't know which lean technology or tool has more intimate relation to successful implementation of lean production. In order to make clear the relation between lean technologies and the implementation effect of lean production, this paper fixes 12 factors affecting lean production's implementation after referring related papers and filed research. Then apply rough set to study the regular in lean production implementation and fix the relative weights of lean technology. The research result can help enterprises identify key technologies thus avoiding the risk of depending on experts severely, and also provide important reference for enterprises to arrange the procedure of enforcing lean production reasonably.

articleTitle: A decision method of characteristic with adding new elements
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: From adding to the single element, it is universally discussed that a group of elements are added to the other group under the same judging criterion in G1 Method. The sequencing condition to the new sorting between every element in the new sorting and every one before adding more are given in this paper.

articleTitle: The development strategies approach to China's small and medium-sized enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: SMEs have become the main force of China's economic development. Management of small and medium-sized enterprises is one of the main themes of management in China. From the angle of development, this article probes into the future development strategies of small and medium-sized enterprises of our country, on the basis of analysis points out the competitive pressure that the small and medium-sized enterprises of our country face. From marketing strategy, talents' strategy, motivating strategy, technological innovation strategy the characteristics of the small and medium-sized enterprises are analyzed in this paper, meanwhile, the proper innovative strategies are also put forward.

articleTitle: High-tech enterprise cluster's innovation and isomorphism: A case study of zhongguancun software park identity struggle
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Enterprise cluster's innovation is the best way of high-tech enterprise cluster optimization and upgrading. Practices show that enterprises inside the cluster have better innovation performance than the ones outside, and organizations in the same cluster are becoming increasingly homogeneous in innovation. This paper exerts the New Institutional Theory from the view of Sociology of Organization, takes "Organizational Field" to explain the mechanism of isomorphism in enterprise cluster innovation, including coercive, mimic and normative isomorphism, uses Zhongguancun Software Park as a typical example, and explores the success of science and technology park. Our results show that the innovative community in organization field makes enterprises in the cluster more and more homogeneous in innovation, and ultimately drives the escalation of high-tech parks.

articleTitle: Analysis on the influencing factors and countermeasures of modern hospital construction based on in-trees archetype generating set
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Modern hospital construction plays an important role in improving hospital competitiveness. The paper confirmed six influencing factors of modern hospital construction by the means of doing research on the spot in hospital and analyzing systematically. Then set up system archetypes of influencing factors based on the method of the in-trees archetype generating set, and classified all archetypes into three groups, which make easy to propose the countermeasures of modern hospital construction.

articleTitle: A study of online transaction platform based on interactive search engine
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Online transaction becomes a main way of e-commerce at present. Information discovery and price discovery in e-commerce are realized in the platform mainly. This thesis presents an online transaction platform of interactive search after analyzing the research status of interactive search engine to solve the problem that buyers are hard to search seller information in this platform, bring the initiative of the sellers in principal part of trade into full play about using transaction platform, improving search efficiency and enhance VAS ability in transaction platform. The system has been implemented with .net technology and runs in campus network. Interactive search can be fulfilled using embedded search engine rather than using SQL trigger mechanism to raise search efficiency.

articleTitle: Integrated management of collaborative relationships and collaborative processes in industrial clusters
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Collaborative relationship in industrial clusters is taken as the basic unit of analysis. Relationship integration is defined as the function of transaction frequency and asset specificity. Process integration is defined as the function of process coordination, flexibility and reconfigurability. The relation of relationship integration and process integration is investigated. It is revealed that appropriate level of relationship integration can improve process integration, but as relationship integration exceeds certain threshold process integration falls as it increases.

articleTitle: Study on monitoring methods of cluster innovation network and related empirical case based on patent intelligence
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Patent intelligence is an effective approach that enterprises cluster innovation network realizes through quantitative analysis. The paper builds the operational monitoring methods of enterprises cluster innovation network based on patent information and synthetically applying network and patent map analysis methods, and illustrates operation characteristics and existing problems of cluster innovation network taking Harbin equipment manufacturing industrial clusters as an example, so as to offer scientific theoretical methods guidance and empirical reference for risks monitor and management of enterprises cluster innovation network from the angle of patent.

articleTitle: Research on order switch cost for ETO enterprise in MC
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As orders of ETO enterprise in MC environment switch frequently and various orders are very different from each other, the cost caused by order-switch is enormous. Based on this situation, the characteristics of the ETO enterprise in MC environment are analyzed. The concept of order switch cost (OSC) is put forward and its characteristics are analyzed. The structure of the OSC model is built; and its contents are analyzed. Based on a matrix method, a procedure to acquire OSC is proposed. Finally the feasibility of this method was verified by a case.

articleTitle: Multi-resource leveling based on entropy and fuzzy comprehensive selection relation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Resource leveling optimization with fixed project duration is one classic problem but also hard to solve. It becomes more difficult when multiple resources are considered. According to the defects existing in current research, this paper puts forward an effective method to solve the problem of multi-resource leveling in construction management. First of all, this paper determines the weights of all kinds of resources by establishing fuzzy comprehensive selection relation of their importance degree. Then, by bringing in the concept of resource entropy, resource leveling evaluation index based on entropy function is proposed, and furthermore, the fundamental principle and optimization procedure of the method mentioned above are presented. Finally, the efficiency and validity of this method are tested through case study, the result of which shows that the method brought forward in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Simulation model of a supply chain with asymmetric information based on non-linear control
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Simulation studies for the operation process of supply chain are helpful to find the factors which the bullwhip effect was caused by, and the measures weaken the bullwhip effect. A simulation model, using control theory and MATLAB, was developed to describe a three-echelon supply chain inventory control system under asymmetric information. In the simulation model, a non-linear controller was used to simulate the (s, S) Strategy in the supply chain. The simulation results demonstrated the existence of bullwhip effect and the simulation model developed is valid. Some further simulation results show that distortion of demand information results in the bullwhip effect when the demand information is asymmetrical for each echelon on the supply chain, and a coordinate mechanism should be established to improve the efficiency of supply chain.

articleTitle: Enterprise business process reengineering design and research of AHP evaluation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Started with analysis on actualities and characteristics of purchase, production and sale in a steel enterprises, proposes three management models of reengineering of material flows in enterprise, such as management models of production flow, purchasing management and client center, which all normalized by standards The effects of material flows reengineering are comprehensively evaluated by application of hierarchy analytical method. The better economic and social benefit is achieved after execution of this model in a steel enterprise. After implementation the Iron and steel enterprises will have good cost-effective and social benefits.

articleTitle: Occupational safety and health management for the recycling industry
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The workers in the recycling industry have to deal with various kinds of toxic and harmful substances in wastes on a regular basis. Due to the unique high-risk operations and processes in the recycling industry, the occupational safety and health (OSH) management system for general working environments requires serious modifications to better safeguard the health of workers. In this project, the existing OSH working environment and operational practices have been reviewed. Accordingly, effective OSH management program has been established for the recycling industry. The subsequent implementation will enable systematic OSH management to collect injury statistical data, identify mitigation measures and thus improve the OSH performance.

articleTitle: Supplemental economic analysis of urban newly-built projects based on TIA
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Economic analysis is the core content of feasibility study and evaluation, and an important basis for decision-making. Its role is to minimize the risk and improve returns on investment. Traffic impact analysis (TIA) is the way that analyses the project impact on the urban traffic, according to the inner link between urban development project and traffic demand growth, and then advances countermeasures of keeping the level of service (LOS), and implements the compensation policy to reduce traffic load impact of the development. Based on the theory of TIA, this paper analyses and evaluates the impact of urban newly-built projects on its surrounding network, and uses this technology to supplement the traditional methods of economic evaluation of project items.

articleTitle: Delta-neutral dynamic hedging of the HS300 stock index futures and option portfolio — The evidence from simulation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The launch of Shanghai-Shenzhen 300 index futures can not only supply the hedging tools and liquidity, but also bring some new kind of risk. The principal of this research is to analyze the risk hedging policy of the index futures using various kinds of dynamic hedging portfolios of index futures and index options with the same underlying index. Firstly, we developed a delta-neutral dynamic hedging model of the stock index futures/option portfolio in a perfect market; Secondly, we completed the daily and weekly adjusting of dynamic delta-neutral hedging and proposed the dynamic-neutral adjusting strategy: adjusting continuously the stock index futures position to achieve zero-delta of the portfolios on the basis of the prerequisite of keeping the stock index option position constant. The results of this analysis show that a protective “delta-neutral” strategy produces a more effective hedge than the other hedging examined, daily adjusting is optimal. Thus, we further suggest that with the steady operation of Shanghai-Shenzhen 300 stock index futures, China could launch the stock index options in due time, thus to provide developing strategy for the stock index derivatives markets.

articleTitle: A method for software project risk identification based on GA
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A software project risk identification process based on Genetic Algorithms (GA) is presented in this paper. The risk identification process utilizes GA to search the rules of risk identification based on historical data in software project in order to identify the risks in the process of software project development. The application process of GA in risk identification is analyzed in the paper. Finally, the validity of risk identification process is proved using an example.

articleTitle: Enterprises scientific development performance evaluation based on combination weighting
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To evaluate the scientific development performance of enterprises is an effective way to enhance companies' core competitiveness. Based on combination weighting, this paper evaluated four enterprises scientific development performance. The innovation points and contributions are in three aspects. Firstly, by determining the combination weight through the multiplicative synthesis method, it arouses experts' subjective initiatives and experiences, fully utilizes objective data and then organically combines subjective and objective information. Secondly, through evaluation from manpower criterion, the basic idea of Scientific Development Concept on people-oriented is reflected. Thirdly, the research results indicate that the scientific development tendency and economic performance of China State shipbuilding Corporation is prominent. However, its performance in manpower, society and zoology is not ideal.

articleTitle: Dynamics of a triple-stage gearing using finite element models
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: An analyzing method that can examine the complex, dynamic behavior of a triple-stage gearing by using FEM is proposed in this study. The 3D CAD model of the triple-stage gearing is established according to the given geometry parameters. The finite element model of the system is developed from a unique analysis solver specialized for gear dynamics. The dynamics model is established with transmission error excitation and shaft compliance taken into account. The main vibration modes of the whole system are analyzed by simulation experiments and noises are mainly induced by the vibration of the gearbox under the second modal. Based on the model of transmission error, the dynamic forces are determined by using equations in matrix form. Some nonlinear phenomena have been detected in the water spectrum of dynamic mesh forces. The transmission performance is validated by analyzing dynamic responses of the triple-stage gearing.

articleTitle: Study on assessment of the sustainable development of regional industrial enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Assessment of sustainable development of regional industry enterprises is an important content of regional sustainable development study. Based on the principles of establishing assessment index system of sustainable development of regional industrial enterprises, an index system including four-layer and 56 indicators was established, the membership function model of quantitative indexes and the choosing value standards of qualitative indexes were discussed. Based on the learning mechanism of BP neural network, the weight of each index and each layer were ultimately determined. In the end, the fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method of comprehensive assessment and a practical verifying example were given. This study can provide scientific basis for working out strategy of sustainable development of regional industrial enterprises.

articleTitle: The growth of the HTBF backed venture capital
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Compared with the big enterprise and the mature enterprise, the high technology-based firm (HTBF) lacks the innovation capabilities and restricts the fast and sustainable growth. Lacking the support of exterior financial capital is an important reason. Under the mature market conditions, HTBF depends upon the good operation of venture capital(VC) and the support of capital market for obtaining the power of innovation, but at present this is only an ideal plan in China, where lacks the effective system security and market environment. Therefore, the paper mainly analyzes the growth characteristics of HTBF backed venture capital, thereby proposing an interaction mechanism between venture capital and HTBF.

articleTitle: Research on lead time of supply chain and its interrelated cost
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: On the basis of comprehensive analysis of the lead-time (LT) of supply chain(SC) and the research of the interrelated cost, with setting related assumptions, the mode of lead-time reduction and related costs that faces the two-echelon supply chain composed of manufactures and suppliers is established. Finally, it is concluded that the total cost in the two-echelon supply chain is the convex function of the lead time. Besides, the total cost will be obtained at each interval end point. Through the concrete cases, after clashing the lead-time, the manufacturer's cost will decrease, while the supplier's cost will increase. What's more, the range of decreasing cost is greater than that of the increasing cost. Therefore, transferred payment is needed to properly compensate the supplier.

articleTitle: Simulation research of the Mixed-Model production line based on Flexsim
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To meet product diversification and individuation, the paper reconstructed the original single object production line using Flexsim simulation software. Reconstructed model was optimized using the ECRS (eliminate, combine, rearrange, simple) analytic method. The study indicate that the mixed-model production line making up three production line can raise the comprehensive utilization ratio of equipment.

articleTitle: Particle filter based study of fire forecasting in RCRSS
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: RoboCupRescue simulation system aims at simulating large-scale disasters in order to explore coordination strategies for real-life rescue missions. Rules of fire propagation are complex, so most teams only use some features of fire for decision, and it lead to the limitation of the fire forecasting and decision-making. This article introduces a kind of simplified fire propagation model based on the principle of fire simulator and a particle filter based online fire forecasting method. In the end, the result of forecasting will be introduced.

articleTitle: Study on anaerobic granular sludge in beer waste water treatment
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this study, granule activated carbon was adopted as carrier to speed up the cultivation of granular sludge in a UASB reactor treating beer waste water. The results showed the granulation process of UASB was finished just on day 63rd and the COD removal efficiency reached as high as 92% at volumetric loading rate of 15.0 kgCOD/(m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>-d) after the addition of granule activated carbon. Mature granular sludge had perfect settling property and methanogenic activity with diameters of 0.83-2 mm. Bacterium community was abundant and distributed regionally inside the granular sludge. Furthermore, no in-core was discovered which indicated that the formation granular sludge was due to the second nuclear theory.

articleTitle: Study on general and sectoral characteristics of the corruption in project bidding
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Through an inter-temporal game between traffic department and tender enterprise, this paper, theoretically studied the general characteristics of the corruption in project bidding in infrastructure construction, and then, setting an example of the traffic infrastructure construction and water infrastructure construction, researched the sectoral characteristics of the corruption in project bidding. From the angle of regulating the government officials, this paper put forward that: incentive and restraint mechanism, such as the innovation for the system of civil servants' wage, strengthening the supervisory mechanism and penalty mechanism, are effective countermeasures to circumvent corruption. Besides, the sectoral characteristics between different departments are mainly determined by democracy participation mechanism.

articleTitle: Development of an RMS model based on colored object-oriented Petri nets with changeable structures
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Current research on reconflgurable manufacturing systems (RMSs) only highlights the isolated empirical study with a limited attempt to explore the modeling and design support issues surrounding this economically important class of system development problems. This paper proposes colored object-oriented Petri nets with changeable structures to shed light on how RMSs can dynamically reconfigure system components to accommodate production variations resulting from diverse changes in product design and order quantities. The proposed model is discussed in detail using a case example.

articleTitle: A finite element model of knowledge network performance in organization
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Knowledge network performance is a very popular topic now, firstly the attribute of the knowledge network is analyzed, and is compared with the finite element system, it is found that some general characters exist between the two systems. Based on this, a knowledge network appraisal model is established with the finite element analysis which is used in engineering problems, this model could quantify the knowledge network assessment problems, which will promote knowledge management. A case study with this model shows that a department or individual with more knowledge couldn't contribute more, because this is related with other factors such as communication frequency and so on.

articleTitle: Influence of rim thickness on crack initiation life of wheel web plate for freight car
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The temperature and stress distribution in freight car wheel are very important to the operation life. According to the data of investigation, the relationship among the wheel service life, crack rate on web hole and rim thickness is analyzed. The loads, boundary conditions and loading processes in the finite element analysis of temperature, stress field and wheel-railway mechanical stress are discussed according to the heat transfer theory, tread braking principle of wheel and UIC standard. Based on the wheel operation conditions, the influence of different rim thickness on grade braking thermal stress and wheel-railway mechanical stress is simulated with finite element method. The prediction model of crack initiation life for the wheel web hole, which has been taken into consideration for rim thickness, is established. The results show that the high stress at the web hole edge appears under grade braking load cases combined with mechanical load cases. The stress at wheel web hole edge will be increased as the rim thickness reduces, and the increase of thermal stress is much more obvious. Mechanical stress combined with thermal stress is absolutely necessary for crack initiation on wheel web hole. With the service time increases, the rim thickness will be reduced gradually, and the fatigue damage on web hole will be accelerated. The crack initiation life prediction is close to the practical situation.

articleTitle: Study on Kansei status evaluation of consumer electronics products based on artificial neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using Kansei engineering method, this paper discussed the principle of Kansei status evaluation of consumer electronics products, and analyzed the approach to quantify the inner perception of consumers. Based on the technology of artificial neural network, this paper established neural network model of perceptual status evaluation of consumer electronics products. Using investigation samples to train this neural network, we got the optimized neural evaluation network.

articleTitle: Research on reverse logistics network design methods of household appliance
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the development of household appliances, it also has brought more and more pollution and threat. In order to better solve the problem, this paper introduced the characteristics of the household appliances reverse logistics, followed by giving the network construction elements; After analysis, put forward a suitable design method-TOC, and set up a model; Finally used WITNESS software to simulate in order to confirm the practicality of the model.

articleTitle: Establishment and empirical study of prediction model of financial status of listed companies based on entropy theory
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A new type of prediction model has been established by using entropy theory to predict changes of financial status of the listed companies. This model can be applied to enterprise ranking according to the financial status. Furthermore, the objective weight is assigned to each index in this model to remove weakness appeared in the case of subjective weight. Both financial indexes and corporate governance indexes data are applied to the demonstration analysis of the listed companies in metal and nonmetal industry. It proves that this entropy theory based-prediction model becomes very feasible and reliable to evaluate the financial status of the listed companies.

articleTitle: A method for semantic performance modeling in extended enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Performance modeling now gains much attention and investigation by academic and industrial researchers. This paper is intended to develop a framework named 'semantic performance modeling' to overcome the problems in practice, since we concluded that the performance model should be subjected to explicit context where it exits. Under this framework, the business process modeling methods are employed to present the context. A combination of Process Specification Language (PSL) and Resource Description Framework (RDF) is adopted to link performance modeling to process modeling. A heuristic method to build up performance models from its contextual process models is then proposed to support the framework.

articleTitle: Study of the market structure on market performance of the regional real estate
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on market-structure theory, targeted at the real estate industry in Tianjin, and adopted the data from 1996 till 2006, analyze the real estate market structure and the relationship between its performances. The results show that: the higher the degree of industrial concentration, the higher of the profit margin.

articleTitle: Research on application of multi-agent system in the inter-area oscillation damping control based on wide-area measurement information
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the view of the research in the existing inter-area oscillation control system in wide area network and multi-Agent system, this paper presents the control collaborative model of the inter-area oscillation based on multi-Agent and PMU for solving the problems presently such as centralized control and delay of wide-area power system in the control mode of the inter-area oscillation. It discusses the main function of each Agent in this model, and designs the monitoring strategies of three-level PSS signal, finally indicates the feasibility and effectiveness of the constructing the inter-area oscillation control system based on multi-Agent system by the digital simulation.

articleTitle: The research of modeling & simulation on improving efficiency for job shop in manufacturing enterprise
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper aimed at the cylinder head processing production line of a small equipment manufacturing enterprise, established the discrete digital simulation model of production and analyze the existing bottlenecks in the production line through the simulation run. This study raises the corresponding optimal adjusting program in accordance with the need of workshop production, carries out the comparative analysis of the facts before and after the workshop production, determines a standard method of production and the process, and then achieves to improve the production efficiency at the workshop working level, through investigating and analyzing over the line, this paper showed some measures about improving efficiency using Petri net and witness software with actual conditions. Then construe the results about theoretic and figures. These methods improved the efficiency of enterprise after the enterprise using them.

articleTitle: Recognition of quality control chart patterns based on back propagation neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the off-line monitoring of the control characteristics of manufactured parts/products has usually been performed by establishing suitable quality control charts. The control charts as maintained would usually show various patterns and the analysis of such patterns would require human expertise so that suitable remedial actions can be taken. In the present paper, a maiden venture has to be taken to recognize various observable quality control chart patterns through the application of back propagation neural network technique. Various patterns like normal, cyclic, increasing/decreasing trend, upward/ downward shift etc. have been taken into consideration. Various known patterns have also been generated through the simulation and induction approach. The developed module has been tested and observed to be quite fast, accurate and flexible as it can be able to cope up with varying quality control chart patterns as encountered in real time manufacturing environment.

articleTitle: Assessment method research of the stock investment value based on niche
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Along with the mature of the China stock market day by day, as well as background of the internationalization and the marketability, the investment funds, the qualified foreign investor, society guarantees institutional investors and the insurance fund become the leading force of the stock market, which has made the market investment idea reformed. Therefore, our country stock market gradually changed from the to the fundamental plane analysis value investment way. Stock investment's primary purpose is the income, as a rational investor, what we must first choose is these the superior stock about fundamental planes. Therefore, assessment method research of the stock investment value is meaningful. Through using the niche, we evaluate the stock investment value of the corporation in china. Finally we gave the pointed investment countermeasure, which has a very vital role to stock market's steady progression and investor's income.

articleTitle: Research on a wear-law model based on fuzzy programming
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper proposes a fuzzy programming based wear-law model. Theoretical foundations, technical instructions are elaborated. And an application of cylinder wear modeling is presented to test the feasibility and reliability of the proposed model. It is proved that the proposed wear-law model is sufficient to describe a product's wear law as a fuzzy variant. This research offers an innovative instrument for wear law analysis.

articleTitle: Research the difference between different quality of investment on economic growth
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper starts from the traditional production function, searches to the decomposition according to the different quality in capital, induces a decomposition model of investment, and proves that the advantage of high-quality capital, reveals the difference effect of different quality of the capital on economic growth, so that entrepreneurs can able to improve the quality of invest in awareness.

articleTitle: Study on the cooperation mechanism for transformation of scientific and technological achievements
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the day of economic globalization, the ability of scientific and technological innovation is a measure of national comprehensiveness. The transformation of scientific and technological achievements which transformed the laboratory achievements into productive forces is an important part of the national innovation system. The successful transformation will directly determine the scale and efficiency of the scientific and technological innovation in a country. This paper regarded the transformation of scientific and technological achievements from the view of cooperation, analyzed its characteristics by using the complex adaptive system theory, and described its objective evolution laws. Then, the author defined the concept of cooperation entropy, and designed tripartite (universities, research institutions and enterprises) cooperation mechanism for income distribution based on the principle of maximum entropy, in older to ensure the cooperation system stable operates and evolve.

Author Keywords: The transformation of scientific and technological achievements

articleTitle: Value of information forecasting in a hybrid manufacturing/remanufacturing system with stochastic returns: A control engineering perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Our paper addresses the value of information forecasting (VOIF) the returns in a hybrid system with production leadtime larger than remanufacturing leadtime. We develop transfer function models by using control engineering methodology and then analyze the system's behavior in the case of using forecast information of returns or not. With the dynamic simulation data, we evaluate the VOIF by measuring the reduction in total expected costs. We find that under low uncertainty of returns, VOIF increases with increasing variance of returns; that is the larger the uncertainty, the larger the potential VOIF. However, under high uncertainty of returns, the larger the uncertainty, the less the potential VOIF is. In our opinion, the latter is caused by the substantial information distortion due to the high uncertainty of returns. Moreover, we also find that the larger the discrepancy between the production leadtime and remanufacturing leadtime, the larger the VOIF is. Our study shows that the discrepancy between leadtimes is very important for manufacturers' decision making, even more important than the uncertainty of returns.

articleTitle: Flexible sphere approach — A new dynamic organization structure
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The normal way by which the managers handle environment changes and the problems which exists during the product life cycle is just under original policy, so usually it cannot solve the problems essentially. This paper overviews the exiting organization structure, adopts a dynamic ideology to redesign the structure. Flexible Sphere Approach (F.S.A.) is a dynamic approach by which the managers can change the structure of the enterprise when they face some management problems. By this way the enterprise is in a dynamic state, so during the enterprise's developing period, the enterprise can utilize all kinds of the resources at a maximum extent, and avoids some problem which can't solve essentially.

articleTitle: Product design quality F-G evaluation in life cycle
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It is proved that the quality and cost of production is affected by the product design quality to a large extend, so the evaluation on product design is very necessary. The problem of traditional evaluation method is analyzed in this paper, and the conception of product design quality evaluation in life cycle is proposed. A flexible hierarchy evaluation index system structure is set up to support the computer-aided evaluation. According to the characteristic of evaluation index system the method of F-G (Fuzzy and Grey theory) evaluation is used, which provide a new method to realize the comprehensive evaluation of product design quality.

articleTitle: A study on application of design of experiments in GL company
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the production of pre-stressed steel strand, the key step of the process of hard-drawn is post-welding tempering. Almost 95% of the ruptures are caused by improper tempering. In this paper, with the support of the MINITAB software, we use tool of DOE to design and improve the tempering technology of cold drawing process in high speed wire rod of GL Company. The experiment table of fact-level was composed by 2 factors and 3 levels. We found the best combination of parameters of tempering through tests. As the results, the rate of nonperforming production declined significantly, the produce costs reduced and the company's competitiveness enhanced.

articleTitle: A study of multiperiod global supply chain network equilibrium model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, we develop a multitiered dynamic global supply chain network equilibrium model in which decision-makers determine their optimal strategies for seeking to maximize their profits over the multiperiod time planning horizon. Specifically, the model consists of three tiers of decision-makers: manufacturers, retailers and consumers at different demand markets, who compete within a tier but may cooperate between tiers. In a dynamic setting, we investigate the interplay of the various decision-makers, derive their optimality conditions, establish the equilibrium conditions, and provide the finite-dimensional variational inequality formulation which is then utilized to obtain qualitative property regarding to the existence of the equilibrium model under reasonable assumptions. Finally, a numerical example is considered and discussed for illustration purpose.

articleTitle: Analysis on the introduction of private capital into urban infrastructure and its conflict
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: China's urban infrastructure construction lagging behind the needs of social development. To accelerate the development of urban infrastructure will needed to introduce private capital. The financial difficulties caused by excessive reliance on government investment in construction of China's urban infrastructures are analyzed. The development ideas are put forward that urban infrastructure should be invested by more investor. Private capital should be introduced into the construction of urban infrastructure. Private capital and state-owned capital participate in the construction of urban infrastructure commonly must bound to have a conflict of interest. By the use of F-H method, the potential conflict of interest of the state-owned capital and private capital in the process of cooperation and its possible outcome is analyzed.

articleTitle: Moral risk management of open-ended fund based on dynamic game
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the perspective of dynamic game, an analysis on the main performance of moral risks of open-ended fund is made and a multi-stage dynamic co-operation game model of open-ended fund is given as well. Then deep-seated reasons that have hindered cooperative game of several parties and caused moral hazards to the open-ended funds are listed. In the end, countermeasures and suggestions to reduce the moral risks of open-ended fund are put forward.

articleTitle: A bidding strategy between agents based on double auction
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In some systems, running after a period of time, agents form cooperation partnership. However, there are two problems in the bidding strategy of double auction between cooperative agents. Firstly, the auctioneer or bidder can't make an effective response to the pricing program while the opposite changes itself strategy. Secondly, because of incomplete information, the bargain efficiency is low in equilibrium. Aimed at these problems, a conception of favor degree is presented from the views of both auctioneer and bidder, and it is used to simulate the stimulation of nerve cells. This paper brings forward a novel bidding strategy of double auction based on the favor degree, which makes the two agents call for the long-term interests rather than immediate interests. So this strategy enlarges the trading range and improves the trading efficiency. Finally, the validity of the model is proved by a case.

articleTitle: Research on the IE solution for design phase of engineering management in manufacturing sectors in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In this paper, the phenomena of poor functions of many new factory buildings are presented. The fundamental causes are negligence of importance of design in engineering management and lack of scientific design. This paper puts forward an industrial engineering (IE) solution for design phase of engineering management in manufacturing sectors in China. Because factory design involves many aspects, a multi-layer model for factory design is proposed. IE theories, principles and methods are extended into many layers of the model. A phase-wise model for implementing the IE solution is suggested. Based on our research, we come to a conclusion that engineering management needs scientific design, and in order to enhance design phase work of engineering management, it is possible and suitable to apply the IE solution to design phase of engineering management in manufacturing sectors in China.

articleTitle: Application study of uncoupling method based on axiomatic design and SIT
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper analyzes the inherent contradictions that exist in most of the conventional approaches disposing of dishware problem in student refectory, and presents an effective approach, based on axiomatic design (AD) and systematic inventive thinking (SIT). In the process of searching for a cost effective solution, the hierarchy framework of AD provides a framework for the application of SIT and a logical structure for problem orientation of SIT. SIT is introduced into the AD framework for removing functional dependency and searching for an uncoupled design, when the system hierarchy has been created and the interdependent functional requirements (FRs) have been found out by AD framework. SIT provides a set of thinking tools and principles. Thinking tools can lead designers to break the conventional thinking pattern and also shorten the path for a satisfied solution. Through the proposed uncoupling procedure, we can obtain a solution avoiding measuring functional dependency, harmonizing parameters, or searching substitutable technological ideas. The operational solution to dishware problem avoids the disadvantages of very poor cost effectiveness and crowded student refectory. The developed concept is based upon enlisting the students to disposing of the dishware problem successfully by taking away the dishware by the way after dinning. The detailed technological and operational concept is described, including: operation modes, implementation method, 3D representation of student refectory etc.

articleTitle: Study on environment-based manufacturing operational management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The fast development of manufacturing industry is greatly driving the Chinese economy. Meanwhile, a series of problems also come into sight, environmental problem has become the primary problem of the present manufacturing industry. The harmony between economic development and environmental protection will inevitably be considered by enterprises. Enterprises must pay more attention to environmental problem during their operations. The operational management of the manufacturing industry is analyzed from three macro-environmental prospective: natural environment, social environment and humanities environment. Some countermeasures are proposed, including green remanufacturing, environment operating, value readjusting and building the corporate culture of people-oriented.

articleTitle: Research on target markets decision for product innovation
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Segmentation of industrial markets is typically based on observable characteristics of firms such as their location and size. Indeed, the target market decision research for new product development primarily relies on experience. To improve the effectiveness and power of existing approaches to industrial market segmentation, The target market decision model for product innovation is presented and the market segment approach for mechanical product based on buyer firms' characteristic, suppliers firms' product characteristic and core technology characteristic is also proposed. And the mathematic model for target market decision is built. This technology makes the target market decision process operable. To test the effectiveness, a practical example of edge position automatic guiding control system is provided to illustrate the market segment, evaluation, and decision process.

articleTitle: Do fund managers window-dress their quarterly reports?: An empirical study of the quarter-end effect of the stocks invested heavily by open-end funds
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the employment of the event study approach and the Generalized Autoregressive Conditional Heteroskedasticity (GARCH) model» we analyzed the stocks listed in Shanghai Stock Exchange which were also invested heavily by all open-end equity funds in Shanghai and Shenzhen market. It shows that the abnormal returns (AR) generated by these stocks during the last trading week in every quarter are statistically positive and the average AR of the last three days is obviously much higher than that of the first two days in the same week. We interpret this as the evidence of the "quarter-end effect" in Chinese stock market and indirectly demonstrate the window-dressing behavior of the fund managers.

articleTitle: Research on the effect of life cycle gaps on life cycle cost of urban infrastructure engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Life Cycle Cost optimization has become a new focus of urban infrastructure engineering economic study. This paper shows the replacement reasons and preferences related to the different type of life cycle by studying literatures. It is clear by analyzing a basic LCC model that sensitivity of the LCC functions on life cycle gaps is less than the discount rate when life period is longer, so the life cycle seems to be a secondary factor for LCC optimization. But some special replacement projects have been found by an empirical study on some subway engineering assets. The results have demonstrated that the deviation between predicted and actual life greatly affected the LCC of subway engineering, and these gaps mainly contributed the recurring investment to the LCC. A new concept of built environment life cycle is put forward.

articleTitle: Research on negative entropy of high-tech virtual enterprise based on dissipative structure
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The process and condition of forming dissipative structure of high-tech virtual enterprise is researched based on dissipative structure theory. Negative entropy models of the organizational structure of high-tech virtual enterprise are set up and the calculated formulas of time efficacy entropy and quality entropy with maneuverability are described, then an example of high-tech virtual enterprise is validated by the models and formulas, these methods solve the problem of evaluation and selection of organizational structure of high-tech virtual enterprise.

articleTitle: Analysis on supply chain information sharing based on game theory
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the competition of globalization, supply chain strategic alliance is becoming an effective supply chain management strategic. Information sharing of the companies in supply chain is also becoming more and more important. In the background of the rapid development of information technology, there are a lot of factors hampering the information sharing in the companies. The paper analyzes the information sharing in the companies of competition and cooperation with the game theory, and gives corresponding strategies. The research of information sharing will greatly improve competition of companies in supply chain strategic alliance.

articleTitle: A joint decision model of product variety, inventory control and pricing
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The problem of jointly determining the product variety decision with inventory control decision and pricing decision for different items of a certain brand product is studied in this paper. The market demand of this assortment of products is described as a function of time, price, seasonal factor and random factor, and the total profit of this brand and its service level at the retailer are both given. Based on it, a nonlinear integer programming model to maximize total multi-period profits subject to given stocking space, budgetary and service level constraints is established. The computational results show that by using this joint decision model, the profit of the retailer could be 5 times more than the before. The result shows that as the centralized coordinator, the manufacturer will enhance greatly the whole system's competence of obtaining profit by taking the profit maximization of distribution system as its' strategic goal.

articleTitle: A new perspective of establishing the index system of public project performance appraising — Based on the analysis to the stakeholders in project life-cycle
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The index system for public project performance appraisement is the criterion for evaluating the performance of a project, thereby is one of the key factors which affect the quality of project performance appraisement. After a brief review of researches on public project performance index, a new method to establish the index system is raise, in which Theory of Stakeholders is used. The meaning of performance of a public project is interpreted as that, to which degree the needs from the stakeholders of it have been satisfied. So to get the index system, the core value of the public project is firstly formed by identifying the key stakeholders and the needs appeal from them. And then the indexes of the public project performance are obtained accordingly. By this method, the index system for public project performance is established top-down. Therefore, the established index system based on the analysis of stakeholders in life-cycle of public project is a multi-dimensional and Multi-view one, which is hence of great scientificity and systematicness.

articleTitle: Study on the index system of performance evaluation of engineering projects
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on combination of related foreign theories and engineering practices in China, an index system of project performance evaluation, including quality of engineering projects, degree of customers' satisfaction, social benefits and considerations of environments, has been explored and constructed. Furthermore, we applied the index system of performance evaluation to some cases according to their actual situations. The effectiveness of the index system of engineering projects was confirmed.

articleTitle: Application of fractal theory in vender selection
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Vendor selection is one of the critical activities for firms to gain competitive advantage and achieve the objectives of the whole supply chain. Fractal model is proposed in this paper for solving the vendor selection problem from the multidimensional angle, which indicates the inner relationship between fractal dimension and excellent degree of vendor. Finally, the example indicates that the model is simple and convenient. It can effectively reduce subjective effect in the course of evaluation, and it can overall and objectively evaluate the vendor.

articleTitle: Study on electronics recycling process
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The discarding of electronics is a growing problem around the world. This paper first analyzes the possible limitations in current electronics recycling models and methods through the review of the literature, and this paper then presents a study of the complete electronics recycling process based on electronics features. The five main stages in the recycling process are described: collection, product recovery, component recovery, material recovery, and energy recovery. During each recycling stage, the work involved, the advanced techniques may be used, and the tools conducting the work are detailed discussed. Finally this paper presents conclusions and recommendations for conducting effective and efficient electronics recycling.

articleTitle: Analysis and thoughts for China's problems in global collaboration and communication
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the development process of human society, we will face more and more common problems such as energy, war, disease, protection of the environment and international terrorism. In order to promote the common development and progress of mankind, global collaboration and communication is particularly important. In this article, we analyze the China's problems in current global collaboration and communication, then probe into the deep-seated causes of the occurrence of such problems, lastly, we provide some constructive thoughts and countermeasures on how to establish a health, reasonable and orderly way to collaborate and keep the channel of communication unblocked. People should insist the principle of mutual learning and mutual assistance in the process of global collaboration and communication and emphasize national self-confidence, establish a stronger national awareness and management capacity, control the speed of development, so that the whole world can develop toward a healthy and orderly direction.

articleTitle: Supply chain management modes and their essential attributes
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The importance of supply chain management (SCM) is well recognized, but there is lots of confusion about it in academia and business community. This paper discusses the SCM modes in the perspective of logistics, organization, operation management and strategy management respectively, and summaries the common attributes of SCM modes. The results can be useful to better grasp the implications and significance of SCM.

articleTitle: The syncretism of capital structure theory: An explanation from adjustment speed of capital structure
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper established dynamic adjustment model of capital structure and analyzed the factors affecting the adjustment speed of capital structure. Based on the unbalanced panel data of Chinese nonfinancial listed companies from 1997 to 2006, this empirical study shows that all dynamic tradeoff theory, pecking-order theory and market-timing theory can explain the adjustment speed of capital structure in some degree, though the three theories have different theoretical basis. If a company dynamically adjusts its capital structure, then its target capital structure is decided based on dynamic tradeoff theory, its adjustment approaches is decided based on pecking-order theory, and its adjustment time is decided based on market-timing theory. So it is necessary to combine the three theories to analyze the determinants and adjustment of capital structure.

articleTitle: Uncertain risks control in the industrial Chain based on the complex network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: From a brand new view of complex network, this paper abstracts the topological structure and dynamic mechanism of industry chain to expatiate the network relation formation and characteristics of industry chain. It points out industry chain has such characteristics of complex network as microcosm and scale-free. Therefore, the conception system and structure of industry chain are proposed. On the basis of analyzing the influence of disaster crisis on industry system, the stability to resist random attack or malicious destruction of industry chain were analyzed and the result is obtained that the robustness and weakness of industry chain under random attack or malicious destruction. The weakness of core enterprises in industry chain under external attack was stated and it is highlighted the importance of promoting core enterprises to react crisis. This paper also depicted the spread and the control of uncertainty of industry network under crisis. Disease spread model is utilized to analyze the spread of uncertainty in industry chain, measure the threshold value to prevent the spreading of crisis, as well to provide theory foundation for stability of industry chain as a whole.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation indicator system for construction of demonstrative small towns in Tianjin by utilizing AHP
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: During the past years Tianjin's small town construction has made outstanding achievements and has owned special features and characteristics. For the sake of harmonious sustainable development of economy and society, to measure periodically the value of performance of demonstrative small town construction and the effect of the "demonstration" tends to be very important.
