This paper utilizes AHP, Delphi method and MATLAB software to establish a set of evaluation indicators for the relevant purposes aiming at helping decision makers develop strategic plan and tactical programs in the concerning field in the future. Twenty indicators are carefully selected according to principles of recycling economy. The procedure of producing weights of indicators basing on AHP is concretely illustrated. Finally, the paper points out that construction of demonstrative small towns should be planned from high starting point, designed in superior level, and implemented in high quality, in accordance with requirements of establishing environment friendly society.

articleTitle: Conformation of express delivery service provider based on a two-stage method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: There are three main types of service provider in China's express delivery market, namely China EMS, International express Giant and private express company. Due to their distinct characters on price, service level, infrastructure and other aspects, they are adopted by different customers. Considering the variety of service requirement, a configuration structure of potential alternative providers should be established. In this paper, a two-stage approach composed of Analytic Network Process (ANP) and Goal Programming (GP) is proposed. In the first stage, due to interdependence and feedbacks among the evaluation index elements ANP method is utilized to find a proper weight rank for each alternative. Furthermore, to realize a branch of multiobjective optimization Goal Programming helps determine the accurate business distribution proportion for each candidate company. Finally, a client company has been simulated by this approach.

articleTitle: The impact of network tie and organizational learning ability on knowledge diffusion through focal firms
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This article investigates effects of network tie and organizational learning capacity on knowledge diffusion through focal firms in industrial cluster. Results show that: the strength of network tie to be a direct driving force in knowledge diffusion through focal firms while organizational learning capacity is also directly involved in pushing the process along. This conclusion is supported by an analysis of a multi-case study.

articleTitle: Research on separate production workshop dynamic productive plan and real-time monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This system will enhance the production efficiency and the management level of separate production workshop. It makes up the flaw in the ERP implementation process and proposes the more concrete data acquisition and the control method in view of the production. This method implementation will be able to cause the planned time fixed quantity to be more accurate gradually and cause the plan and the control to be more convenient and accurate. So it provides the basis for the work norm formulation and the achievements inspection.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of Verhulst-type kinetics with poisson white noise
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A new numerical method is developed for finding response samples for a Verhulst-type system subjected to Poisson white noise. The method based on the three following steps: first, zero-one jump law was used to generate the sample paths of Poisson white noise, which worked as the system inputs, then the classical Heun method was used to calculate the system outputs corresponding to the generated input samples, and last we estimated the response statistics from repeating sample outputs by previous steps. The accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method are examined by Verhulst-type systems driven by Poisson white noise.

articleTitle: Analysis of influencing factors in real estate prices based on stochastic gradient regression model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The components of house prices and several main influencing factors partially affected by the policies in the market price system were analyzed in this thesis. Then the stochastic gradient regression theory was introduced briefly. The method of the stochastic gradient regression was taken to analyze the real data of Tianjin commercial real estate sale prices in the past decade. The relativity analysis results of the factors influencing housing prices in Tianjin were shown by using stochastic gradient regression model according to the relevant data of Tianjin housing prices after 1998. The influencing degree that the main factors affected the changes of Tianjin commercial real estate prices during the recent years were explained in detail and concluded in this paper.

articleTitle: A study on return policy considering the disposal cost and efficiency of the dead stock
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Study on the pricing and order problem of a decentralized supply chain composed of a manufacturer and a retailer. In this supply chain, the manufacturer acts as the leader of the Stackelberg game and makes decisions for the whole supply chain benefits. Considering the return cost and the disposal efficiency of the dead stock, we built the model of the return policy and theoretically analyzed the application conditions. When the return policy is not applicable, we suggested using mark down money contract instead of the return policy to coordinate the supply chain. At last, we confirmed the two contracts with numerical examples.

articleTitle: Study on optimization of scientific resource evaluation methods
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Scientific resource evaluation has become a major means for the effectiveness of scientific activities as well as an important tool for governments making scientific plans. This paper based on the idea of composition of scientific evaluation system to build a strong and universal set of scientific resource evaluation indicator system. By separately empowered the quantitative and qualitative indicators with the coefficient variation method and ordering relational analysis method, the evaluation system was optimized, thus the complexity of calculation process of scientific resource evaluation was greatly simplified, and the comparability and objectivity of the evaluation results were enhanced. Empirically analyzed Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Liaoning region, and then gave some suggestions to improve the effectiveness of scientific activities.

articleTitle: The research on off-farm employment services of rural labors
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The off-farm employment services of rural labors have great importance to increase the rural labors' income and lessen the difference between the urban and rural. The paper firstly analyzes the demands of the off-farm employment service and its contents: employment services, training services, rights maintenance and social security services, and cultural life services. Then it refers to the current problems from the institutional, economic and managerial perspective. Lastly it gives the advice on policy: reforming registration system and employment system of rural labors, increasing the government's investment and financial support to off-farm employment services, setting up united department and the related employment service system.

articleTitle: A contingency view of the research framework of knowledge acquisition based on the oversea embedding of Chinese high-tech firms
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Under the background of low income of high-tech industry based on the mode of FDI, and Chinese firms gradually lose out in the competition of the high-tech product export, we construct a research framework of knowledge acquisition abroad by the oversea-embedding of high-tech firms base on the contingency view and the theory of new economic-sociology.

articleTitle: The determinants of transformation and upgrading of China processing trade
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Processing trade is an important way for China to participate in the international division of labor. Under the rising world financial crisis, the Chinese processing trade meets opportunities and challenges for transformation and upgrading. This paper does the empirical research on the factors affecting the transformation and upgrading of processing trade in China by using the multi-linear regression model and the relative data from 2003 to 2007. Through the empirical study we find that the major influencing factors of China processing trade structure are science and technology level, education level, RMB exchange rate and FDI. The science and technology level showed a positive correlation with the processing trade appreciation rate, whereas RMB exchange rate and FDI showed a negative correlation with it.

articleTitle: The research on Xiao Long Mine's estimating cost & strategic cost management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper analyzes the theory on SCM The object is the Xiao Long Mine's cost expediture constitution. It formed a way, the work flow model analysis tool, estimating the cost of Xiao Long Mine. This way is combined with the theories of ABC, TOC and SCMIn conclusion, it clarifies the improvement on account issue concerning the activity and convergence character.

articleTitle: Analytics on historical data using a clustered insert-only in-memory column database
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the field of OLAP and data warehousing, column stores and compressed main-memory data storage technology have successfully been implemented in products that enable a significant speed improvement of analytical queries with special performance requirements. We could soon see the majority of analytical workloads move to such main-memory based systems. Having one specialized OLAP DBMS explicitly aimed at performing ad-hoc queries on an ever-growing database requires the capability of an in-memory database to retain historical states so that applications can calculate consistent values based on previous states of the database, a requirement often found in financial and production planning analytical applications. This paper describes Rock, an in-memory analytics cluster based on a column store database, and proposes an architecture for historical query support as well as the prototypical implementation in Rock.

articleTitle: Driving effect on price variety from involvement degree and price perception experience
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Consumer price behavior is the practical origin of price variety. Consumer price overall perception can be jointly expressed by price cheapness, price fairness and price variety. Price variety is an important dimension of price evaluation, and consumer's involvement degree and price perception experience as price environmental factor can affect price evaluation. In order to explore the relationship between price behavior and price evaluation, this research examines the influential characteristics on price variety evaluation from involvement degree and perception experience, which chooses consumer price behavior in using mobile phone as testing object. Result shows that involvement degree positively impacts price variety, whereas price perception experience negatively influences price variety. This contribution brings theoretical researcher and practitioner from qualitative perception of consumer price behavior character up to quantitative evaluation and managerial level.

articleTitle: An analysis of service quality's impact on relationship quality: Taking the certification industry as an example
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper adopts the certification industry as the case, in the B2B context, and defines three dimensions of relationship quality (cooperation, adaptability and atmosphere) and four dimensions of service quality ('hard' process quality, 'soft' process quality, potential service capability and outcome quality). Further, this paper analyzes service the quality's impact on relationship quality, and states four related issues and builds a conceptual structural model. The analysis show that 'hard' process quality and outcome quality have positive impact on relationship quality, and 'soft' process quality and potential service capability have not significant impact on relationship quality. Finally, this research proposes some recommendation for management practice.

articleTitle: MMSE soft-interference-cancellation aided MCMC detection for MIMO systems
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A novel MCMC detection algorithm in MEMO systems is proposed. The Gibbs samples are initialized through a new way after integrating the Minimum Mean Square Error soft-interference-cancellation (SIC-MMSE) algorithm and the convergence of the Markov chain is accelerated. Comparison with the conventional MCMC algorithm shows the novel algorithm performs better with equal number of Gibbs samples, that is, equal complexity. It is proved that our proposed SIC-MMSE-aided MCMC algorithm has superior performance.

articleTitle: Dynamic alliance partner selection and its negotiation strategy based on agent and resources
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The rapid development of Internet technology has facilitated formation of cooperation and dynamic alliance between enterprises. Enterprises have realized that it's important and necessary for them to build competitive dynamic alliance which depends largely upon whether the leader enterprise can find the best partner. This paper elaborates the concept, criteria and phases of dynamic alliance partner selection. Then it designs a negotiation strategy based on resources and Agent. Our research provides valuable reference for future studies. It can help enterprise to realize sharing business resources, increase the efficiency of choosing allied partners and enhance the competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Research on online consumer behavior based on experience
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Using flow as a viable describing experience by online consumers, an online consumer behavior model is developed from consumer's perception perspective. Based on this, the paper discusses which attributes would make consumers feel an experience of flow and whether creating pleasant shopping experience for consumers just as in the traditional environment would increase consumers' purchasing intention. The empirical analysis by SEM (Structural Equation Modeling) shows that perceived system quality's effect is greater on flow than perceived information quality. Having a feeling of flow can increase consumer's purchasing intention. But its effect on purchasing intention is not as strong as initial trust.

articleTitle: On value-creating of knowledge capital: Theoretical model and case study
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The firm's profit is up to the market demand curve and the cost curve, which is affected by all kinds of knowledge capital that are employed by the firm, including technology capital, organization capital and market capital. It is demonstrated by a model that all kinds of knowledge capital depend on one another in value creation, and the firm's profit will be maximal in case that the production scale based on organization capital and the market size based on market capital match well. A case implies that the firm's competitive advantage will be lost even if one kind of knowledge capital is insufficient, and confirms the conclusion derived from the model.

articleTitle: Analysis of influencing factors and mechanism for repurchase price in BT project
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: BT model is widely introduced into infrastructure project (IP) in China. The core issue in the operation process of BT project is that the government sector's confirmation of the repurchase price (RP) and payment methods influences the interests of both sides. However, the theoretical studies and relevant legal system on the issues above are relatively insufficient. This paper defines the concepts of BT operation models and repurchase price in BT project, and analyzes the influencing factors, including the methods of investing funds, construction period, engineering change, benchmark interest rate and investment rate of return (IRR), RP payment methods, repurchase period etc. Through the analyzing of their mechanism and example calculation of the repurchase price, this paper comes out a well targeted contract control strategy on the basis of RP control purpose. The results may have a strong guiding significance in theoretical studies and practical operation of BT model's application in China.

articleTitle: Study on the impact mechanism of operations research to the strategic performance of nonprofit organization
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Nonprofit Organization is playing a big role in the modern society, and the performance appraisal of nonprofit organization is a complicated problem because of its commonweal. In business sector, operations research has been used widely to improve performance, and then brings forward sustainable competitive advantage. This paper figures that operations research can enhance the strategic performance of nonprofit organization, and establishes a model of impact mechanism of operations research to the strategic performance of nonprofit organization.

articleTitle: The study of trends in the structure of the Pig supply chain upstream view-based transaction costs
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Pig supply chain make up of three nodes, piglet supplier, pig cultivation, and butchering & processing factory. The upstream is mean from piglet supplier to pig cultivation. There are two types structure in the upstream pig supply chain in mainland china. The first one is the distribution channel mode that there has a dealer between pig raiser and piglet supplier, also named traditional mode. The second one is direct selling mode that the supplier sell piglets to raiser directly, also named scaled cultivation mode. This paper analyzed transaction attribute of two modes from three aspect: Asset Specificity, Trading Frequency, Uncertainty in exchange. Then, build the transaction cost function with the transaction size as parameter, and compare the transaction cost between those two types upstream structure. The conclusion is that with the cultivation scale enlarges; the structure of upstream pig supply chain is changing from distribution channel mode to direct selling mode. In the end, use a numerical experiment to illustrate the conclusion.

articleTitle: The importance of spin-off companies in R&D activities
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This research paper is about to examine the role of spin-off companies in research and development. The paper emphasizes the success factors (closeness to parent institutions, founder's competencies, life experience, R&D capacity, industrial concentration) in spin-off development. We introduce ELINOR Engineering Ltd., a Hungarian technology-oriented spin-off company, which can be seen as a good case for a successful spin-off company. The company initiated a new project in healthcare, which aims to develop duplex threaded fixing screw for more efficient curing of femoral fractures. The project is characterized by pronounced interdisciplinarity linking traumatology, technology engineering and business management. The paper shows the development of this project by emphasizing the success factors of spin-off companies.

articleTitle: A discussion on three critical issues for assuring quality of the users' requirements specification
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The paper tries to step in a forbidden area of software engineering - to achieve the users' requirements specification of ideal quality in DIRPT (do it right the first time) way. The key idea happens to be a trilogy: modeling business relevant to the purpose of the software to be developed with a compact business model, defining a complete set of inhomogeneous users in conformity with the business model, and eliciting user's requirements by strictly adhering to correspondent user's definition. The result seems encouraging.

articleTitle: Application of stochastic frontier analysis in survey and design market management system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In China, more and more building safety problems and disputes about the quality of buildings have occurred. It's important to enhance the management of the building design enterprises. Connecting "Bad Record" to the level of building design enterprises, we construct the management system of survey and design market and a new dynamic management mode, and stochastic frontier analysis (SFA) method is used to evaluate building design enterprises based on the result of stepwise regression. By using it, technique efficiencies of building design enterprises in Tianjin are calculated, and it supplies theoretical basis to the management of building design enterprises. It is useful to solve building safety problems.

articleTitle: Realized range-based beta and its application in Chinese stock market
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In recent years, research on high frequency data has been a new research field in financial econometrics. In this paper, we put forward realized range-based beta to estimate the beta by using high-frequency data. By using high-frequency data, we can fully take advantage of the intraday information of the stock market. We cast our analysis of realized range-based beta within the framework of realized range-based variance and realized range-based covariance. Realized range-based variance and realized range-based covariance are unbiased estimators of variance and covariance. Our approach makes the beta observable and model-free. Our empirical analysis is based on high frequency data from the Chinese stock market — Shenzhen stock market. We further explore the dynamic nature of realized range-based beta. Through the empirical analysis, we indicate that realized range-based beta of the stock listed in Shenzhen stock market is time-varying and persistent.

articleTitle: Research of countermeasure and emulational analyse for restraining innovation inertia in enterprises basing on systemic theories
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Innovation inertia often blocks new innovation mode to form after enterprises' succeeding in innovation, which depress the ability enterprises' adapting to changes of market. In this article author analyzes the causes of formation of innovation inertia, and puts forward countermeasure restraining innovation inertia using systemic theories for reference, creating the simulating model by the methods of systems archetype and level variables and rate variables fundamental in-tree modeling of System Dynamics, which is used to test the effect of countermeasures for restraining the innovation inertia.

articleTitle: Optimization model of coal mine roadway layout system based on evidence theory and its application
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: China's coal mine roadway layout systems are complicated, multi-production and poor matching. And thus affect the overall effectiveness of the coal production logistics system. Although the research content on coal mine logistics system at home and abroad are many, however, research on the optimization method of coal mine roadway layout system are very few. In this paper, we did an in-depth analysis on coal mine roadway layout system, established an optimization factors system of coal mine roadway layout system, and determined the relative weight of the influencing factors at each levels using analytic hierarchy process to according to experts' advices. At the same time, by introducing D-S evidence theory in this article, we established optimization model of coal mine roadway layout system and described its application process through empirical analysis. Finally, the results of the discussion can provide the optimization and transform of coal mine roadway layout systems in practice with a theoretical basis.

articleTitle: Empirical study on governance mode of supply chain
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the past two decades, supply chain cooperation has emerged rapidly and formed the important source of corporate competitive advantages. By using the survey of supply chain alliances, and by combining transaction cost economics (TCE) and relational contract theory (RCT), the authors analyze governance modes of supply chain as well as their influencing factors. First, the authors analyze the risk rising from supply chain transaction, and develop several basic theoretical hypotheses on governance mode choice of supply chain. Then by using the survey data of 159 supply chain alliances in China and by applying logit model, the authors empirically test the hypotheses. The emperical results show that asset specialty, uncertainty and relationship are critical factors that influence governance mode of supply chain. With the increase of asset specificity, uncertainty (or complexity) surrounding the transaction, partners are more likely to choose equity governance mode; whereas firms with prior ties or long cooperative history are more likely to choose non-equity governance mode. Finally, the authors discuss the empirical results and propose some suggestion for future research.

articleTitle: Research and implementation of distributed platform for collaborative design
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Collaborative design is an engineering process that involves decision-making through iterative communication and coordination among product designers throughout the lifecycle of product. In order to increasing openness and flexibility, a framework of distributed platform for collaborative design based on Web services and Agent technology is proposed. Web services are the foundation of system, and Agent technology is applied to accessing and updating information. Subsequently, the structure and communication of Agent is studied, and dynamic behavior of system is described and designed. Finally, deployment and achievement of a system prototype shows the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Prediction by artificial neural network on China's freight traffic from 1995 to 2007
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The forecasting to a nation's freight and its turnover is an important thing for the development of transportation industry and even national economy. Based on the analysis using Backpropagation Algorithm in artificial neural network and time series forecasting methods in Microsoft Excel to China's transportation volume from 1995 to 2007, the paper try to find the algorithm to effectively predict transportation every year, and then predict the transportation volume of the year 2008.

articleTitle: Research on efficiency of information transfer in cardiac emergency process based on Markov hybrid model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It is the base of a successive cardiac emergency (CE) treatment to architect a rapid cardiac emergency information transfer process with high efficiency and high quality. Aiming at the shortage of quantitative method to diagnose the process of CE, a hybrid method was presented, in which time Petri nets (TPN) was used to model the process of CE and ABC-Markov process was adopted to diagnose quantitatively. As a result, the bottlenecks of the efficiency of information transfer of CE were found. And on this base, the bottlenecks were optimized based on the theory of BPR. As a result, the time of CE treatment was shortened and the success rate was raised.

articleTitle: Evaluation model of manufacturing technological learning and product innovation performance
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Technological learning is the most effective way for China manufacturing enterprises to learn advanced technology at home and abroad. Meanwhile, it is the best way to achieve more autonomic technological innovation and enhance the development competitiveness and sustainability. Product innovation performance can be positively affected by the knowledge source of technological learning, the content of technological learning, the subject of technological learning, the environment of technology learning, the technical capability, which are analyzed for the impact factors and the degree on the operable level, and the evaluation model of manufacturing technological learning and product innovation performance are established. In this text, the comprehensive evaluation ideas of structural equation model testing and osculating value method are put forward, and operable suggestion on improving product innovation are offered.

articleTitle: Reliability allocation using analytical target cascading method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Analytical target cascading (ATC) is a methodology for translating system design targets to design specifications for the elements comprising a decomposed engineering system. The paper introduces ATC to the application on the reliability allocation and presented a new algorithm based on exterior penalty function, called ATC-EPF. The method can deal with huge scale reliability allocation problem by the decomposition and coordination of targets between upper and lower level. The examples in the paper show that the proposed method can achieve good results as the same as the all-in-one method.

articleTitle: A hierarchy method for TFT-LCD production chain planning
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the demands of TFT-LCD (Thin Film Transistor Liquid Crystal Display) increasing, the enterprise are necessary to expand their capacity by adding more plants, which leads to the change from single site planning to multi-stage multi-site planning. According to the characteristics of manufacturing process, a hierarchical planning framework is discussed which consisted of three layers involve: multi-stage planning, multi-site planning and single factory planning. For each layers, due to the different optimization objective, different optimization method is proposed. And a communication mechanism is discussed for the layers' communication. At the end, how to integrated with the ERP (enterprise resource planning) system is also discussed.

articleTitle: Visualization of researcher's knowledge structure based on knowledge network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to promote intuition and accuracy of researcher's knowledge representation, this paper is focused on the visualization of knowledge structure based on knowledge network. According to the system science theory, the composition of researcher's knowledge structure is analyzed. A model of researcher's knowledge network which represents researcher's knowledge structure is proposed. This model includes knowledge points, knowledge stocks and relationship between knowledge points. After modeling process of knowledge network which includes modeling of knowledge points, calculating of knowledge stocks, modeling of relationship and hierarchical processing of knowledge network, researcher's knowledge fields and knowledge sub fields can be discovered. A researcher's knowledge management prototype system is developed based on the above method. The method makes researcher's knowledge structure visualized intuitively, objectively and quantitatively, which is validated by a case in the end.

articleTitle: An approach to derive strategy set in supply chain management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The supply chain (SC) uncertainties are predicted from historical data is proved to be not the best way, and an integrated approach or model to assort with the overall decision problems is lacking in current SC management region. To solve above problems, a new approach for deriving the optimal strategy sets is proposed via the principle of BCC formation introduced by Banker, Chames and Cooper with the technique of assurance region in data envelopment analysis (DEA). The proposed model reflects not only the technique efficiencies but also the scale efficiencies, which may provide much helpful information for decision-making. Applied to a simulation example, the presented approach is proved to be reasonable and well applicable.

articleTitle: The influencing mechanism of personality traits on team performance: An empirical study based on creative product development project
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The previous researches on influencing factors of team performance mainly focus on its direct influencing factors such as personality traits, ability, team member role, mutual trust atmosphere, cooperation and conflict management but seldom on the mechanism among them. Using data from a nationwide survey of 238 team members of creative product development, we use teamwork quality(communication, coordination, balance of member contributions, mutual support, cohesion)as the mediator and quantiflcationally analyze the effects of personality traits (emotional stability, extraversio¿n, agreeableness, openness to experience, and conscientiousness)on team performance(team efficiency, team effect). The result shows that personality traits influence team performance by influencing teamwork quality and teamwork quality plays a completely mediator role between personality traits and team performance. We also discuss the implications of this study for research and practice and conclude with suggestions for future research directions.

articleTitle: A method and its application for business-process oriented knowledge classification
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Knowledge classification is a key step to establish enterprise knowledge bases. The business process oriented knowledge classification method is the most efficient way to integrate knowledge management and business process systems. The method is also oriented by knowledge application optimization. There are two phases, first of all, enterprise knowledge and business process pattern sets are expressed and built by meta-knowledge, then we search knowledge related to them by pattern match algorithms. Empirical works have proved this method is well-operated, and when enterprise meta-knowledge is precise enough, the accuracy of classification is well-acceptable in practice conditions.

articleTitle: Research on the integration of the methods of enterprise value stream and material flow — Based on the theory of lean production and circular economy
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Enterprises are faced with the dual pressures of reducing costs and saving energy and reducing pollution; yet it is entirely possible that the cost and pollution at the same time are cut down through enterprises' technological innovation and management innovation. Based on this idea, the authors tried to integrate the methods of value stream and material flow, simultaneously identifying and monitoring costs and pollution problems. In the basis of in-depth study up on value stream and material flow, it had been confirmed that the integration of value stream mapping and material flow analysis is necessary and feasible, and the integrated framework of the both had been represented in this paper.

articleTitle: Study on cost-control of supply chain based on the decision tree
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Nowadays, with the intense competition resulting from the changes of global competitive environment, the supply chain management idea is playing an increasingly important role in the competitiveness of enterprises. And cost control has become urgent to improve the performance of supply chain problems. This paper takes decision tree method to analyze the cost of supply chain, determines the standard cost reasonably and discusses the effective strategy for cost-control of supply chain. As a result, it can help enterprises, especially the SME to carry out more convenient and efficient cost control measures.

articleTitle: Enterprise data management in mixed workload environments
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Enterprise applications are presently built on a 20year old data management infrastructure that was designed to meet a specific set of requirements for OLTP systems. In the meantime, enterprise applications have become more sophisticated, data set sizes have increased, requirements on the freshness of input data have been strengthened, and the time allotted for completing business processes has been reduced. To meet these challenges, enterprise applications have become increasingly complicated to make up for short-comings in the data management infrastructure. This paper outlines the characteristics of enterprise application with regards to the underlying data management layer. We also propose a database design perfectly fit to the demanded requirements of enterprise applications.

articleTitle: Studies on the emergency response ability evaluation of gas pipeline leakage accident based on Gl
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to improve the operations and management capacity of gas leak accident emergency plans, reduce accident losses, it is necessary to do an evaluation of emergency response capability to provide decision-making basis for emergency command. Based on the characteristics of dialectical and logic process, Expanding the emergency response ability evaluation study with systematic and integrated, having selected 7 head indicators, 31 secondary indicators, construct the level of gas leakage accident emergency structure; to base on Gl and Tianjin area gas pipeline emergency response capacity with the object, calculate the weights determination at all levels, proposed and set up an emergency response capability evaluation index system. This approach don't need consistency test and may be feasible, has been very good authentication at emergency capacity assessment. Through the indicators and the Gl on the evaluation of indicators that can clearly reflect a business or government department to deal with unexpected incidents ability.

articleTitle: The examination of the role of desired organizational capabilities (DOCs) in readiness for implementing of BPR
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to propose how to enhance the chance of success implementation of BPR by measuring required capabilities and fill the gap in the literature on decreasing risk in BPR projects by introducing a BPR readiness and implementing assessment approach. For this purpose, the paper proposes a self-assessment approach and generic questionnaire for readiness and implementing in BPR efforts based on the desired organizational capabilities (DOCs). A relevant literature review, which investigates required capabilities in BPR efforts, is carried out and a new categorized list of indicators are proposed. Readiness and implementing indicators are determined based on DOCs. These indicators include twenty one categories. So, this paper reports survey results indicating BPR readiness and implementing in three Iranian organizations. After comparing the position of the three cases, the paper offers several guidelines for amplifying the success points and decreasing failure points and hence, increasing the rate of success before and during implementation.

articleTitle: Coordinating three-level supply chain with disruption by buyback contracts
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The three-level supply chain can be coordinated by buyback contracts under some settings. But if a demand disruption happened, the coordination may be broken off. In this paper, we investigated the impact of demand disruptions to the three-level supply chain. Using buyback contracts, we designed an improved mechanism to coordinate the supply chain. The validity of the result is illustrated by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Technology road-mapping for local industrial value chain upgrading: A preliminary framework
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Local industrial value chain (LIVC) upgrading under global value chain (GVC) is investigated. Four trajectories of LIVC upgrading are distinguished: link upgrading, scope upgrading, structural upgrading, and chain upgrading. A preliminary framework of technology road-mapping for LIVC upgrading is proposed, comprised of five layers: value chain, value chain upgrading trajectory, technology trajectory, learning and innovation, and technology resources. Based on this framework, the changing trends of the drivers in GVC could be identified and forecasted to aid the definition of the upgrading objectives, the selection of the upgrading trajectories, and the determination of the technology trajectories; learning and innovation programs could then be planned accordingly, and the related technology resources could be coordinated and allocated consequently. The proposed framework can support local industrial technology policy-making and provide guidance to the technological learning and innovation activities of the local industry.

articleTitle: Based on cooperative game theory of chain enterprises purchase alliance and income distribution
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: How to allocate the profits from cooperative purchasing is a key factor to the formation and maintaining of aconsortium. In this paper, according to the characteristics of joint procurement. Established a cooperative game model-Union game model o Analysised several methods based on cooperative game theory of the distribution of benefits. According to the model of Heijboer and Fredo Schotanus. Explored the joint procurement and distribution of benefits, Take a practical example of Corporate joint procurement as an example. Analysised PV, SV and CV of three distribution methods. Concluded that the method of CV which can provide guidance for the enterprise when they are make decision-making in Purchasing Alliance.

articleTitle: Transit lines optimization model research based on the lowest total cost of hybrid hub-and-spoke road freight transport network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Increased competition in the transport market has led to more focus on enterprise's logistics network. To build and improve the integration of logistics network is regarded as the key way to improve supply chain efficiency. This paper firstly focuses on the hub-and-spoke network structure which is widely used in road freight transport system, and by taking into account the restriction of sole service characteristics and service capacity limit, puts forward a hybrid hub-and-spoke network structure to optimize the road freight transport network; then, the paper sets up the total cost model of the network and carries on scientific quantization to every combination of the cost through exhaustive analysis to the cost; lastly, the paper introduces a (0,1) optimization mathematics model to optimize the transit lines based on the lowest total cost of hybrid hub-and-spoke network structure. A practical application to a third-party logistics provider is also described.

articleTitle: Building fire rescue with evacuation management information system and its application
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Building Fire Rescue with Evacuation Management Information System (BFREMIS) is established. And the evacuation model of BFREMIS was analyzed and presented in this paper. Based on the constructed network model, the evacuation of the teaching building in the university was analyzed by using the software EVACNET4. The analysis items included: the total evacuation time, the floor clear time, evacuation bottleneck, and the visual path of the evacuation on MAPGIS platform. BFREMIS is valuable in building safety assessment and building fire rescue.

articleTitle: Cooperation and profits distribution of reverse supply chain based on the different outsourcing degrees
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper discusses cooperation and profits sharing of a triple-echelon Reverse Supply Chain (RSC) composed of one manufacturer, one third party logistics provider and retailers from the perspective of different outsourcing degrees. Divided the RSC cooperation into three degrees, it models and analyzes the variances of product price, product recovery rate, firm's profits, customer benefits, resources reuse and overall profits. Cooperation profits are distributed by using the Shapley value method. Conclusions are reached that firms, customers and natural environment achieves a win-win-win status, which means that product retail price is falling and return rates, overall profits, individual profits are rising with the deepening outsouring cooperation of RSC. Reduced price benefits more consumers and increased return rate improves the reuse of natural resources.

articleTitle: On management of technology and its application in agriculture of China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Agriculture is a pillar of industry and a key component of economy and society in most if not all of the countries of the world. Management of Technology (MOT), an emergent body of knowledge and techniques, can be effectively applied to improve economic efficiency of agriculture and develop a more harmonious relationship between agriculture and environment. MOT models, having found successful applications in science, engineering, and manufacturing, can be altered to accommodate modern agriculture of China when the latter is classified scientifically according to the requirements of agriculture and characteristics of MOT. The result proposes a new MOT-based model for improvements in agriculture.

articleTitle: An empirical study of the relationship between BPR and interior environment support system in Chinese enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to explore effective ways to improve the performance and ensure the success of BPR, the paper puts forward a conceptual model and 4 theoretical hypotheses about the relationship between BPR and its interior environment support system, makes a empirical study about the theoretical hypothesis employing a multidimensional statistic and analytic method, reveals the relationship, and researches the impact of organizational and background factors like corporation scale on BPR. The research findings show that interior environment support system plays a positive role in the success of BPR, various support elements influence BPR differently, and the form of ownership significantly affects the extent of BPR implementation. In addition, some suggestions are made to make BPR a success based on the research findings.

Author Keywords: Business Process Reengineering (BPR) Interior environment support system

articleTitle: Process control system of roof disaster based on PDCA cycle
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to control the whole process of roof disaster, first estimates the movement parameters of working face roof, calculates weighting intensity, chooses the method of roof support, calculates support parameters, predicts possible types of incidents and proposes preventive measures, according to geological conditions and design parameters. Then realizes auto-drawing which is depend on technical parameters, works out operational rules intelligently and ensures the implement of support design. At the same time, the system analyses the monitoring data of support quality and roof dynamic at actual working face, then makes contrast with the design results of the roof support design expert system, using the actual data to amend the expert system step by step, to complete "self-learning" function and realize PDCA cycle. It has proved that the system can control roof disaster very well, and it is of significance to coal mine safety production.

articleTitle: Price and due date setting under service level constraints with contingent orders
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper extends the model of [Eur. J. Oper. Res. 116 (2) (1999) 305] that, optimizes pricing and lead time decisions for MTO firms with contingent orders under service level constraints. The respond function was modified to be of more practical by introducing the average service level to express the effect of delivery reliance on customers' decision. We describe a simple enumerative procedure to determine optimal quotations, then compare the results between under service level constraints or not. Our simple numerical examples show that, on the consideration of service level, our proposed method can increase the total long-term expected marginal revenue. We derive a number of managerial insights based on the analysis of the influence of service level requirement on optimal bidding quotation.

articleTitle: Research on the security model for e-business process management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Security has become one of the biggest issues that slow down the progress of e-commerce. Web service is a key technology to achieve e-commerce. On the basis of research of the Web service standards and the features of e-commerce, this paper points out the inadequacies of current electronic commerce system and gives out a security model based on Web service. It can provide two-way authentication, which will guarantees the equality between both parties and quality of confidentiality.

articleTitle: Empirical research on managerial overconfidence and corporate financing behavior of pecking-order
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper test whether managerial overconfidence is associated with corporate financing policies, it propose that managerial beliefs help to explain the remaining variation across and within firms, including variation in pecking-order behavior. Developing a proxy for managerial overconfident mainly based on the manager being board chairman as CEO and using the modified pecking order model of financing, making an empirical test the behavior of pecking order financing with overconfident manager using the panel data of Dow Jones China 88 Index companies at September 2008 from 2000 to 2007, the results show that managerial overconfident is an important managerial characteristics determinant of financing decision, the overconfident manager prefer internal over external financing and they prefer debt over equity financing.

articleTitle: An establishment and management system of production planning and scheduling for large-piece OKP enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In order to achieve the purpose of the automotive establishment of plant-level production planning and scheduling, to balance the enterprise production capability, to reduce the production cycle, and to ensure the enforceability of the establishment of production planning and scheduling on plant-level, an establishment and management system of production planning and scheduling is proposed oriented to large-piece OKP (one-of-a-kind production) enterprises. The requirement of production planning and scheduling for this kind of enterprises is analyzed. A function model of the establishment and management system of production planning and scheduling is designed and constructed, and the capability balance and the establishment methods of production planning and scheduling are advanced based on this model. And then, the main function models of the system are developed. Finally, the functions of the system are introduced by using examples and verified by applying them in one of the real enterprises.

articleTitle: Study on mechanism of profit allocation in virtual enterprise based on shapley value considering harmony degree
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The aim of virtual enterprise which is composed by a number of member enterprises is to gain its benefit, but how to distribute the benefit may impact its stability. The traditional Shapley value method only takes into account the important extent of member enterprises in virtual enterprise, in the actual operation it has some defects. In order to enhance the stability of virtual enterprise, in accordance with the thinking of harmony degree of profit allocation in the operation of virtual enterprise, this evaluates the harmony of profit allocation based on the Shapley value method which seems fair, and adjusts the existing value of profit allocation based on the Shapley value considering the degree of harmony, so that the distribution of benefits in virtual enterprise tends to a high degree of harmony, in order to maintain its sustained and steady development.

articleTitle: Change of total factor efficiency of financial service industry in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the non-parametric DEA and Malmquist index, this paper studies total factor efficiency of fifteen cities' financial service industry (FSI) in China during the year of 2000 to 2006. According to study objective, total factor productivity (TFP), as well as factors' degree of contribution, is analyzed. Eventually, the conclusion is obtained that the increase in TFP of China's financial service industry depends on both improvement of technical progress and technical efficiency.

articleTitle: Evaluation of technological innovation capability of enterprises based on perspective of knowledge management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Considering the role of knowledge management during process of technological innovation, this paper manages to build evaluation index system of technological innovation capability based on perspective of knowledge management, use factor analysis method and establish corresponding evaluation model in order to evaluate technological innovation capability much more objectively and comprehensively. The paper finally carries out empirical analysis, and the result verifies rationality and effectiveness of evaluation index system and evaluation model that are chosen.

articleTitle: Order production planning based on lead time and balanced production
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the rapidly changes in the market, the businesses need to produce according to order more and more. As currently there is no order production planning based on lead time and balanced production, an order production planning model based on lead time and balanced production is proposed. It is goal programming model aiming at restraining the capacity of resources in production process, in which we firstly make use of AHP to identify the priority class, and then find the solution using MATLAB programming, at last we carry out an empirical analysis and achieve a good result.

articleTitle: Green supply chain performance based on unascertained means cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Unascertained means clustering methodology combines unascertained theory and clustering theory to construct unascertained measurements which measures the degree of collective affiliation between samples and category. By considering both financial and non-financial factors, this paper constructs a green supply chain performance evaluation system which contains 17 secondary indicators based on financial condition, customer service, operation flow and degree of green. According to this system, we apply the unascertained means clustering methodology to evaluate the performance of green supply chain, derive the clustering results and present the degree of affiliation of the samples. Unascertained average clustering theory solved the classification problem of green supply chain performance as well as improving the credibility of the evaluation. Finally, this paper ends up with the discussion of the feasibility and effectiveness of this system.

articleTitle: Optimal threshold in the group-buying auction with replenishment postponement
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The group-buying auction is often used in the B2C market. The seller here is offered a quantity-discount-price contract and implements a replenishment postponement policy. We show that when customer's valuation follows a uniform distribution, the group-buying auction does not always outperform the fixed pricing. The optimal group-buying threshold is shown to depend on only purchasing costs, prices and the upper bound of customer's valuation.

articleTitle: Integrating environmental performance into the supplier evaluation: A GRA-based method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The Green Supply Chain Management (GSCM) takes environmental considerations into the account in supply chain management. Purchasing decisions have significant impact on the GSCM. However lack of effective and practical tools for supply chain managers to incorporate green into their daily operations hindered the practice of GSCM. The paper establishes an integrated supplier evaluation model considering supplier's environmental performance together with price, production capability, reliability and service. The method of Gray Relation Analysis (GRA) is adopted to compare and rank the potential supplier's performance in these dimensions. A case study is conducted to demonstrate the application of the proposed the method.

articleTitle: Theoretical system of product platform innovation and evolution
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The lack of independent innovation ability is regarded as the main shortage of product platform. To enhance the ability of product platform innovation and upgrading under mass-customization (MC) environment, the concept of product platform life cycle (PPLC) was put forward. The theoretical system of product platform innovation and evolution was presented, including basic theoretical research, implementation method, enabling technology. Then some key problems, such as the product platform planning, the platform stability analysis, the innovation problems recognition and platform innovation process in the process of product platform innovation and evolution were discussed.

articleTitle: Improved fuzzy genetic algorithm-based networked manufacturing alliance member selection
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Networked manufacturing alliance is a virtual cooperation organization which consists of some core competence enterprises. Alliance member selection is the primary step to implement networked manufacturing. Through selection process analysis, alliance member selection is a multi-objective decision problem. The improved fuzzy genetic algorithm was used to design and analyze the member selection model. Then the combined optimization strategy can be obtained based on the quantitative evaluation factors: time T, quality Q, cost C and qualitative evaluation factors: service S, design ability D. In the process of solution, the conception of "life" was employed to control the population size. The crossover operator and mutation operator were controlled by fuzzy controller and fuzzy logic reasoning. In order to verify the presented model and algorithm, the improved fuzzy genetic algorithm was use to evaluate the real case. The simulation results showed that the algorithm had fast convergence and accorded with the real condition.

articleTitle: A human factors improvement on supervisory alarms in wastewater treatment system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The automation of the computer monitoring system has already been extensively used by industries. This study introduces a high-level automation water treatment system that was developed in a semiconductor plant. The original system was so designed that it could monitor the system in a very sensitive way and display and records all the alarms in detail. The system was considered of convenience and security because of such features. However, the design of supervisory alarms in the system failed in considering the human factors. The problem was identified and improved by applying human factors into the system. NASA-TLX evaluation on performing the monitoring tasks was carried out with a group of technicians/engineers before and after the improvement. The subjective and objective indexes indicated that the improved human factors alarm design performed better. The subjects' satisfaction was very high with the improved system. The mental workload of the subjects was reduced and the performance improved remarkably. It is concluded that detailed information may not be a good idea for monitoring system. Less detail but fit the needs of the task is a better way for such a system design. The result is applicable to not only semiconductor industry but also to other industries.

articleTitle: Using semantic annotation for ontology based decision support in product family design
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Developing product family is one of the most promising approaches in the mass customization paradigm. In the product family perspective, the understanding of product family metrics and modeling is crucial for decision support and analysis. Most of the current product family modeling representation is meant solely for physical product configuration. Therefore, the current product family modeling approaches is not adequate to support various decision making at different product family design issues. An integrated knowledge framework that is able to support decision making in all aspects of interest would be highly desirable. This paper presents a conceptual framework of using semantic annotation for ontology based decision support in product family design. Together with a new commonality analysis based on a semantically annotated product family ontology, the framework illustrates the merits of using semantic annotation in assisting ontology based analysis and decision making in product family design. A case study involving a product family of digital camera is also presented to demonstrate our concepts and approach.

articleTitle: Analysis on location selection of dry ports based on ANP
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper mainly discusses location selection of the dry port and takes Tianjin Port as an example. Furthermore, Analytic Network Process (ANP) method has been introduced into the determination of the priorities on location selection of the dry port. The factors that affect the facilities of the dry port were systematically analyzed and an evaluation model was built when considering the feed back and the relations between those factors. As a conclusion, the evaluated result is shown about the location selection of Tianjin Port's decision.

articleTitle: On enterprise innovation integration based on the self-organization model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The research on innovation has become an important trend from the perspectives of system and its relative system theories. According to knowledge about enterprise innovation and self-organization theory, innovations include culture innovation, knowledge innovation, institution innovation, technology innovation, management innovation, and so on. Innovation integration is defined as a dynamic innovation process and system for a better comprehensive benefit, taking into account all perspectives of innovation, emphasizing harmony and match from all kinds of innovations, and all kind of innovations interacting with each other. And then the difference of all innovators engaging in innovations in enterprise innovation integration is expounded. Based on analyzing the relationship among all innovators of enterprise innovation integration, the Self-organization model of enterprise innovation integration is set up and the matrix operation of the model is processed. The operation outcomes are received as follows: (1) there is no competitive effect, but synergetic effect when self-relation of single innovation in enterprise acts on enterprise innovation integration. (2) if only self-relation of single innovation sub-system in enterprise but lack of interaction among all innovation sub-systems, even if they themselves have competitive and synergetic effect, they will not contribute to enterprise innovation integration. (3) The competition effect among the different innovation subsystems has active effect and passive effect, and the active effect has decisive influence on the final result of the enterprise innovation integration. (4)By means of the interaction of innovation subsystems, competition and cooperation under the situation making use of the resources in the innovation system, enterprise innovation integration will lead to ideal integrated result in the end, and the higher degree innovation integration will come into being, this explains the mechanism and its complex evolvement of self-organization about enterprise innovation integration.

articleTitle: Research on target cost control of construction project based on goal programming
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Target cost control of construction projects is an important part of project management, and it plays a crucial role on the benefit of construction projects. In this paper, the issue about target cost control on the early stage of construction projects has been explored further. Firstly, this paper elaborates on determination principles and measurement methods of target cost of construction projects. Secondly, through the establishment of target cost programming model of construction projects and the use of simplex method on the linear programming, the established target cost programming model has been solved and the satisfied value of target cost control of construction projects has been determined based on final solution of the model. Finally, the application of method has been verified in practice. The purpose on target cost control of construction project has been achieved qualitatively and quantitatively. The effective control about target cost of construction projects on the early stage has been ensured.

articleTitle: The simulation expert system for job shop on-line scheduling based on G2
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the paper, the job shop on-line scheduling problem with random release date is taken into consideration. For the problem, the discrete event-driven model is set up. On this basis, the simulation expert system is developed on the platform of G2. By dynamically exploiting the dispatching rule according to the state of each machine in the system, the system realizes the job scheduling and the simulation result is given at last.

articleTitle: Product family design and logistics decision support system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The purpose of the paper is to present Product Variety Analysis (PVA) approach to coordinated and synchronized flows of information about products and production processes among various supply chain members. The cost based PVA is developed by presenting cost modeling according to three factors in the cost model, namely part cost, development cost, and production cost. The results show that cost based PVA enables a product designer for producing higher commonality product family to reducing total costs per component. Developing commonality metric by including component price should be carried out in the future in considering component support to product family profitability. In terms of managerial implication, coordination between the manufacturing process and product development department facilitate supply chain design. Cost based PVA shows the novelty of this paper.

articleTitle: On the application of fuzzy comprehensive appraisal in human capital evaluation of logistics enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the age of knowledge economy, the talent is the most valuable resource. The important aspects of improving organizational efficiency and enhancing organizational vitality include: how to manage persons reasonably and effectively, and how to choose talents. For the management of the human capital, first we should have the method and standard for the appraisal before we begin to evaluate the human capital. This paper aims to study the application of fuzzy comprehensive appraisal in human capital evaluation of logistics enterprises through introducing the present method of human capital evaluation as well as the special nature of human capital.

articleTitle: Memetic algorithm for real estate portfolio based on risk preference coefficient
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Optimization of real estate portfolio is to select two or more different types of real estate for investment, and the previous models based on expected return-variance cannot meet the needs of the investor's. Furthermore, the investor changes their risk preference with the risk level. In this study, firstly, the real estate investment portfolio semi-variance model based on risk preference coefficient is constructed. The return per unit of risk is the key factor to determine an investment decision. Secondly memetic algorithm has been employed to solve the constructed model. Finally, a real-world case study is carried out to verify the performance of memetic algorithm, and indicates that memetic algorithm approach can generate better solution than GA. The memetic algorithm approach can be regarded as a useful approach for solving real estate portfolio problem.

articleTitle: Simulation and improvement of multi-product multi-stage processing system based on witness
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper introduces the multi-product multi-stage production system's characteristics and the basic application of the witness, and then takes a precision instrument manufacturer as an example to detail the simulation process of a multi-product multi-stage production system. Through analyzing the results of the model to identify the bottlenecks of production system and the causes of the problems, then put forward some measures to ease the production problems, and by setting the model parameters to improve the multi-product multi-stage production system, so as to minimize the inventory of products; to ensure the delivery time, to improve production benefits.

articleTitle: Condition monitoring system design with one-class and imbalanced-data classifier
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As machine's condition plays a central role in today's manufacturing industry for assuring process stability and productivity, it is crucial to efficiently monitor the machine status to acquire desired performance. However, in many practical applications, due to economic and technical difficulties, there is only normal operating data or small amount of faulty data available, which will render classic classifiers unusable for this case. To address this problem, this paper presents a design of condition monitoring system with one-class classifier and classifier for imbalanced data. Based on the general description of condition monitoring system, support vector data description (SVDD) and Mahalanobis-distance threshold (MDT) are introduced as one-class classifier and classifier for imbalanced data, respectively. Then they are embedded into a design of condition monitoring system in LabVIEW software and hardware configuration, and a prototype is then developed to show the rationality and feasibility of the design idea.

articleTitle: Research on the relationship between intellectual capital and listed companies performance of China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Based on the data of 100 Chinese listed companies (50 high-tech companies and 50 other companies), this study investigates the impact of intellectual capital and the constituent elements of intellectual capital on Chinese listed companies performance with regression analysis. The results show that, there is a positive relationship between intellectual capital and performance, and elements of intellectual capital are also positive to the companies performance. Relation capital has the most significant effect whereas structural capital's significance ranks medium and human capital doesn't have a significant effect.

articleTitle: NFC at the workplace — Simplify enterprise work flows with NFC
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In our contribution, we present the results of our research on the use of Near Field Communication (NFC) for user authentication and document control. To show our results, we present two different scenarios and a combination of them. In the first scenario, NFC tags are embedded in documents of an office environment. This includes customer invoices which are archived or kept in paper form as well as contracts with business partner which might change over time. Once certain paper document needs to be changed, it is moved close to the NFC reader, which will invoke a database lookup to get the digital version of the document. The second scenario is mainly intended for attorneys, tax consultants or, in general, for each situation that involves the need for a copy of (highly) classified documents. If somebody considers copying a classified document, he needs to have the proper access rights, which are stored in a database that can be referenced by the NFC tag. The third scenario involves both, authentication and digitization of documents. In order to copy a document, the proper access rights and the digital version of the document is stored in a protected, centralized data storage container.

articleTitle: Research on coal production materials distribution based on supply chain management
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Supply logistics system of coal production is an important component of the production logistics system. And the choice of the mode of coal production materials distribution relates to the operating efficiency of the entire supply logistics system of coal production. In this paper, the application of supply chain management in the coal production materials distribution is discussed.
