At the same time, based on the supply chain thought, three modes of coal production materials distribution are proposed and compared, in favor of the coal enterprises in the appropriate choice.

articleTitle: Strategies on human capital investment of knowledge-based employees based on the growth of high technology enterprises
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Knowledge-based employees, as one of the core competitiveness of high technology enterprise, become more and more important as the enterprise from the introduction to the growth facing the market intensify competition. Therefore, we integrate the enterprise strategy with the growth of enterprises life cycle, develop a model on human capital investment of knowledge-based employees by analyzing employees' needs and characters during the growth of high technology enterprise to get how to arouse knowledge-based employee's initiative, and make effective investment return, we then give such advices as setting up warning risk mechanism on knowledge-based employees; improving the motivation mechanism; strengthening knowledge-based employees' team; deepening enterprise culture in order to make the utilization of enterprise existing resources maximized, enhance the core competitiveness, what is more, realizing high technology enterprise sustainable development.

articleTitle: Scheduling and manpower allocation for hotel banquet functions
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Hotel banquet functions usually employ part-time workers as waiters and waitresses. These functions often end beyond the scheduled duration. In addition, there is also either a shortage or excess of workers for majority of the banquet functions, resulting in significant losses to the hotel not only in monetary terms, but also to the reputation of the hotel. In this paper, the Six Sigma methodology was employed to help a hotel understand their current situation and come out with solutions to address these problems. The systematic approach allowed all their banquet functions to end within a stipulated duration and controlled the labor cost with no out-of-control situations. The process capability was also vastly improved as a result. All the recommendations were summarized into a Visual Basic .Net program for easy use by the banquet supervisor, allowing him to retrieve the required information and perform scheduling and manpower allocation automatically.

articleTitle: Competence evaluation approach based on 2-tuple linguistic representation model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The aim of the present work is to provide a reliable decision-making tool to enterprise managers that helps them to understand the available acquired competence resources network and to take the right decision to promote and ameliorate this network. For that purpose, a novel competence evaluation approach based on a fuzzy linguistic information model, named the 2-tuple linguistic representation model, is presented. It has been developed in order to obtain an objective evaluation generated by a group of experts with heterogeneous opinions. It has the advantage to overcome the loss and the distortion of information and then to offer conclusive information about each acquired competence level. To illustrate the different steps of the proposed approach, a didactic example is described. The found results allow a suitable comparison between competence resources levels that may help enterprise managers in making the right decisions when selecting and/or assigning the operators.

articleTitle: Site selection of supermarket based on DEMATEL
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The key factors from complicated selecting system are found to solve supermarket location optimization problem. By introducing Decision Making and Trial Evaluation Laboratory (DEMATEL) methodology matrix calculation is used and then DEMATEL quantitative analysis through surveying diversified experts is finished to find the core driving factor and priority order of influencing factors. One supermarket in Xi'an as the case study example is adopted to describe the application and effectiveness of DEMATEL methodology. That a series of influencing factors such as population structure are core items in selecting supermarket site whereas another series can be ignored is found in the case. Thus the complicated selecting system is simplified but the optimal supermarket site is still effectively and accurately chose. Causal relationship between influencing factors is considered and the effectiveness and accuracy of selecting supermarket site is increased.

articleTitle: Research of the coordination between industrial structure and employment structure in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Referring to the similarity coefficient method, this paper defines the concept of coordination coefficient between industrial structure and employment structure, and applies this method to measure the coordination coefficient during 1978-2006 in China as well as all provinces in 2006. The result shows that Chinese industrial structure and employment structure has been in unbalanced since reform and opening-up, and the coordination coefficient presents obvious fluctuation. Meanwhile, the coordination coefficient presents the gradient distribution in which it reduces from eastern to western in turn, and the differences among provinces is extremely great.

articleTitle: “Family and community endowment” and function analysis for old caring of community public service facilities
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Traditional family endowment and social endowment both have limitations in China at present whereas the new endowment mode “Family and community endowment” integrates advantages of the two. The paper analyzed the old people's choice on living style under the new mode. Residential districts are the optimum environment for old caring, and public service facilities in residential districts have to satisfy the old people's life necessities. There are peculiarities in the old age: physiological natural aging and organic lesions in physiology, being afraid of loneliness and desiring to be looked after in psychology. So the old people have the endowment demands of “living with security, being nursed in time and enjoying independence, achievement and entertainment”. Public service facilities in residential districts must meet these demands and correspondingly provide functions of residing and feeding, medical care system, maintaining the old people's survival value and social communicating.

articleTitle: Calculation method of delay claims with multi-event interference based on shapley value
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As an important measure for parties of the contract to protect their own interests, project claim is the core of project contract management. For claims of time delay under multi-agent and multi-event interference, it is difficult to assess the responsibility. To solve this problem, this paper presents a new analytical method based on Shapley value, and brings forward a new parameter called Correction Factor to denote the affecting degree of every interference event. On the basis of this method, project delay responsibility is allotted to each single responsible activity, and then allotted to both owner and contractor in each single responsible activity. Finally, the responsibility is reallotted to the responsible parties through Correction Factor. This method takes into account the impact of the interference event, and makes the responsibility-sharing more equitable.

articleTitle: The bilateral information asymmetry on insurance market
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper restudies the incompletely insuring condition under the influence of adverse selection in insurance market. First of all, this paper demonstrates the bilateral information asymmetry on the insurance market. Following that, through the application of Karush-Kuhn-Tucker Theorem, this paper deduces this condition newly. Finally, this paper draws the conclusion that insurance company should control the compensation amount through the design of insurance contract.

articleTitle: Research on the products realized processes and the frame of a new type of quality monitoring and control system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The world wide ISO9001 standard specified quality management system needs to be corrected and improved to make it effective. The advanced and effective quality control system of a batch production factory should have the properties of on line process monitoring and controlling, including project planning process, product design and development process, process design and development process, product and process validation process, assessment and corrective action process. The system consists mainly of quality information processing unit, data acquisition units distributed production line, spot broadcasting unit of quality information. This kind of quality control system relied mostly on integrated IT technology, including software and hardware, so that the system must be more objective and effective and can improve the ISO9001 specified quality management system.

articleTitle: Evaluation of service quality for power supplying enterprises based on cloud model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the condition of power market reform, it is a key question for the power supplying enterprises about how to evaluate the service quality objectively. Therefore, an index system to evaluate the service quality of power supplying enterprises is set up based on the previous studies. Then, improved analytic hierarchy process method (AHP) is exploited to determine the index weights. Finally, cloud model is introduced to give an evaluation of service quality. This model discards the hard division methods which are used in previous studies. As a result, the concepts gained by this way can reflect the data distribution characteristics more obviously and objectively. After that, by backward cloud generator, the cloud parameters can be got, which are used for evaluation. The example in this paper shows that the model is feasible and effective since it can offer more hidden information directly.

articleTitle: The research of knowledge production of KIBS based on industry engineering
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Nowadays knowledge production of KIBS (Knowledge Intensive Business Services) has been successfully implemented in foreign countries, while domestic research in this field has not yet been carried out, and to some extent, this has hampered the knowledge innovation of KIBS in China. This paper proposed the concept of knowledge production of KIBS, then compared research content of IE with research content of knowledge production of KIBS, analyzed three aspects of knowledge production of KIBS based on IE methodology: organized knowledge system, operation process control, project management. At last, proposed the research field of knowledge production of KIBS, which tried to broaden the research field of industrial engineering.

articleTitle: Design of incentive mechanism and game analysis for project managers
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Through mathematical models and game theory, this paper analyzes the optimal incentive contracts between enterprises and their project managers under asymmetric information condition in order to solve the problems in establishing incentive mechanism for project managers. Punishment mechanism is introduced and analyzed in the design of incentive mechanism for project managers. It expands the theoretical frame for incentive mechanism. The results are as follows: Punishment mechanism is related and complementary with incentive mechanism. Both can encourage or guide the project managers to work hard towards common goals. Therefore, the function of the incentive mechanism and the punishment mechanism should be considered simultaneously in the design of incentive contracts for project managers. It helps to prevent project managers from speculating. Introduction of punishment mechanism into incentive mechanism not only results in theoretical innovation, but also has great application value in practice.

articleTitle: Sustainable development of modern logistics industry under the condition of industrial cluster
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: From the characteristics and advantages of industrial cluster we can see that the cluster is actually a large transportation system. Interlinked with each other on the lower reaches of the integrated enterprise, it contains of product packaging, transportation, handling, storage, custody, as well as what happened in all the process of information management and delivery. Every element of logistics chain can serve as a node, connected with the relationship between supply and demand in different enterprises, and form a distribution network within clusters. As a result, modern transportation industry has played an important role in industrial clusters. However, the scientific development is a huge and complex systems engineering. This paper based on the scientific concept of development tries to guide the conduct of the transportation industry cluster. And we also analyzed systematic exploration of transportation industry development model, to enhance the sustainable capacity. On this basis, we proposed service for modern transportation industry in industry cluster, including modernization of technology, network services, globalization of markets, large-scale industries, co-distribution, development of excelsior, and so on.

articleTitle: Study and application of mobile logistics management system in auto parts enterprise based on 3PL-HUB
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The third party logistics-hub (3PL-HUB) is a model of logistics direct delivery stations, and an advanced logistics organization mode. And it can integrate supply-side resources and promote the supply chain coordination. Logistics information system plays a key role for successful implementation of 3PL-HUB. The main objective of the paper is to solve the existing data collection problems in logistics systems, such as lag, inaccuracy, and unreal-time tracking. According to 3PL-HUB and combined with the VPN-based internet, wireless communication and mobile barcode scanning technology, this paper established a mobile logistics management integrated architecture of auto parts, and proposed the business processes based on 3PL-HUB, and constructed the logistics management architecture for auto parts, and some key technologies are studied, such as standardization technology, data synchronization, and PDA development, Finally, through an example, the feasibility and practicality of this system are verified.

articleTitle: A ring type standing wave ultrasonic motor using bending transducer
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: A ring type standing wave USM using bending transducer is proposed. The transducer includes one exponential horn located on leading end, and the horn insect with the ring at tip end. The working principle of proposed motor is analyzed. The ring and transducer are designed with FEM. The bending vibration modals of ring and transducer are degenerated. Transient analysis is developed to gain the vibration characteristics of stator, and results indicate that the motion trajectories of nodes on the teeth are oblique lines. Results also indicate the proposed design enables the standing wave USM to operate with large vibration amplitude, which would improve the mechanical output characteristics. The results of this paper verify the theoretical feasibility and provide instructions for the development of proposed motor.

articleTitle: Network failure characteristic analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: With the increasing popularity of network, network failure has already become a hot topic recently. This paper summarizes the conception of network failure according to network functions. It is defined as the state or event, in which the network cannot transmit material, energy or information timely, completely and correctly according to customer requirements. Based on dialectic and systems science, this paper explains the transformation relationships between different network states, and expresses the drive of the transformation. Six main characteristics of network failure, namely universality, complexity, emergence, relativity, hierarchy and dynamic, are expounded separately. These characteristics form the basis of failure prevention and control. The contribution of this paper is to lay the foundation for the research of network failurology.

articleTitle: Application research of disruptive innovation in product lifecycle
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper compared the differences and the relationship between sustains innovation and disruptive innovation and expounded the role and the limitations of sustains innovation to extend the product lifecycle. Then this paper analyzed the advantages and the functions of disruptive innovation to extend the product lifecycle. The results show that sustains innovation can extend the product lifecycle within a certain range, but can't change the trend of product to be eliminated. Through use disruptive innovation and sustains innovation alternately and adjust the innovation direction continuously, the product lifecycle should be extended unlimitedly.

articleTitle: Bio-energy and rural low-carbon economy in China: A system perspective
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The demand of energy in rural areas is growing dramatically as well as the pressure of greenhouse gas (GHG) emission reduction. Therefore, rural low-carbon economy should be given more attention today because of the day-increasing energy consumption. Bio-energy is one of the low-carbon energies and has abundant biomass material in China's countryside, which means it should be a partial substitute for fossil energies use in rural area. An overview of bio-energy utilization situation in the world is presented in this paper as well as the advantages of developing the rural low-carbon economy in China. Then, one system model is put forward to developing the rural low-carbon economy with the basis of bio-energy substitution, including three subsystems of energy, agricultural production and rural life. The findings in this paper are significant to promote the low-carbon economy development in China's rural area.

articleTitle: Demand chain management — The new source of profit increase
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The intersection of transaction cost economy, demand management and information technology shapes the framework of demand chain management theory. Demand chain management that emphasizes demand planning, value adding and demand chain optimization has enhanced the internal values of products and services, and thus evolved to the new source of profit increase. This paper starts with the background of demand chain management, then based on the connotation of demand chain management, analyzes why it is an instrument to increase business profit from three aspects. Finally, the paper discusses the potential problems of demand chain and the developmental prospect of demand chain management in China.

articleTitle: A study of the relationship between R&D capability and innovation performance based on high-tech firms in optics valley of China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: As a central part of innovation, R&D has played a key role in affecting firm's innovation performance. In the perspective of resource-based view, this paper comprehensively establishes the framework of R&D capability, and conducts an empirical research to explore the relationship between R&D capability and innovation performance of firms, combining with the data from innovative survey of "Optics Valley of China" in 2006. The finding proves that innovation performance is closely related to the total improvement of R&D capability. The number of patents owned and experimental development input intensity are the most important factors significantly affecting firm's innovation performance. For large firms, the number of science and technology center is also found to be the R&D capability affecting the innovation performance, while the ratio of R&D personnel is surprisingly found to be vital for small firms. Hence, high-tech firms should establish feasible and appropriate strategies in terms of size and resources condition, in order to get better and quicker development. At the same time, the authorities should set down innovative incentive policies and patent regulations to build a harmonious environment.

articleTitle: Analysis of influence factors of corporate technology innovation based on interpretative structural model
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The economic globalization and rapid development of the high-tech have put forward new requests on the economic development. Innovation has become a decisive factor for the sustainable development of enterprise. Technology innovation is not only the independent behavior of enterprise, but also influenced by the factors of motivation, ability and environment. The research defines the factors from the three aspects on the above and reveals the relations of the factors quantitatively with the aid of interpretative structural model. Finally, some conclusions are drawn according to the strategies so as to provide scientific policies for technology innovation activities of enterprise.

articleTitle: Research for multidimensional systems diagnostic analysis based on improved mahalanobis distance
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The relative importance of variables is different when comprehensively evaluating samples from multidimensional systems; however, traditional Mahalanobis-Taguchi System (MTS) method ignores this difference and treats all variables equally. To improve the accuracy of diagnosis or prediction when using MTS to measure the degree of abnormality of multidimensional observations, this paper makes an improvement on Mahalanobis distance function. Firstly, the necessity and feasibility of weighted Mahalanobis distance are analyzed. Secondly, the weighted Mahalanobis distance function in MTS is proposed. Finally, based on the new method a blood viscosity diagnosis system is optimized and analyzed and the result proves the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Coordinating price model for retailer dominant in a two-echelon supply chain
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper proposed a coordinating pricing model, in which the retailer occupies a leading position. Coordinating pricing is a practice that a manufacturer pays a retailer a portion of sales promotion expenses in order to induce sales. Comparing with other relative studies, we assume the market demand is not only influenced by retail price but also by sales promotion expenses. With the game theory, we analyses and find out Stackelberg equilibrium solution, manufacturer's, retailer's and system's maximum expected profits. Furthermore, through the economic analysis on the sales promotion expenses' share ratio, we find manufacture's optimal share ratio depends on the demand sensitivity to the retail price and to the sales promotion expenses and get the optimal sales promotion expenses' share ratio that optimizes the entire two-echelon supply chain.

articleTitle: The anti-standardized design research of data warehouse
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Standardization is a basic principle to design the relational database, which guarantees the revision of data structure and the quality of reorganization, but when referring to data mining system, anti-standardization is needed for data warehouse design. This paper discusses the necessity of anti-standardization and the specific design methods. With the development of data mining application, the study of inherent law and quality control of the anti-standardized design is extremely urgent. The research has a great potential and has an important guiding significance for improving the quality of data warehouse design.

articleTitle: Research of expression recognition base on optimized BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper combined Genetics algorithm with BP neural network, mixed-training neural networks, optimized the classification process. Genetic algorithm optimized BP network structure and parameters, found better search space in the analytic space. Then BP network searched the optimal solution in the small search space. Finally, two experiment results indicate that optimized BP neural network training is a effective method of study expression classification and recognition.

articleTitle: A prediction method of life and reliability for CSALT using Grey RBF neural networks
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: There are two problems of the traditional life and reliability estimation methods of Accelerated Life Test (ALT): one is the difficulty to establish the accelerated model and another is the complex computing of multiple likelihood equations. In this paper, we proposed a new prediction method of life and reliability for the constant stress accelerated life test using Grey RBF Neural Network. The accelerated stress levels and reliability are used as the training input vectors, while well-regulated failure data operated by Grey Accumulated Generate Operation (AGO) principle as training target vectors. Then RBF neural net is established and trained. Eventually, the failure data under normal stress can be predicted by putting the normal stress levels and the reliability into the model, and reliability curves can be drawn if life distribution is known. A simulation case is conducted and results are compared to that of BP algorithm, which demonstrates the validation of this model.

articleTitle: Prediction analysis of human error probability for mine hoisting systems
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Mine hoisting accidents, as common and frequent disasters, the statistics shows 90% of them are caused by human errors. Therefore, studying human reliability of the systems can effectively reduce systems failure due to human errors. Although the significance of human reliability has been widely acknowledged, this technology, currently restricted to aerospace, aviation, nuclear industry, is not prevalent in industrial and mining enterprises. So cognitive reliability and error analysis method which is the typical second generation of human reliability analysis method is utilized to analyze the failure model during mine hoisting operation. It divides the whole process into the basic events which are further divided into basic operation sequences, and analyzes possible failure mode and failure probability of each cognitive activity of operators, and quantitatively calculates the possible failure probability of each basic event. Eventually, according to contribution of each cognitive failure prevention and control measures are put forward from the aspects of management and technology to ensure the reliability of the system by reducing the probability of human error to the minimum acceptable degree.

Author Keywords: Cognitive reliability and error analysis method

articleTitle: A novel optimization model for sequencing automobile assembly shops
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: To solve the sequencing problem in automobile assembly shops, the colour batch size constraints of paint shop and the spacing constraints of the assembly shop are explicitly discussed. The spacing constraints are proved to be a sufficient condition for the capacity constraints. On the basis of those, the spacing constraint inequalities with utility workers are presented. An integer programming model is presented where the cost of utility workers and the cost of setups are to be optimized simultaneously. For computing conveniently, some nonlinear constraints in the model are transformed into linear constraints. Simulation results confirm the feasibility and validity of this proposed method.

articleTitle: A study on market oriented product innovation strategies for technology product market
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For the traditional product market, customer's requirements for the new product are product quality, cost, and delivery. However, several emerging market trend such as competitive technology product market requires different product development management. This paper defines the concept for strategic approach for the high technology product market. The suggested management method defines the different approach to satisfy the customers in the target market. The introduced approach effectively manages the three types of innovation concepts. The innovation factors are applied to define the strategies for approaching high technology product market. The paper defines the several practical management methods for the current high technology market by using the three innovation factors.

articleTitle: RFID-based manufacturing execution system for intelligent operations
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The radio frequency identification (RFID) technology is applied in a mixed-model assembly line to facilitate operational functionalities of the manufacturing execution system (MES), including data collection, document control, labor management, production process control, and performance analysis. The architecture and logic framework of the RFID-based MES are illustrated and synchronization modes between the MES and RFID devices concerning stability, efficiency and generality are discussed as well.

articleTitle: An investigation of logistic operation in a crossdocking distribution system with RFID
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Studies on crossdockings have mostly been focusing on the physical layout of a crossdock or on a single crossdock. In this paper, we will investigate if improvement can be made with increase product visibility especially before and after the flow through the distribution centre. RFID technology would be introduced along with GPS system. The suggested crossdocking distribution system would be first modeled out using simulation software ARENA. Finally, to optimize the crossdocking distribution system, both heuristics and meta-heuristics (i.e. Genetic Algorithm) optimization method would be conducted and analyzed.

articleTitle: Problems and solutions of railway engineering quota
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In recent years, runaway investment is a common phenomenon in railway construction. The importance of investment control can not be ignored with the faster and better development of the railway in the large scale railways construction. Quota is the computing basis of rail budget which controls investment scale, in this study, the authors research the role of quota in the whole process of the railway construction, and analyze the existing problems of quota. In the last, the study puts forward some improvement measures from the organization and technology and institution.

articleTitle: Study on a GERT based method for hi-tech product development project planning
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Considering the development of high-tech products, due to its complicated properties, a project planning model based on GERT is studied. By analyzing the GERT network description of WBS items of a product development project, the logical relationship of WBS items are defined and analyzed. Taking this as a core, a research of high-tech product project plan dynamic, product development and a case study are carried out.

articleTitle: Application of 3D optical measurement system on quality inspection of turbine blade
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Turbine blades are complex free-form surface parts and their inspection by a CMM or profile templates is slow, inefficient and expensive. Accordingly a 3D optical measure system with four measure heads has been developed. This system acquires complete point cloud data of a blade in 60s. The 2D twist analysis and Blade section analysis can be obtained after 3D CAD reference models and as-built parts are aligned. Experiments show that the entire profile inspection of a blade can be completed in 10 minutes with a precision of 0.1 mm/m.

articleTitle: Study on intelligent financial supervision management system based on context-awareness and rule engine
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The financial crisis triggered by the US credit crisis has given enormous damage to the world. Although domestic financial industry is booming and not yet been fully linked with the international economy, it still suffers a lot in the financial crisis. In order to prevent the economic losses caused by the financial events and keep the stability of the financial development, it is necessary to build an efficient financial supervision for analysis and early warning. Therefore, this paper introduces the context-awareness and rule engine technology to improve the traditional financial supervision mechanism based on the analysis of current supervision system status and the existing problems. And then we integrate context with the course of the financial supervision. At last, this paper focus on the key technologies such as context-awareness, rule engine and metadata management, which will provide a new way to improve the operational effectiveness of the supervision mechanism.

articleTitle: Research on the numerical control system reliability model using censored data
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the analysis of data for the reliability in CNC system, people commonly do not consider censored time. With the continuous improvement of reliability in CNC system, the failure rate is usually low in the timing censored test. All these produce a certain error in data analysis and parameter estimation. To solve this problem, this paper proposed to use censored data in the data analysis. First pre-process data of failure interval time, followed by the application of the cumulative failure rate to determine the distribution types primarily, then the maximum likelihood method is used to estimate the distributed parameters followed by fitting test with Hollander-Proschan method to get the distribution model. In this paper, failure data from 13 of a certain type numerical control system in four-month test were performed for processing and proved this method could improve precision in data analysis of reliability in CNC system.

articleTitle: Feasibility analysis to establish coking coal futures in China from US experience
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Under the background of increasingly volatile coal price in China, this article depicts market running situations before and after coal futures' launch in US. Then it consolidates current status of Chinese coal market and compare both background and conditions to start coal futures between two countries with the index of concentration rate. Finally the conclusion is drawn that it is possible to avoid price risk for coal producing and consuming companies through establishing futures market. Also, concretely, this article analyzes the producing market, demand market and price changes of coke coal and make it clear that coke coal is better to be the first product in coal futures market.

articleTitle: Process analysis of hospital outpatient service based on Arena
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: For the phenomenon of multiple long waiting and one short visiting in traditional hospital outpatient service by the statistical analysis of time that patients in service, by using simulation implement, Arena platform, establish simulation model of traditional hospital outpatient service, and simulate the impact of outpatient flow time-consuming in hospital with the introduction of HIS process. Through intend to jointly analysis of samples and simulation on the time-consuming of traditional paying and taking medicine, get the time value saved by the patient in the condition of full capacity utilization of medical resources, to provide ideas for improving outpatient service efficiency

articleTitle: Management information system of RIA constructed based on open source frame
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The RIA application of Internet constructed by integrating Hibernate, Spring, Struts and OpenLazlo to make the construction of Management Information System (MIS) faster and more effective. It is an optimal practice of constructing application of rich client based on Browser at present technique conditions.

articleTitle: A framework for simulating combined OLTP and OLAP workloads
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: OLTP and OLAP systems are thought of as two different domains despite sharing the same base data set to operate on. The data set only differs in granularity and logical layout. Serious changes in the development of hardware and database systems have occurred since the separation of analytical systems from the transactional systems in the 1990's. As a result, the decision to set up a separate domain for OLAP applications has to be reconsidered. In this paper we propose a configurable simulation framework that can be used to validate existing database systems and their ability to handle both workloads in parallel. The framework uses a benchmark defined for a combined OLTP and OLAP workload based on real enterprise data.

articleTitle: An improved method of wavelet neural network optimization based on filled function method
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: BP algorithm of neural network don't obtain global minimum sometimes, furthermore, it is possible to create many local minimum so that the optimum solution can't be found. In order to solve this question, one parameter filled function method is presented which can calculate value fast. We combine it with modified BFGS (Broyden-Davidon-Fletcher- Powell) to get a new algorithm for global optimization of wavelet neural network. The algorithm obtain the first local minimum by BFGS, then filled function method is used to obtain another smaller local minimum, this process is repeated for some times so that the network structure and weight value are optimized till global minimum is found. This method is used to train Shanghai stock index, then better network performance is obtained.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis on the performance of the sales and distribution process with enhanced information systems
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It has been assumed that it is difficult to predict or analyze the performance of a business process by introducing enhanced information systems. The performance of business processes, in actuality, is too complex and dynamic to be understood or analyzed through conventional modeling techniques. In this study, in order to predict the potential business impacts of introducing an information system, the approach of business process simulation (BPS) is used. By presenting an industrial example, the characteristics of BPS are illustrated.

articleTitle: Research on operation process analysis system based on MPM platform
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Operation process analysis is one important technique to promote the process optimization and reduce the production cost, and operation process chart is the tool describes the whole manufacturing flow of the product entirely, applied by more and more enterprises. This paper developed one operation process analysis system based on manufacturing processing management system (MPM), and the system had been accomplished on the MPM platform of Shanda Hoteamsoft Co. Ltd. This system first builds operation process chart with production route, based on process design, work analysis, time study, assembly line balancing and so on, and then optimize the process using the method 5W1H, etc. It can be integrated with PDM, CAPP or other systems, that insures veracity and coherence between different data.

articleTitle: A mode choice method for inland network of collecting and distributing of container port
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: This paper studies the selection of CDMs (CDM, Collecting and Distributing Mode). A connotation for CDSCP (CDSCP, Collecting and Distributing System of Container Port) is presented. After establishing a layered architecture, an optimized model with the goal of the minimum of the network cost is set up. And finally, a heuristic algorithm is advanced.

articleTitle: Production-outsourcing supply chain quality management based on multi-agent system
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Quality is one of the most important factors for an enterprise to win the competition. Production-outsourcing supply chain (POSC) is a kind of special supply chain in which the core enterprise transfer the manufacturing of products to the other enterprises. It results in the separation of two important stages - product designing and product manufacturing for forming product quality, that is product design and product manufacture are completed by different enterprises respectively. Traditional quality management which focuses on the inside of enterprise and emphasizes the coordination and cooperation of processes, elements and department inside an enterprise cannot satisfy the requirements of this kind of POSC quality management. In this paper, the architecture of a distributed cooperative quality management based on multi-agent system is presented. And an incentive mechanism is put forward to achieve the distributed cooperative quality management for this kind of POSC based on the information sharing through this architecture.

articleTitle: Management on the bio remediation of petroleum contaminated soil and its cost analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Bioremediation technique is becoming more and more important with the increasing amount of petroleum contaminated soil in China. Management on the bioremediation technique is a basic need for the application of the bioremediation techniques on petroleum contaminated soil. Environmental management, including selection of remediation method, technique management, process control and risk management, is discussed in detail. Basic remediation cost model is developed to characterize the bioremediation cost analysis for petroleum contaminated soil.

articleTitle: Simulation flow management for planetary gear transmission
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: In the design process of the planetary gear transmission, it is necessary to acquire its motion law, dynamics characteristics and structural strength, etc. In order to improve the work efficiency, how to make sure the correct sequence among many kinds of simulations and the proper relationship between all simulation data has become more and more important. Based on the workflow technology, a simulation flow management system for planetary gear transmission is proposed. And the functional framework and the technical architecture of this system have been established. The management system abides by the workflow reference model which is provided by the Workflow Management Coalition(WfMC); while the flow files can be acquired based on XML Process Definition Language(XPDL). Furthermore, the Relational DataBase (RDB) is adopted to manage control data of flow and the simulation data files can be managed by folder system. At last, an engineering application demonstrated that the simulation flow management system can control analysis process conveniently, manage simulation data effectively and improve work efficiency markedly.

articleTitle: Extension evaluation on risks in earlier stage of real estate project
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Real estate investment is an activity with high-income and high-risk. In recent years the state's macro-control to real estate industry have stepped up, while financial crisis broke out in 2008, which causes that the risks in real estate project increase greatly. These characteristics determine that the investors will inevitably face many risks in the whole processes especially in the earlier stage. Therefore considering the probability, losses, predictability and manageability of risk factors, the thesis constructs risk assessment model based on matter-element model and extension set theory. At the same time, taking into account the balance of risk factors, the thesis builds extension variable weights method. The results prove the model is feasible, and can improve the level of investment decision-making.

articleTitle: Failure importance analysis models based on Bayesian network
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: It is very important for the complex equipment to analyze the importance distribution of failure cause, which can make maintenance experts find the weak point of the equipment for diagnosis and improvement. This paper presents the failure importance analysis models based on the failure importance analysis Bayesian network (FIABN) to calculate the failure causes and modes importance. We adopt the immune algorithm to optimize the structure of FIABN. The numerical simulations show FIABN and the failure importance analysis methods are correct and effective.

articleTitle: Study on the selection of firm technological innovation model based on game analysis
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Recently, firms do not only devote resource to the innovation throughout firms, but also focus on in-house. The kind of innovation model ldquodouble trackrdquo-both on independent innovation and cooperative innovation has become the new trend for firm-innovation. Based on transaction cost theory and resource dependence theory, the article constructs a three stage innovation mode selection framework focus on two core factors-innovation cost and innovation resource theoretically. It also presents an equilibrium game model to show that innovation cost and innovation resource are the most important affect factors for innovation model selection and how they influence. Finally, some conclusions are drawn and a discussion of future directions is given.

articleTitle: Dynamic quality control of multi-variety and small batch manufacturing based on Bayesian Monitor
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Depend on circumstance more complex and changeable, the traditional control chart no longer meets the need of a more and more industrializing and complicated application environment. Therefore, this thesis is to analyze the shortage of traditional process control, and then propose dynamic quality control of multi-variety and small batch manufacturing based on Bayesian Monitor, which is come up with by Bianca. A case of a Chinese electronic chip manufacturer is studied with Bayesian Monitor, which together with the method studied is proved practical and of help to the quality control.

articleTitle: Structural design and empirical analysis on the circular economy index system for energy-intensive industries
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The energy-intensive industries are the key fields of circular economy construction, but their circular economy index systems are not well discussed. Therefore the general structure of circular economy index system for the energy-intensive industries is designed here, based on the features of industry, social pressure, comprehensive performance and feasibility. The circular economy index system has the advantages of clear levels, compact structure, and being easy to operate, which are illustrated with two cases.

articleTitle: The factor decomposition analysis of secondary industry energy intensity in China
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: According to 1994-2007 energy consumption intensity data in China of secondary industry, which is divided into mining, manufacturing, power (electric power, gas and water production and supply simplified)and construction 4 industries, the paper researches efficiency and structural 2 factors of secondary industry in China by Ang B W 1998 logarithmic mean weight Divisia method (LMD). It also researches efficiency and structural 2 factors contribution comparison of coal, oil, power 3 energies and efficiency and structural 2 factors share contribution among 4 industries. The paper gives 5 conclusions of the factor to energy intensity in China of secondary industry.

articleTitle: Study on player experience in the game world
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: The aim of this study is to investigate impacts from a game on players through measuring and comparing player immersion to explore game design. In terms of an instrument of player immersion in the computer game narrative and factor scores from exploratory factor analysis of a survey, this study measures and compares player immersion impacted from 5 games. The first three games are Final fantasy, Sangokushi 11 and Sword of Xuanyuan 3. And through comparing 7 dimension involved in the player immersion from the 5 games, this study proposes advices on some dimensions.

articleTitle: Simulation of spherical encapsulated ice of thermal energy storage system during freezing
publicationTitle: 2009 16th International Conference on Industrial Engineering and Engineering Management
abstract: Freezing characteristics of spherical encapsulated ice for thermal energy storage (TES) system are analyzed and important factors such as behavior of temperature inside spherical encapsulated ice is identified. An ice ball model was developed considering the heat transfer fluid (HTF) that flow across the ice ball containing phase change material (PCM). The model was simplified and the numerical simulations were validated by comparison with experimental results from previous study. The study shows that the rate of complete freezing of the ice ball is roughly three times the rate of diameter increment. The study also shows that it is critical to control the flow of the HTF inside the storage tank. The formation of ice was estimated based on the volume of ice formed at certain increment of time. The formation of ice for 94 mm ice ball is 4% faster than that of 103 mm ice ball.
